Who We Are

At CarGurus (NASDAQ: CARG), our mission is to give people the power to reach their destination. We started as a small team of developers determined to bring trust and transparency to car shopping. Since then, our history of innovation and go-to-market acceleration has driven industry-leading growth. In fact, we’re the largest and fastest-growing automotive marketplace, and we’ve been profitable for over 15 years.

What We Do

The market is evolving, and we are too, moving the entire automotive journey online and guiding our customers through every step. That includes everything from the sale of an old car to the financing, purchase, and delivery of a new one. Today, tens of millions of consumers visit CarGurus.com each month, and ~30,000 dealerships use our products. But they're not the only ones who love CarGurus—our employees do, too. We have a people-first culture that fosters kindness, collaboration, and innovation, and empowers our Gurus with tools to fuel their career growth. Disrupting a trillion-dollar industry requires fresh and diverse perspectives. Come join us for the ride!

Role Overview

The Integrated Marketing and Communication Associate will support the Sr. Director of Brand Marketing and Head of External Communications across integrated brand campaigns, content creation, and brand communication in the US, CA, and UK.

What You'll Do

Campaign Development & Project Management

Work with the Brand Marketing Manager to concept and develop integrated marketing campaigns, brand partnerships, and grassroots marketing initiatives
Manage project plans for integrated campaigns and initiatives across US, CA, and UK — tracking timelines, deliverables, and approvals from brief to launch.
Draft creative briefs for the UK and CA, ensuring audience, objectives, and success metrics are clearly captured. This person must ensure localized briefs stay true to CarGurus' brand platform, voice, and visual identity while incorporating localized insights and goals.
Serve as the day-to-day point of contact for international stakeholders across revenue and product marketing teams, ensuring localized needs and nuances are incorporated into our strategy and planning.
Serve as the day-to-day point of contact for performance marketing, product marketing, analytics, PR, and sales — covering project status and administration duties (archiving assets, handling day-of activation logistics, overseeing procurement).

Communication Support

Manage internal brand calendar to plan and track all internal and external brand communication
Draft internal and external content related to brand campaign promotion, including press releases, social content and internal communication, translating campaign messaging and strategy into clear, on-brand copy.
Incorporate feedback from PR and Brand Marketing stakeholders through revisions to finalize release-ready copy.
Partner with PR agencies on brand campaign communications strategy, providing campaign briefs and target KPIs, making sure results tie back to campaign goals
Support brand reputation monitoring and flag relevant coverage or social media conversations

Reporting & Analytics

Build regular performance reporting on campaigns, content, and sponsorships — pulling data from tools like Google Analytics and Sprout Social — and translate it into executive-ready summaries for leadership.
Track budgets and invoices across creative production and sponsorship programs

What You'll Bring

2+ years of experience in brand marketing or a creative or PR agency, ideally in a consumer-facing, digital-first environment.
Creative thinker with a finger on the pulse of what's relevant in culture, living and breathing social trends and content
Strong project management and organizational skills, with the ability to track multiple workstreams and deadlines simultaneously.
Excellent written communication skills, with early experience drafting external-facing copy (e.g., press releases, brand messaging, social content).
Clear, proactive communication style — able to keep stakeholders and leadership informed without needing heavy oversight.
Eagerness to learn brand strategy fundamentals and grow into a larger strategic role over time.

This annual base salary forms part of a comprehensive Total Rewards Package. In addition to benefits, this role may qualify for discretionary bonuses/incentives and Restricted Stock Units (RSUs).

Position Pay Range

$69,000—$87,000 USD

Working at CarGurus

We reward our Gurus’ curiosity and passion with best-in-class benefits and compensation, including equity for all employees, both when they start and as they continue to grow with us. Our career development and corporate giving programs, as well as our employee resource groups (ERGs) and communities, help people build connections while making an impact in personally meaningful ways. Thoughtful perks like daily free lunch, a new car discount, meditation and fitness apps, commuting cost coverage, and more help our people create space for what matters most in their personal and professional lives.

Here, we turn dreams into stardom and audiences into fans. We are guided by three core values that underpin everything we do across all our diverse businesses:

Curiosity: We do our best work when we’re immersing ourselves in culture and breaking through barriers. Curiosity is the driving force behind creativity and ingenuity. It fuels innovation, and innovation is the key to our future.
Collaboration: Making music and bringing it to the world is all about the power of originality amplified by teamwork. A great idea, like a great song, travels globally. We ignite passions and build connections across our diverse community of artists, songwriters, partners, and fans.
Commitment: We pursue excellence for our team and our talent. Everything in music starts with a leap into the unknown, and we’re committed to keeping the faith, acting with integrity, and delivering on our promises.

WMG is home to a wide range of artists, musicians, and songwriters that fuel our success. That is why we are committed to creating a work environment that actively values, appreciates, and respects everyone. We encourage applications from people with a wide variety of backgrounds and experiences.

Consider a career at WMG and get the best of both worlds – an innovative global music company that retains the creative spirit of a nimble independent.

Job Title:
Manager, Marketing (Revolution)

A little bit about our team:

Revolution is Warner Records’ distribution and artist development business, helping emerging artists grow their audiences and build lasting careers. We work across genres, combining a nimble and personal approach to artist development with the expertise and resources of Warner Records. Our team partners closely with artists and managers, bringing together marketing, viral, creative, and distribution support to help each project move forward.

Your role:

In this role, you’ll own campaigns for an assigned roster, leading new releases and sustaining momentum across the catalog. As the main day-to-day contact for artists and managers, you will translate their goals into clear plans and coordinate with internal and external partners to deliver on them. Additionally, you’ll manage timelines, budgets, and communication while bringing fresh ideas and solving problems as they arise. This exciting new role will have the opportunity to help shape a growing business and make a direct impact on the artists we support!

Here you’ll get to:

Own marketing strategy and campaign management for an assigned roster, from release planning through ongoing catalog development
Serve as the primary day-to-day contact for artists and managers, building trust, managing expectations, and providing clear, timely updates
Partner with the viral team to develop campaign briefs, align on priorities, and coordinate execution, keeping artist feedback and campaign goals connected
Lead campaign meetings and maintain project plans across internal teams and external partners, assigning responsibilities, tracking deadlines, and following through on commitments
Manage release calendars and coordinate artwork, content, approvals, and distribution deadlines to ensure releases are delivered accurately and on time
Bring fresh, practical marketing ideas tailored to each artist’s identity, genre, and audience, adapting quickly when new opportunities emerge
Develop and manage campaign budgets, select and coordinate vendors, track spending, and recommend investment priorities in collaboration with leadership and Finance
Review streaming, social, and campaign performance to refine strategy, identify catalog opportunities, and turn results into clear next steps
Resolve day-to-day issues independently, anticipate delays, and keep leadership informed of key developments and decisions that need input

About you:

You have 2–4 years of relevant experience in marketing, campaign or project management, artist services, or a related field
You have strong organizational skills and a track record of managing multiple projects at once, with close attention to detail and consistent follow-through
You have excellent communication and relationship skills, with the ability to earn artists’ trust, lead productive conversations, and manage expectations
You are passionate about music across genres and understand how different artists, audiences, and fan communities call for different approaches

jobs.description:
IXL Learning, developer of personalized learning products used by millions of people globally, is seeking a full-time Marketing Associate to help launch and grow Takeoff by IXL, our new core math curriculum.

Choosing a core curriculum is a major, multi-year decision, and it usually involves committee reviews, classroom pilots, and strict adoption processes set by districts and states. As a new entrant in this market, Takeoff needs marketing that builds credibility, supports rigorous evaluation, and gives educators and decision-makers the information they need at every stage, from first awareness to full adoption.

In this role, you’ll help bring Takeoff to national and regional markets. You’ll create materials that introduce the program to educators who have never heard of it, give review committees the materials they need to evaluate it, support districts through pilots, and turn early customer success into proof that builds confidence. You’ll partner closely with our sales team to bring national campaigns into regional outreach timed to each state’s and district’s decision process. We’re looking for a strong writer and communicator who is creative, organized, proactive, and passionate about IXL’s mission to improve education.

This is a full-time position that requires you to be in our IXL headquarters office in San Mateo, CA.

What You'll Be Doing

Partner with Sales to understand district and review committee priorities, questions, and objections throughout the adoption process
Write and develop marketing and sales materials that meet those needs, from initial awareness through evaluation, pilot, and purchase. These may include overview brochures, evaluation guides, pilot resources, objection-handling resources, emails, web copy, event materials, and customer case studies.
Coordinate national and regional campaign rollouts timed to state and district adoption cycles, ensuring the right messaging and materials reach each market ahead of key decision points
Help identify and develop customer proof points, including educator feedback, implementation stories, and results that build confidence in Takeoff
Collaborate with colleagues from various teams, including product managers and graphic designers, to manage projects from start to finish
Help keep a pulse on core math curriculum trends, adoption cycles, and the competitive landscape, and share insights with marketing and sales
Track campaign performance, such as email engagement, event response, lead activity, and field feedback, and use these learnings to improve future outreach

What We're Looking For

BA/BS degree and 2–4 years of solid marketing experience in a professional environment
Written communication: You are an exceptional writer and know how to make every word count. You can switch easily from writing messaging about a new product feature, to crafting an impactful marketing email, to creating attention-grabbing invitation headlines
Sales partnership: Experience working with a sales team is a plus
Interpersonal skills: You’re a team player, have excellent interpersonal skills, and the ability to work effectively with people at all levels
You get things done: You’re a self starter, detail-oriented, organized, resourceful, can manage projects from start to finish and juggle multiple deadlines
You have knowledge of, or an interest in, education/edtech and can learn about the industry quickly
Experience with Google Docs, Sheets, and Slides
Experience with Adobe Illustrator/Photoshop is a plus

The base salary range for this full-time position is $71,000 to $80,000 + benefits. Our pay ranges are determined by role, level, and location. The range displayed on each job posting reflects the minimum and maximum target for new hire salaries for the position. Individual pay is determined by work location and additional factors, including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.

About IXL Learning

IXL Learning is the country's largest EdTech company. We reach millions of learners through our diverse range of products. For example:

1 in 4 students in the United States uses IXL.com
Rosetta Stone provides an immersive learning experience for 25 languages
Wyzant is the nation's largest community of tutors, covering 300+ subjects

We have a unique culture at IXL that fosters collaboration and the open exchange of ideas. We value our team and treat one another with kindness and respect. We approach our work with passion, tenacity, and authenticity. We find it immensely satisfying to develop products that impact the lives of millions and we are eager to have you join our team.

jobs.description:
Marketing Operations Manager, US (Remote)

The Role

We’re looking for a Marketing
Operations Manager
to be the primary RevOps partner to our Marketing team at Linnworks.

This is a hands-on role for someone who understands how systems, data, process and automation come together to help Marketing generate demand, create pipeline and measure its impact on revenue.

The Marketing Operations Manager will own the operational framework behind our marketing funnel — from campaign infrastructure and lead lifecycle management to scoring, routing, attribution, data quality and Marketing-to-Sales handoffs. You’ll work closely with Marketing, Sales, Revenue Operations and our Salesforce team to build processes that are scalable, measurable and easy for teams to use.

We’re also investing in how we use AI, automation, enrichment, and emerging GTM technology. You’ll play an important role in identifying practical ways these tools can reduce manual work, improve data quality, and help us identify, engage, and convert prospects more effectively.

This position is open to applicants who live in either the Eastern or Central US time zones. Applicants must be authorized to work in the United States without the need for employer-sponsored visa support, now or in the future.

What You’ll Do

Act as the primary Revenue Operations partner to Marketing, translating business priorities into scalable processes, systems, data and reporting solutions
Own and continuously improve our Marketing Operations framework across technology, automation, governance and measurement
Own Pardot / Salesforce Account Engagement from a Marketing Operations perspective and help ensure our wider MarTech stack is effectively integrated and governed
Manage and improve the lead lifecycle, including capture, scoring, routing, nurture, recycling, ownership and Marketing-to-Sales handoffs
Own campaign operations and standards, including campaign structure, taxonomy, UTMs, segmentation, automation and QA
Improve Marketing data quality through better enrichment, deduplication, field governance, consent management and database hygiene
Help us get more value from tools includ ing ZoomInfo, Clay, Qualified and Gong

Partner with our Salesforce and BI teams to improve funnel, attribution, campaign and pipeline reporting
Use performance data to identify conversion gaps, risks and opportunities across the funnel
Lead cross-functional Marketing Operations initiatives from requirements and implementation through documentation, training and adoption

What We’re Looking For

You’ll bring 3+ years of experience in Marketing Operations, Revenue Operations, GTM Operations, Demand Operations or a similar role, ideally within a B2B SaaS or technology business.

You should also have:

Hands-on experience owning or administering a marketing automation platform, ideally Pardot / Salesforce Account Engagement
Experience working with Salesforce-connected marketing processes and CRM data
Strong understanding of the B2B lead-to-opportunity funnel and Marketing-to-Sales processes
Experience with lead lifecycle management, campaign operations, attribution and funnel reporting
Strong systems thinking and an understanding of how data, integrations, automation and reporting work together
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to turn ambiguous GTM challenges into practical solutions
Experience leading cross-functional projects and working with stakeholders across Marketing, Sales and Revenue Operations
A proactive, curious approach and the confidence to challenge inefficient or overly manual ways of working

Experience with enrichment tools, account-based marketing, intent data, AI-enabled workflows or emerging GTM technology would be a plus.

What Success Looks Like

You’ll help us build a Marketing Operations function that scales: clearer lead management and handoffs, better data, stronger attribution and funnel visibility, less manual work, and a MarTech stack that genuinely supports the business.
Most importantly, you’ll become a trusted operational partner to Marketing — helping the team execute more effectively and clearly demonstrate its contribution to pipeline and revenue.

We embrace diversity and inclusion and encourage our amazing team members to bring their authentic, fun selves to work every day. Work in tandem with business unit managers, market segment leaders, project managers, and subject matter experts to determine forward action decisions, pursuit win strategies, craft sales messages, assemble pursuit teams, manage the proposal process, and develop proposal responses.
Manage multiple proposal efforts and teams simultaneously within diverse service offerings.
Manage, develop, and maintain client action plans for high priority clients.
Support business development and operational personnel in market research, competitor analysis, and client intelligence.
Possess the sales acumen to represent the firm appropriately with teaming partners and subcontractors, at events and business networking opportunities.

The US Early Assets Eye Health Marketing Lead drives corporate TA development to maximize commercial value for U.S. market and to create a U.S. commercialization strategy for future portfolio of early assets. Provides input and insight-based recommendations into key strategic early asset deliverables. This role serves as the strategic marketing lead on the U.S. Early Assets teams until transitioning to a core team member of the U.S. Early Assets Eye Health Team around SoD.

This role is responsible for leading U.S. commercial strategy and value maximization for eye health assets and new indications from preclinical development and cTPP formation through transfer to the asset team at Release of Full Development (ROFD). The role brings a deep U.S. eye health perspective to global pipeline commercial activities and prepares each opportunity for informed investment, development, differentiation, and transition decisions.

Therapeutic scope is eye health, with particular emphasis on retinal diseases including geographic atrophy (GA), diabetic retinopathy (DR), diabetic macular edema (DME), and age-related macular degeneration (AMD), including neovascular AMD where relevant

Development scope begins in preclinical development, including cTPP development, and continues through formal transfer to an asset team at ROFD

Primary focus is asset strategy, commercial value maximization, evidence-based U.S. input, and pre-ROFD commercialization planning. Post-transfer brand execution and launch tactics are outside the scope of this role

Stakeholder scope includes retina specialists, comprehensive and general ophthalmologists, optometrists, patients, caregivers, payers, integrated eye care networks, and other partners that influence diagnosis, referral, treatment, access, and longitudinal care

Eye Health Asset and Portfolio Strategy

Lead the U.S. early asset strategic plan or Value Proposition Development Plan for each assigned eye health asset and new indication, establishing strategic choices, value drivers, U.S. success factors, assumptions, risks, and decision points required before ROFD

Translate retinal science, clinical evidence, patient experience, provider workflow, referral dynamics, payer considerations, and market insights into actionable commercial recommendations that guide development and maximize long-term U.S. value

Maintain a current, practical understanding of the U.S. eye health market landscape, including care settings, referral pathways, diagnostic practices, treatment capacity, office economics, buy-and-bill dynamics, access considerations, and differences across retinal practices and broader ophthalmology and optometry channels

Duties & Responsibilities

Responsible for critically understanding the asset and current plus future competition which includes current and future evidence generation, competitive advantages and disadvantages, and asset/ portfolio positioning (e.g., competitor pipeline analysis, scenario planning based on potential competitor actions, and developing specific competitive strategies)

Co-creates global deliverables by giving input into U.S. and Corporate working teams (Knowledge Networks, Early Asset Teams, Value Deliverable Teams) for forecasts and asset strategy within the Integrated Asset Plan

Proactively informs and influences, provides briefing and recommendations to US Leadership/CMC members for decisions and additional commercialization topics at EC level governance forums such as TALC and HPSC

Provides insight-based input into the development of value drivers to deliver a strong value proposition for each asset through the VPDP (value proposition development process) and provides inputs into the GTM strategy, when appropriate

Leads the development of the disease handbook and respective updates, communicates the market understanding to stakeholders

Identifies and communicates areas for improvement and Optimization – Drives continuous improvement initiatives to optimize the product transition process from early asset to post PoCP, sharing and implementing best practices, tools, and methodologies to streamline workflows and enhance efficiency for other US Early Asset Teams

Provides valuable insight-based recommendations into the corporate Early Asset Value team by understanding the prescriber and the patient which includes:

Patient prevalence, diagnosis and treatment rates, patient journey, understanding the HCP (mapping, journey and segmentation, actively engaging with patient advocacy groups, external partners, KEEs etc. to understand the prescriber and patient perspective that could shape the disease map, PoPC study design and patient flow

Translating key insights from scientific experts (internal R&D colleagues and external opinion leaders) into clear, actionable strategies for the asset and/or franchise

Managing the early asset budget (GP) to ensure we appropriately and efficiently invest to set the strategic foundation

Leads the development of an early brand strategy by understanding the market landscape of the future:

Provides an understanding of the asset indication space, early planning for line extensions or new indications, current and future market opportunities and challenges, regulatory guidelines, and high-level market access strategies in partnership with the early asset team and global

Uses in depth disease area, patient journey and market knowledge to influence development colleagues providing strategic direction to inform clinical trial design

Evaluating the opportunity:

Co-creates global forecast (which could include OPU expenses) or creating bottoms-up forecast for the U.S. market, leads the development of early asset brand strategy

Leads US economic evaluation for early assets to determine feasibility of success in the US for Global strategic choices and recommendations

Collaborates to develop the market research plan, the respective market research survey and associated budget

Requirements

Bachelor degree in related field required; Master’s in a related field or MBA preferred

Minimum of twelve to fifteen (12-15) years’ experience in the pharmaceutical industry including ten to twelve (10-12) years of pharmaceutical product marketing, commercial, or related experience

Demonstrated experience in eye health, ophthalmology, retina, or a closely related specialty market. Direct experience in retinal disease areas, particularly GA, DR, DME, and AMD, is strongly preferred

Demonstrated knowledge of retina specialists, comprehensive and general ophthalmologists, and optometrists, including stakeholder needs, practice workflows, referral relationships, treatment settings, and adoption considerations

Strong understanding of the U.S. eye health market landscape, including retinal disease epidemiology, diagnosis and treatment pathways, imaging and monitoring, intraocular treatment delivery, patient and practice burden, payer dynamics, and access considerations

Demonstrated success in early commercial planning/strategies, launch and managing products strongly preferred

Ability to independently interface with leadership in the U.S. and in corporate

General understanding of medical practice, payor landscape, FDA and EMEA regulatory processes, launch processes

Understanding and leadership required of advertising and promotion procedures and guidelines, as well as market research process and tools, and forecasting techniques

Demonstrated project management skills and able to manage complexity

Demonstrated ability to achieve results in a highly matrixed organization

History of successful performance

Ability to travel (may include overnight travel)

Eligibility Requirements:

Boehringer Ingelheim is a biopharmaceutical company active in both human and animal health. As one of the industry's top investors in research and development, the company focuses on developing innovative therapies that can improve and extend lives in areas of high unmet medical need. jobs.title: Sr Product Marketing Manager, Platform
jobs.description:
Product Marketing turns Chainalysis innovation into customer value. We position our intelligence as solutions customers can understand and consume through our platform, shape how we commercialize them, and give GTM the stories and strategic assets to win. Customers reach our intelligence through products, AI agents, workflows, APIs, data and expert services. This role owns what those add up to. Our segment leads make it specific to an industry; you make the case for Chainalysis as a whole, and build the programs that grow each customer over time.

As Senior Product Marketing Manager for Platform, you will own the positioning for the Chainalysis platform as a whole, then turn it into the lifecycle campaigns and programmes that drive adoption, usage and expansion across our customer base.

This is a horizontal role working across every segment. It suits a problem solver rather than a feature marketer: you start from what customers are trying to do and what gets in their way, then work back to what we offer. You are metrics-savvy. You know what moves the needle and which levers to pull to meet an objective. You will work closely with Product, Sales, Customer Outcomes, Marketing & Communications and GTM Solutions & Readiness, alongside the segment leads who go deep on their industries.

In This Role, You'll

Position the value

Define and evolve the Chainalysis story: what our intelligence enables, why we are meaningfully different, and why the whole is worth more than any one part.
Build the messaging that lets GTM teams tell that story consistently.
Own competitive positioning: frame the category and turn market moves into guidance deal teams can act on.

Build the programmes that grow it

Build the lifecycle campaigns that take customers deeper into the platform and scale them in partnership with demand generation, product and sales strategy: onboarding, activation, expansion and renewal, each with its own message and moment.
Spot the expansion patterns that hold across segments and turn them into cross-sell and upsell plays: the trigger, the message, the proof, and the asset a seller uses.
Explain our commercial model in the customer’s terms, so buyers can see how what they use connects to what they get.
Lead go-to-market planning for launches that span the portfolio, working with segment leads on the value proposition for each audience.

Win and learn in market

Produce the strategic content that moves these conversations forward: first-call decks, value maps, discovery frameworks, ROI stories, objection handling and sales plays.
Partner with Product, Product Marketing, GTM & Enablement teams to turn the strongest narratives into field tools sellers can find and use without asking.
Turn churn, win-loss, field feedback and competitive signal into sharper positioning, and measure what reflects business health rather than activity.

We're Looking For Candidate Who Have

8+ years in product, solutions, industry, or B2B enterprise technology marketing.
Experience building something from nothing: a new proposition, segment or business line where there was no playbook.
Positioning that changes how customers and sellers see a problem, and connects many capabilities into one value story.
Experience designing lifecycle campaigns or expansion programmes where you owned the messaging and mechanics.
Exceptional writing and editorial judgment. You can write crisp headlines, persuasive narratives, practical sales content, and executive-level messaging; you know the difference between jargon and precision.
A collaborative self-starter, comfortable driving ambiguous, multi-stakeholder work forward across Product, Sales, technical and revenue teams, and senior leaders.

Nice To Have Experience

Experience with blockchain, digital assets, or crypto-native financial infrastructure.
Experience marketing AI-powered products, data platforms, intelligence products, cybersecurity, or risk and compliance technology.
Familiarity with consumption- or usage-based pricing and packaging.

You’ll Thrive Here If

You enjoy connecting many products into one story more than marketing a single product in isolation. You build from first principles and create structure where none exists. You write with precision, build for repeatability rather than one-off requests, and care about the quality of what reaches customers and the field. You know when to go deep and when to simplify, and help raise the standard of the work around you.

AI at Chainalysis

AI is not a feature at Chainalysis - it is a new way of working. One that turns instructions into work done, and helps us move faster than the threats we're built to counter, and we expect our employees to take ownership of the output and ensure quality. As the world's most trusted blockchain analytics platform, Chainalysis sits at a rare intersection of proprietary data, regulatory relationships and crypto expertise that makes it uniquely placed to shape and lead the next era of AI-driven intelligence - and we expect everyone here, regardless of role, to be an active part of it.

AI fluency is tied directly to how we measure performance and how we plan to win. There is no substitute for your own curiosity. We provide the tools, workflows, and space to experiment - but the expectation is that you develop these capabilities yourself, bring ideas, and collaborate across teams to reinvent the way work gets done. We are not using AI to do less. We are using it to do what was never possible before.

About Chainalysis

Chainalysis is the blockchain data platform, making it easy to connect the movement of digital assets to real-world services. Powered by deep blockchain data and AI, organizations can investigate illicit activity, manage risk exposure, and develop innovative market solutions built on the industry's most trusted blockchain intelligence. Our mission is to build trust in blockchains, blending safety and security with an unwavering commitment to growth and innovation.

You belong here.

At Chainalysis, we believe that diversity of experience and thought makes us stronger. With both customers and employees around the world, we are committed to ensuring our team reflects the unique communities around us. We’re ensuring we keep learning by committing to continually revisit and reevaluate our diversity culture.

We encourage applicants across any race, ethnicity, gender/gender expression, age, spirituality, ability, experience and more. If you need any accommodations to make our interview process more accessible to you due to a disability, don't hesitate to let us know. You can learn more here. We can’t wait to meet you.

jobs.title: Lead Management & Performance Marketing Manager
jobs.description:
About Usg And Our Digital Customer Experience Journey

USG Corporation is an industry-leading manufacturer of building products and innovative solutions highlighted by Sheetrock®, Durock®, and Securock® Brands.

Headquartered in Chicago, USG serves construction markets around the world through its Gypsum, Performance Materials and Ceilings divisions. Its wall, ceiling, flooring, sheathing, and roofing products provide the solutions that enable customers to build outstanding spaces where people live, work, and play.

USG is evolving its digital customer experience and translating the objective of being the easiest to do business with, into a sustainable technology roadmap which USG shares with the parent company Knauf. The digital transformation includes upgrading our technology stack and augmenting our teams, developing new digital platforms, and integrating an agile operating model to deliver exceptional customer experiences. The program supports all USG regions, building solutions for customers in the US, Canada, and LATAM.

Role Summary

The Manager, Lead Management & Performance Marketing is a strategic commercial marketing leader responsible for the end-to-end lead management operating model and the performance marketing programs that create qualified demand, accelerate pipeline, and demonstrate measurable revenue impact. This role owns the lead lifecycle from acquisition through qualification, routing, nurture, sales handoff, opportunity conversion, and closed-loop performance measurement across USG, CGC, and LATAM.

As the business Product Owner for Lead Management, this leader defines the vision, roadmap, governance, requirements, and prioritized enhancement backlog for Salesforce CRM, Salesforce Marketing Cloud, and connected capabilities. The role partners across Marketing, Sales, Digital, Sales Operations, Customer Experience, Analytics, and IT to establish scalable processes, improve adoption and data quality, and optimize investment based on funnel performance and business outcomes.

Key Responsibilities

Lead Management Strategy, Operating Model & Governance

Own the enterprise lead management strategy and operating model, aligning priorities to commercial objectives, customer segments, and regional growth plans.
Define the lead lifecycle across capture, enrichment, scoring, qualification, routing, nurture, sales acceptance, opportunity conversion, recycling, and disposition.
Establish decision rights, ownership, governance forums, service-level expectations, and escalation paths across Marketing, Sales, Sales Operations, Digital, Analytics, and IT.
Product Ownership & Platform Enablement
Own the Lead Management vision, roadmap, governance, and prioritized product backlog in partnership with Marketing, Sales, Digital, Sales Operations, Salesforce, Analytics, and IT.
Translate business needs into clear capabilities, user stories, requirements, acceptance criteria, release priorities, and measurable value outcomes.
Govern stage definitions, entry and exit criteria, scoring logic, routing rules, handoff standards, recycling processes, and conversion tracking across regions and business units.
Act as the business Product Owner for Salesforce Lead Management and Salesforce Marketing Cloud capabilities, ensuring releases support the approved operating model, data standards, user experience, and business controls.
Drive adoption and continuous improvement while balancing enterprise consistency with validated local market requirements.

Performance Marketing & Demand Generation

Develop the performance marketing strategy and integrated demand plan by audience, product, market, lifecycle stage, channel, and revenue objective.
Co-Lead measurable acquisition and demand-generation programs across paid search, paid social, programmatic, account-based marketing, email, web, partner, and event channels together with the different marketing and sales/product management functions:
Design data-driven digital customer segmentation, lead scoring, nurture, suppression, frequency, and re-engagement strategies using behavioral, firmographic, transactional, account, product-interest, and lifecycle signals to improve relevance, lead quality, conversion, and pipeline velocity.
Build a disciplined testing agenda across audiences, offers, channels, landing experiences, bidding, sequencing, and calls to action; scale proven approaches based on incremental business impact.

Analytics, Attribution & Performance Optimization

Serve as the subject-matter expert for lead funnel analytics, performance marketing measurement, attribution, experimentation, and marketing investment optimization.
Co-create a common KPI framework spanning inquiries, leads, MQLs, sales acceptance, SQLs, opportunities, pipeline, revenue, cost per outcome, conversion, velocity, and return on marketing investment together with the analytics team
Develop and manage executive dashboards and operating reviews using Salesforce, Adobe Analytics or GA4, marketing automation platforms, Power BI, and other approved data sources.
Establish closed-loop reporting with Sales and Sales Operations to connect source, campaign, account, opportunity, revenue, and disposition data.
Govern measurement methodologies, attribution rules, taxonomy, campaign tracking, and data-quality controls to support consistent and trusted reporting.
Use performance insights to recommend budget shifts, channel mix changes, audience refinements, and funnel interventions, with clear assumptions and expected outcomes.
Partner with Analytics teams to design test-and-learn approaches, evaluate incrementality, and quantify the commercial contribution of marketing activity.

Lead Management Adoption & Continuous Improvement

Define role-based processes, training requirements, adoption measures, and change interventions for Marketing, Sales, and operational users.
Monitor funnel health, process adherence, lead aging, routing exceptions, rejection and recycling patterns, and data-quality issues; drive corrective action with accountable owners.
Maintain a prioritized continuous-improvement pipeline informed by user feedback, performance insights, business priorities, technology opportunities, and control requirements.

Cross-Functional Leadership

Serve as the lead liaison across Marketing, Sales, Sales Operations, Digital, Customer Experience, Analytics, and IT for lead management and performance marketing priorities. Work closely with Sales leadership and frontline sales teams to align qualification criteria, routing, service-level expectations, follow-up, feedback loops, opportunity conversion, and shared pipeline outcomes; coordinate with USG, CGC, LATAM, and global stakeholders as appropriate.
Provide executive leadership with concise performance narratives, actionable recommendations, investment trade-offs, roadmap status, risks, dependencies, and decisions required.

Capability Building & Best-Practice Leadership

Build lead management and performance marketing capabilities through standards, playbooks, training, coaching, and communities of practice.
Promote a culture of measurement, accountability, experimentation, customer relevance, and rapid learning.

Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Business Administration, Analytics, Economics, Data Science, or a related discipline; advanced degree preferred.

8+ years of progressive B2B lead management, demand generation, growth marketing, or performance marketing experience, including leadership in a complex cross-functional environment.
Deep expertise in lead lifecycle design, demand generation, campaign automation, digital customer segmentation, audience strategy, lead scoring, routing, nurture, funnel optimization, and sales handoff, including the use of behavioral, firmographic, transactional, account, product-interest, and lifecycle data to create actionable segments and personalized journeys.
Advanced experience with performance measurement, attribution, experimentation, funnel analytics, dashboarding, and translating insights into investment decisions.
Proven experience owning B2B lead management processes and applying product ownership practices, including roadmaps, backlogs, requirements, prioritization, release planning, and value measurement.
Proven experience with Salesforce CRM and Salesforce Marketing Cloud; experience with Adobe Analytics or GA4, Power BI, Tableau, and account-based marketing platforms is preferred.
Proven success working cross-functionally with Sales and Sales Operations to define shared funnel standards, qualification criteria, service-level expectations, follow-up processes, feedback loops, and pipeline and revenue outcomes, while also influencing Marketing, Digital, Analytics, IT, and executive stakeholders across regions or business units.
Experience in building materials, construction, manufacturing, distribution, or another complex B2B environment preferred.
Excellent strategic planning, program leadership, communication, and executive presentation skills, with a strong bias for measurable outcomes and disciplined execution.
Success Measures
Establish and sustain a unified lead management operating model, governance structure, roadmap, and accountability model across USG, CGC, and LATAM.
Improve lead quality, sales acceptance, MQL-to-SQL conversion, SQL-to-opportunity conversion, pipeline velocity, sourced or influenced pipeline, and revenue contribution against agreed baselines and targets.
Deliver trusted executive dashboards, consistent KPI definitions, closed-loop attribution, and transparent marketing investment performance.
Increase adoption of lead management standards, reduce routing and data-quality exceptions, and improve timely follow-up and disposition compliance.
Build scalable lead management and performance marketing capabilities that enable future AI, personalization, predictive scoring, and customer experience initiatives.

Rate of pay may be adjusted based on the qualifications and experience of the candidate.

USG employees enjoy a number of benefit options for themselves and their families. These include two medical insurance options, as well as vision and dental coverage. The cost of these optional programs varies based on coverage level - employees generally pay 25% of the monthly premium cost, USG pays the rest. These coverage options are offered on the first day of employment with no waiting period.

Additionally, USG employees enjoy both a 401(k) Investment Plan with company match and a pension plan. Beyond these main features, employees may also choose from a number of additional programs like life insurance, accident insurance, legal insurance, even pet insurance, just to name a few. USG also offers Quarterly (hourly) / Annual (salary) bonus potential for all employees based on performance metrics tied to safety, quality, and productivity. USG also provides employees with paid time off and paid holidays.

Since 1902, Chicago-based USG has been a leader in producing innovative, award-winning products and systems to build everything from major commercial developments and residential housing to home improvements. USG's employees are committed to the highest levels of customer satisfaction and quality in everything we do. Our steadfast commitment to the company's core business values – innovation, quality, integrity, service, diversity, efficiency and safety – have helped us become the company we are today.

serves as the strategic communications lead responsible for strengthening ITW Welding's industry voice through proactive public relations, thought leadership, and strategic storytelling. Move beyond experimentation to institutionalize AI as a structural growth lever, improving productivity, personalization, experimentation, forecasting and customer journey optimization while maintaining governance and data integrity.

Establish clear measures for AI impact and identify where human judgment remains essential.

jobs.title: Sr Product Marketing Manager, Go-To-Market
jobs.description:
ABOUT OBLQ

OBLQ builds software for independent insurance agencies, providing technology solutions that help independent P&Cs operate more efficiently and grow faster. We handle the technology so agencies can focus on selling policies and driving revenue. Learn more at oblq.ai.
Same Team. More Agency.

THE ROLE

We're looking for a Product Marketing Manager to help turn our products that deliver for existing customers into a company and category that independent insurance agencies know about, understand, and want to buy.

You'll work directly with the founders and stay close to both the product and our customers. You'll learn how independent agencies operate, what slows their teams down, why they buy, what makes them skeptical, and how OBLQ changes the economics of their business. Then you'll turn those insights into the way we go to market.

You'll own product positioning, messaging, launches, customer stories, sales enablement, competitive intelligence, and much of the content that connects OBLQ to the market.

This is an early-stage role. We have products our customers love, we have great data and measurable results, a brand, and a point of view. We need someone who can take those raw materials and build a repeatable product marketing engine around them.

WHAT YOU'LL OWN

Position OBLQ and its products.

Develop clear positioning and messaging for OBLQs current and future products. Understand what matters to agency owners & agents, and translate complex product capabilities into simple reasons to care.

Own the product story.

Make sure our website, social presence, sales materials, demos, campaigns, and product launches tell a consistent and compelling story.

Know the customer.

Spend time with independent agency owners and agents. Understand how they generate leads, quote business, work with carriers, use their CRM, follow up with customers, and make technology decisions.

Turn customer outcomes into proof.

Build case studies, customer stories, ROI narratives, testimonials, and other evidence that helps prospective customers understand what OBLQ can do for their agency.

Build sales enablement.

Give the people selling OBLQ what they need to have better conversations: messaging, presentations, one-pagers, competitive positioning, objection handling, demo narratives, follow-up materials, and customer-specific stories.

Own product launches.

Create the go-to-market plan for new capabilities, carrier integrations, product releases, and future OBLQ products. Define the audience, message, channels, assets, and measures of success.

Understand the market.

Know the insurance technology landscape, the alternatives agencies use today, and where OBLQ fits. Track competitors, comparative raters, agency management systems, CRMs, automation products, and emerging technologies that could change the market.

Build content that earns attention.

Create and manage content for the channels where our customers spend time. That may include LinkedIn, customer email, website content, product education, thought leadership, webinars, industry communities, and other formats we discover work.

Improve how we generate demand.

Work across organic, outbound, partnerships, referrals, and paid acquisition to understand which messages and channels create qualified interest. Test quickly, measure results, and keep what works.

Bring the market back into the product.

You won't own the product roadmap, but you'll have an important voice in it. Bring customer feedback, competitive intelligence, win/loss insights, and market signals back into product decisions.

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

You have experience marketing B2B software products and can show examples where your work changed how a product was understood, sold, adopted, or launched.

You know how to find the useful insight inside a customer conversation and turn it into positioning or messaging people actually understand.

You can explain a complicated product simply without stripping away what makes it valuable.

You understand the difference between describing a feature and explaining why someone should care about it.

You're comfortable creating the strategy and doing the work. At this stage, you may define the launch plan in the morning and write the landing page in the afternoon.

You can work closely with product and engineering teams and become technically fluent enough to market what we're building accurately.

You use data to evaluate your work. You care about pipeline, conversion, engagement, adoption, and revenue more than impressions for their own sake.

You're comfortable operating with incomplete information and creating structure where it doesn't yet exist.

You have strong judgment about brand and messaging. You know when something needs another round of thinking and when it just needs to get into the market so we can learn.

SKILLS WE'RE INTERESTED IN

Working with AI tools to accelerate research, content, experimentation, and execution
B2B SaaS or vertical SaaS
Insurance or insurtech (nice to have)
Products sold to small and midsize businesses
Workflow automation or operational software
Product-led or founder-led companies moving toward a repeatable GTM model
Sales enablement and customer storytelling
Launching new or unfamiliar product categories
Competitive and market research
Demand generation and lifecycle marketing

Insurance experience is not a prerequisite. We care more about your ability to understand a market quickly and turn what you learn into effective product marketing.

HOW WE WORK

Our development cycle is fast. New capabilities can move from idea to working software quickly, which means product marketing needs to stay equally close to the product and the customer.
We value people who understand the problem, form a point of view, communicate it clearly, put it into the market, measure what happens, and improve it.

WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE

A year from now:
An independent agency owner can land on OBLQ and quickly understand what we do, why it's different, and why it matters to their business.
Our positioning and messaging are consistent everywhere a prospect encounters us.
Customer outcomes have become credible stories, proof points, and sales assets.
Product launches have an audience, message, plan, and measurement strategy before they ship.
Sales conversations are supported by strong materials and a clear understanding of customer objections and competitive alternatives.
We know which messages, audiences, and channels create qualified opportunities and we're investing more heavily in the ones that work.
What we're learning in the market is consistently making its way back into the product.
Our product marketing capability is repeatable and can scale with the company.

PIMCO is a global leader in active fixed income with deep expertise across public and private markets. We invest our clients’ capital across a range of fixed income and credit opportunities, leveraging our decades of experience navigating complex debt markets. Our flexible capital base and deep relationships with issuers have helped us become one of the world’s largest providers of traditional and nontraditional solutions for companies that need financing and investors who seek strong risk-adjusted returns.

Since 1971, our people have shaped our organization through a high-performance inclusive culture, in which we celebrate diverse thinking. We invest in our people and strive to imprint our CORE values of Collaboration, Openness, Responsibility and Excellence. We believe each of us is here to help others succeed and this has led to PIMCO being recognized as an innovator, industry thought leader and trusted advisor to our clients.

The Role

This executive will play a leadership role in the next phase of digital transformation of PIMCO’s marketing capabilities. The role includes architecting data, technology, analytics and operating models that allow marketing teams to understand audiences, make better decisions, deliver more relevant experiences and measure commercial impact across institutional, wealth and intermediary channels.

A central mandate is to evolve marketing toward an AI-first approach. The leader will turn advances in artificial intelligence into governed, practical workflows for insight generation, decisioning, targeted content creation and optimization. Success requires close partnership with Marketing, Product Strategy Group, distribution teams, Technology, Legal and Compliance, and a disciplined ability to move from pilots to scaled adoption. The role is also responsible for ensuring that data, AI, personalization and marketing capabilities are designed and operated in alignment with global privacy, consent management and regulatory requirements, including GDPR and related data protection standards.

Key Responsibilities

Data, Segmentation and Decision Intelligence

Lead customer data transformation in Marketing, partnering with Technology and other critical business stakeholders
Aggregate and connect first-party engagement, account, product, campaign and relevant external data into reliable, permission-aware audience and account views.
Build segmentation and insight capabilities that reveal client needs, buying groups, journey stages, intent signals and opportunities for acquisition, retention and cross-sell.
Develop propensity models, scoring and next-best-action approaches; validate performance, monitor drift and make recommendations usable by marketers and distribution channels.
Create decision intelligence tools that translate data into choices about audiences, channels, content, timing and investment.

AI, Personalization and Content

Identify, test and scale AI applications across research synthesis, insight generation, campaign planning, content production, experimentation and performance analysis.
Enable dynamic content assembly and personalization across web, email and other channels, with human oversight, approved source material and appropriate review controls.
Advance precise audience and account targeting using consented data, intent and behavioral signals, while setting standards for privacy, model governance and brand integrity.

Measurement, Optimization and ROI

Create a consistent measurement framework connecting reach, engagement and conversion to qualified opportunities, client activity, asset flows and retention where attribution is supportable.
Leverage and evolve existing ecosystem of dashboards and analytic methods for incrementality, attribution, marketing mix and return on investment; state assumptions and measurement limits clearly.
Use test results and performance signals to optimize targeting, creative, channel mix, journeys and marketing spend on an ongoing basis.

Leadership, Adoption and Governance

Provide strategic influence across marketing technology, data science, analytics, digital experience, and marketing operations, partnering with functional leaders to align capabilities, priorities, and outcomes.
Create practical adoption plans, training and service models so regional and channel marketing teams can use new capabilities effectively.
Partner with Technology, Information Security, Privacy, Legal and Compliance to establish controls for client data, AI outputs, recordkeeping, access and regulated marketing approvals.
Manage technology vendors, implementation partners, budgets and delivery milestones; communicate progress and tradeoffs in business terms to senior leadership.

Qualifications

15 or more years of experience in marketing technology, digital transformation, data and analytics or related functions, including significant leadership of enterprise-scale programs and teams.
Demonstrated delivery of integrated marketing data and technology capabilities, from architecture and implementation through adoption, optimization and measurable outcomes.
Strong command of customer data architecture, identity resolution, data quality, consent management, APIs and integration of CRM, web, marketing automation and analytics systems.
Applied experience with segmentation, predictive modeling, propensity scoring, experimentation, causal measurement and ROI analytics; able to assess model quality and explain limitations.
Experience deploying generative AI and machine learning in production marketing workflows, with sound judgment about governance, human review, security and accuracy.
Ability to translate complex technology and analytic concepts into a prioritized business roadmap and to influence senior Marketing, Product, Distribution and Technology stakeholders.
Experience in asset management, wealth management or another regulated financial services business strongly preferred; understanding of institutional and intermediary customer journeys is valuable.
Experience using marketing automation platforms, such as Adobe Marketo Engage, Eloqua, Salesforce Marketing Cloud or HubSpot to execute, optimize, and measure digital marketing programs.

Proven record of leading multidisciplinary teams, managing vendors and budgets, and delivering change across a global matrix.
Bachelor’s degree required in a relevant discipline; advanced degree in business, analytics, computer science or a related field preferred.

SmartBug Media is one of the most respected names in the HubSpot ecosystem — and we've earned it.

We didn't get here by accident. That last part is the one we're most proud of.

Remote by design and strategic by nature, we've never believed that great work requires a corner office or a campus cafeteria. What it requires is the right people, deeply aligned on outcomes, working with clients who trust them to deliver. That's the culture we've built — one where expertise travels, relationships run deep, and the work speaks for itself.

We're obsessed with client outcomes. Not vanity metrics. Not feel-good reports. Real, measurable growth that makes our clients look like heroes inside their own organizations. When SmartBug is in your corner, your team wins — and that's exactly why our clients keep coming back.

We're growing, our client portfolio is expanding, and the relationships we've built are stronger than ever. Senior Director, Product Marketing & Applications, Data Center Power Delivery

The Opportunity

We are seeking a proven technical and strategic Senior Director to lead the global Product Marketing and Applications Engineering organization for Data Center Power Delivery. This dual-function leader will connect market insight, semiconductor and system-level power expertise, product strategy, and customer execution to accelerate profitable growth.

You will define and scale differentiated 48 V/54 V-to-core solutions for next-generation AI data centers, advancing power density, efficiency, integration, and system architecture to help unlock AI at scale and its potential to transform industries and improve lives worldwide.

You will own the product, market, and go-to-market roadmap for the portfolio, working in close alignment with R&D and design leadership to translate hyperscaler needs into winning silicon solutions and measurable business results.

Role at a Glance

Reports To: Head of Data Center Power Delivery.
Organization: Lead the global Product Marketing and Applications Engineering organization for Data Center Power Delivery.
Markets: AI accelerators, high-density servers, cloud infrastructure, networking, and high-performance computing.
Portfolio: High-current point-of-load solutions, 48 V/54 V intermediate bus converters, power modules, smart power stages, and system management solutions.
Technology: Advanced packaging and magnetics, high-frequency conversion, vertical power delivery, and thermal-mechanical co-design.

What You Will Own

Portfolio Strategy & Business Performance

Market & Roadmap Strategy: Convert customer, application, and competitive insight into a differentiated multi-year product and technology roadmap aligned with R&D leadership.
Product Definition, Pathfinding & Investment: Translate market needs into product requirements and business cases; evaluate emerging architectures, packaging, magnetics, silicon technologies, partnerships, and inorganic opportunities; and influence investment, sequencing, and build/buy/partner decisions.
Portfolio Performance: Drive positioning, segmentation, pricing, lifecycle, capacity, and cost decisions to grow revenue, market share, margin, and return on investment.

Applications & Solution Execution

System Architecture & Requirements: Partner with customers and R&D to translate performance, density, efficiency, thermal, reliability, telemetry, and cost needs into system architectures and clear product requirements.
Product & Application Readiness: Guide design trade-offs and ensure validation, evaluation platforms, reference designs, models, tools, documentation, and qualification support are ready for customer adoption.
Customer Execution & Learning: Lead strategic evaluations, integration, debugging, and critical issue resolution; feed field learning into product improvements and future roadmaps.

Go-to-Market & Design Wins

Go-to-Market Strategy: Define target segments, positioning, pricing, launch objectives, channel readiness, and success metrics for new products and platforms.
Launch & Operational Readiness: Align product performance, quality, evaluation tools, documentation, supply, capacity, communications, and support for on-time launches and production ramps.
Design-Win Conversion: Equip sales and field teams, prioritize strategic opportunities, and convert evaluations and reference-platform inclusion into production revenue.

Customer & Ecosystem Leadership

Strategic Relationships: Build trusted relationships with hyperscalers, partners, and internal stakeholders across engineering, architecture, procurement, and business leadership.
Platform Influence: Anticipate requirements, shape next-generation platforms, and focus applications and marketing resources on the highest-value opportunities and risks.
Ecosystem & Executive Engagement: Lead senior customer and partner reviews; support agreements, licensing, joint development, and strategic collaborations.

Organization & Talent Leadership

Organization Leadership: Lead and develop a global team of Product Applications Managers, Product Marketing Managers, Application Engineers, and technical leaders.
Operating Model: Define structure, decision rights, priorities, and operating cadence across Product Marketing and Applications Engineering, with clear interfaces to partner functions.
Talent & Culture: Build leadership capability, succession depth, and a high-performance culture centered on technical excellence, accountability, and customer impact.

How Success Will Be Measured

Design Wins & Revenue Conversion: Strategic socket wins, reference-platform inclusion, and conversion of evaluations and design wins into production revenue.
Growth & Profitability: Year-over-year revenue growth, market-share gain, gross-margin expansion, forecast accuracy, and return on development investment.
Roadmap & Launch Execution: On-time product requirements, validation, evaluation platforms, qualification, launches, and production ramps.
Customer & Organization Effectiveness: Customer satisfaction, critical-issue closure, organizational capability, employee engagement, and succession coverage.

Required

Education: BS or higher in Electrical Engineering or a related discipline.
Leadership Experience: 15+ years in power management, semiconductor applications, product management, product definition, or technical product marketing, including global leadership of managers and senior technical talent.
Power Architecture Expertise: Deep knowledge of high-current, high-density conversion for data center, AI accelerator, server, or networking systems, including xPU core power, smart power stages, point-of-load converters, modules, and intermediate-bus solutions.
Commercial & Execution Results: Demonstrated success defining products, launching semiconductors, executing complex customer programs, and delivering design-win, revenue, margin, or market-share growth.

Summary

The Marketing Operations Program Specialist, working in collaboration with and in support of the firm’s strategic initiatives, is a versatile member of the Marketing Business Development (MBD) team, responsible for supporting a broad range of marketing operations projects while also serving as the team's internal resource for identifying and advancing practical AI opportunities.

This role is equal parts doer and coordinator — stepping in on high-priority initiatives, managing ad hoc project requests, and ensuring cross-functional work stays on track. Alongside that operational foundation, the Specialist brings working knowledge of AI tools and a curiosity for how they can be applied to improve MBD's everyday workflows, reporting, and content processes.

Critically, this is a business-side role. The Specialist does not own AI infrastructure, build technical systems, or operate independently of the firm's IT and Innovation functions. Instead, they serve as MBD's informed liaison — identifying opportunities, scoping use cases, supporting pilots in partnership with the appropriate technical teams, and ensuring successful adoption across the MBD team.

Curate and share best practices, prompt libraries, and usage guidance to enable compliant and effective AI use across teams with varying levels of familiarity.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

jobs.title: Senior Data Scientist, Growth Marketing
jobs.description:
Who We Are

The real world is the next frontier, and at Metropolis, we are creating the artificial intelligence to make it responsive. We are pioneering the Recognition Economy — a future where mundane repetition disappears and being known unlocks access, comfort and belonging everywhere you go. From transforming parking into a seamless drive-in, drive-out experience for millions of Members to expanding our intelligence layer across retail and hospitality, we are building a world that feels instinctive and magical. The future isn’t coming; it’s here, and we need builders, innovators and problem solvers to help us create it.

Who You Are

Metropolis is seeking a Senior Data Scientist, Growth Marketing to join our growing data team. In this role, you will serve as the primary quantitative partner to our Growth Marketing leadership, turning massive real-world transactional and behavioral datasets into engines for user acquisition, retention, and gross profit expansion. You bring a deep background in marketing measurement and causal inference, with proven experience building multi-touch attribution systems, modeling customer lifetime value (LTV), and designing rigorous marketing experiments. You excel not only at building complex predictive models, but also at translating high-level data insights into clear business strategies for cross-functional stakeholders across Growth, Product, and Finance.

What You'll Do

Design, deploy, and refine predictive models for Multi-Touch Attribution (MTA), Customer Lifetime Value (CLV), and Customer Acquisition Cost (CAC) efficiency to guide multi-channel marketing budget allocation
Conduct deep-dive cohort analyses and retention modeling to uncover drivers of user conversion, repeat behavior, and churn across our location-based growth funnel
Lead the growth experimentation roadmap by designing, executing, and analyzing A/B tests, geo-experiments, holdout tests, and incrementality studies across digital and physical acquisition channels
Partner directly with Growth Marketing and Finance leaders to optimize unit economics, justify marketing spend against gross profit targets, and set channel-level growth goals
Collaborate with analytics and data engineering teams to establish event tracking requirements, build scalable growth data pipelines, and develop automated executive dashboards
Utilize advanced AI tools and modern analytics frameworks to transform static analytical workflows into responsive, high-output processes

What we're looking for

Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Mathematics, Statistics, Economics, or a related quantitative field
6+ years of proven experience as a Data Scientist or Analytics Lead, with a distinct focus on growth marketing, performance media, or adtech
Advanced proficiency in Python and SQL for complex data manipulation, statistical modeling, and predictive analytics
Deep domain expertise in growth measurement frameworks, multi-touch attribution, cohort retention modeling, and LTV/CAC dynamics
Hands-on experience with statistical experimentation and causal inference techniques such as A/B testing, geo-testing, synthetic controls, and media mix modeling
Strong business acumen with a track record of partnering with senior executives in Growth, Product, and Finance to drive measurable bottom-line growth
Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills to make complex data stories intuitive and actionable
Experience leveraging AI tools to transform static workflows into responsive, high-output processes

While not required, these are a plus:

Experience with cloud platforms, including AWS S3, SageMaker, and Airflow
Experience with cloud data warehouses and modern data tools such as Snowflake, dbt, Looker, and Tableau
Familiarity with Media Mix Modeling (MMM) frameworks including Robyn and LightweightMMM
Hands-on experience with machine learning frameworks such as scikit-learn, TensorFlow, or PyTorch applied to user segmentation or churn prediction
Ability to write clean, efficient, robust, and well-commented code to produce high-quality data science procedures

4 Days in Office:
Metropolis values in-person collaboration to drive innovation, strengthen culture, and enhance the Member experience. Our corporate team members hold to our office-first model, which requires employees to be on-site at least four days a week, fostering organic interactions that spark creativity and connection.

When you join Metropolis, you’ll join a team of world-class product leaders and engineers, building an ecosystem of technologies at the intersection of parking, mobility, and real estate. Our goal is to build an inclusive culture where everyone has a voice and the best idea wins. You will play a key role in building and maintaining this culture as our organization grows. The anticipated base salary for this position is $170,000 USD to $200,000 USD annually. About Us

Who we are:

Samsonite is the worldwide leader in superior travel bags, luggage, and accessories combining notable style with the latest design technology and the utmost attention to quality and durability. Job Description

The Sr Marketing Manager, Amazon is responsible for driving sell-through, share growth, and account marketing strategy for the Amazon channel across the portfolio of brands. This role is accountable for traffic, conversion, and share growth.

This role operates as the primary marketing leader for Amazon, orchestrating cross-functional resources from Growth & Demand (media), Digital Shelf & CRM (shelf standards), Brand CoE (brand briefs), and IHA/Content CoE (assets) to execute against omnichannel standards. This role partners closely with Product Marketing and Sales to define the Amazon account strategy, build the account marketing calendar, and lead all account-facing marketing execution — leveraging CoE experts as needed for sell-in.

This is a hybrid role; we work on site 4 days and remotely 1 day, weekly.

Essential Functions

Serve as the primary marketing lead for the Amazon channel — account-facing across the retailer and internally across the RMEO organization.
Develop and own the Amazon account marketing strategy in partnership with Product Marketing, CoEs and Sales
Build the Amazon marketing calendar to maximize channel potential across seasons, launches, and key moments
Drive Amazon sell-through, ROAS, and share growth by brand across the Amazon channel
Partner with the CoEs to ensure Amazon account success while adhering to omnichannel standards and guidelines
Coordinate cross-functionalresources from Growth & Demand , Digital Shelf & CRM (PDP standards), Brand CoE (briefs), and IHA/Content (assets)
Own Amazon retailer relationship in regards to marketing— including Amazon Ads reps, Amazon Retail team, and agency partners
Lead A+ content, brand store, and PDP execution in partnership with IHA and Digital Shelf & CRM — briefing content against Amazon spec
Manage Amazon search rank, sponsored placement, and organic ranking strategy in partnership with Growth & Demand
Own Amazon algorithm intelligence — search terms, competitive positioning, and organic performance drivers
Monitor, analyze, and report on Amazon channel performance including sell-through, ROAS, share of search, review velocity, and availability
Lead ROI analysis, campaign tracking, and competitive analysis to inform future Amazon investment decisions
Partner with Merchandising and Sales on Amazon promotional calendar and joint business planning
Escalate media investment needs and shelf issues to the appropriate CoE — pod lead coordinates, does not own headcount
Report Amazon channel KPIs (sell-through, ROAS, search rank, availability) to RMEO Lead
Support set up of new skus for 3P partners

KPIs OWNED

Amazon sell-through
Amazon share of search / share of shelf
Retailer search rank
Pod-level ROAS
Review velocity
Availability rate

Minimum Requirements

7+ years of Amazon marketplace, ecommerce, or retail media experience
Proven track record developing and executing Amazon growth strategies including Sponsored Ads and DSP
Strong understanding of Amazon algorithm, search dynamics, and PDP conversion drivers
Strong quantitative and qualitative analytical skills with fluency in Amazon reporting tools
Experience managing agency partners and cross-functional stakeholders
Strong problem-solving and communication skills with the ability to educate and influence others in the organization

Preferred Skills

Amazon Vendor Central and/or Seller Central experience
Experience with retail media planning and unified investment frameworks
You have an account owner mindset — you treat Amazon like your own business, not just a marketing channel
You are analytical, data-driven, and use performance data to drive decisions
You have excellent attention to detail, follow-through, and a strong sense of urgency for deadlines
You are a resourceful go-getter who thrives in a matrixed environment
You partner effectively with brand, creative, digital shelf, and sales teams
Understanding of A+ content, brand stores, and Amazon-specific content-to-commerce best practices

Other Requirements

Domestic travel: 10%
International travel: 0%

About The Team

Why you'll love working here:

Our employees matter. As a people-focused business, we work hard to provide meaningful rewards and development opportunities for our employees, recognizing performance, and creating a supportive working environment for them, wherever they are based.
Vibrant culture. We are committed to a diverse and rich culture, welcoming people from all walks of life. Our long-standing commitment to culture and inclusion empowers us to bring our authentic selves and unique differences to work every day.
Socially responsible. We want to minimize our products' impact on the environment and help create positive journeys worldwide. We do this by creating the best products using the most sustainable and innovative materials, methods, and models.

At Samsonite, we do more than create the bags that move with our consumer, we inspire and celebrate the moments that move them. We believe we have a responsibility to the world in how we operate, the products we sell, the communities where we live and work, and how we treat the people we employ. We're as diverse as travel itself, and like travel, your journey with Samsonite presents the opportunity to be a part of something bigger and explore your passions. This is why we offer various paths for professionals and celebrate the knowledge and skills they bring to our team. We are committed to a respectful workplace that allows our team members to bring their best selves to the workplace daily.
