Location: Remote (PST Support)

Minimum 12+ Years of Experience required.

Job Description

We are seeking an experienced Senior Data Scientist to build marketing intelligence and decision science solutions that optimize marketing spend, measure campaign effectiveness, improve pipeline attribution, and drive customer targeting. The candidate will work closely with Marketing, Data Engineering, and Data Product teams to translate ambiguous business problems into actionable recommendations, develop predictive models, and deliver production-ready analytical products that influence business decisions.

Key Responsibilities & Required Skills

Data Science & Programming:
5+ years of quantitative analysis or Data Science experience, with strong hands-on Python, SQL, and cloud data warehouse experience, preferably Snowflake. Ability to independently define analytical problems, conduct end-to-end analysis, and communicate business recommendations.
B2B Marketing Analytics:
Strong understanding of the B2B marketing funnel, including campaigns, MQLs, opportunities, closed-won business, and retention. Experience with demand generation, paid media, content syndication, account-based marketing (ABM), buying groups, and sourced versus influenced pipeline.
Marketing Technology Stack:
Experience with Salesforce, Marketo or similar marketing automation platforms, GA4, tag management, ABM and intent platforms, search intelligence tools, and advertising platforms.
Scoring & Targeting Models:
Experience developing lead scoring, weighted intent scoring, propensity models, account prioritization, buying-group detection, next-best-action logic, and customer targeting solutions.
Buyer Journey & Identity Resolution:
Ability to connect anonymous web activity to known individuals and accounts across GA4, Marketo, and Salesforce. Experience with entity matching, deterministic and probabilistic identity resolution, match-confidence assessment, and evaluating the cost of false matches.
Causal Inference & Experimentation:
Strong knowledge of experimental design, A/B testing, holdout testing, incrementality measurement, causal inference, difference-in-differences, matching, synthetic control, and uplift modeling.
Marketing Attribution & Budget Optimization:
Experience with multi-touch attribution, Marketing Mix Modeling (MMM), Bayesian methods, time-series modeling, channel-mix optimization, marketing spend allocation, and demand creation versus demand capture analysis.
Machine Learning & Statistical Modeling:
Hands-on experience with regression, regularization, classification, clustering, and tree-based models. Ability to validate models, assess uncertainty, evaluate error costs, and establish thresholds based on business outcomes.
Analytics Products & Visualization:
Experience building production-grade analytical products, dashboards, self-service tools, and scenario-planning applications that enable stakeholders to explore trade-offs and make data-driven decisions. Ability to partner with data engineering teams to integrate models into the marketing technology stack.
Privacy & Compliance:
Understanding of consent management, cookie restrictions, GDPR, and regional data privacy requirements, including EMEA, and their impact on data collection, modeling, and activation.
Stakeholder Management & Communication:
Ability to translate complex analysis into clear recommendations for marketing leaders, defend analytical methodologies to technical stakeholders, work effectively across matrixed teams, and drive adoption of recommendations.
Problem Solving & AI Tools:
Comfortable working with ambiguity, proactively identifying business opportunities, reviewing and validating analytical work produced by others or AI tools, and maintaining accountability for accuracy and business impact.

Education

Bachelor's, Master's, or PhD in Data Science, Statistics, Economics, Marketing Analytics, Mathematics, Computer Science, or a related quantitative field.

jobs.description:

Marketing
Full time
Remote (USA, Canada or South Africa)

About The Role

Blacksmith Agency runs PPC and SEO for clients across multifamily, B2B and technical verticals. As Director of Search Marketing you lead that department. The PPC strategist and the SEO strategist report to you and they are the specialists in their channels. Right now nobody owns this function, which is the whole reason this seat is open.

This is a management seat, not a senior individual contributor one.
You will not be building campaigns, and on technical SEO your strategist will know more than you do. That is the arrangement, not a gap. You carry channel strategy and where budget goes as accounts scale. The strategists carry the execution of it, and you carry whether the department delivers.

What You Own

The PPC strategist and the SEO strategist: their quality bar, their development, their reviews, and the call when someone is not going to get there.
The standard the work is held to. What a good audit looks like, what gets checked before work leaves the agency, how an account is reported. You write it and you hold two specialists to it.
Client results across the whole function, including whether our reporting is honest. Nobody here is auditing attribution and GA4 accuracy today.
The escalation when an account is at risk. You diagnose it, you direct the strategist who fixes it, and you are on the call with the client.
Channel strategy and where budget goes as accounts scale.
What we tell sales we can credibly deliver, before it gets sold.
The hiring plan for the department, and first-round interviews for your own team, within about a quarter.

What You Need

Strategists or specialists who have reported to you, where their reviews, their development and the decision when someone was not working out were yours. Managing accounts is not this.
7+ years across paid media and SEO. Owning one channel while sitting beside the other does not count here.
Enough depth in Google Ads, GA4, Search Console, Meta and Microsoft Ads to tell good work from work that merely looks good. That is a lower bar than doing it and a higher bar than reading a report.
One account you turned around that you can talk through: the metric, the figure before, the figure after, and why the change worked. Whose hands were on the keyboard matters far less than whether the diagnosis was yours.
Comfortable being the client-facing owner when an account is underperforming. That call comes to you, not to the strategist.
Agency experience carrying many accounts at once.

Please do not apply if

Nobody has ever reported to you, or you have never owned someone's review or had to performance-manage anyone.
You have only ever run one channel.
All of your experience is in-house on a single brand.
What you actually want is to keep building campaigns yourself. That is not a lesser ambition, it is a different job, and this is not it.

None of these are preferences we bend on. They are how we screen, so applying anyway costs you an hour and gets you a no.

Process

Three conversations, then a decision. A thirty minute screen with our recruiter, a first round with the founder this seat reports to, and a final. No take-home project and no panel interview.

Four fields at the link, then a short 6 minute Predictive Index assessment. Use the same email throughout. No cover letter.

Black & Veatch allows you to lend your talent and perspective to humanity’s biggest challenges in a flexible environment where you are empowered to grow and explore new possibilities. We offer competitive compensation, 401k match and benefits that start day one.

Our hybrid environment allows you to balance your work and personal life. At Black & Veatch, you own your career with purpose and meaning. Bring your big ideas knowing you are safe to be who you are and speak up with concerns or questions and put your diverse talents and perspectives to use.

The Opportunity

The Head of Marketing for the Black & Veatch Infrastructure Advisory
business is responsible for creating and executing the commercial, business and marketing strategy to support the company’s growing consulting and managed services organization. As a member of the Infrastructure Advisory Leadership Team, this role is responsible for building awareness of Infrastructure Advisory and its myriad capabilities across all market segments and geographies that Black & Veatch serves. Thus, the Head of Marketing must have a track record of building management consulting and managed services businesses for critical infrastructure and energy. The right candidate will have a strong background in strategy and business planning to help identify, prioritize and develop profitable service areas for near horizon growth while nurturing new market opportunities for later horizons.

Infrastructure Advisory professionals come from a wide variety of industry executive roles and have high expectations of marketing partnership and support. This role will have a hunger to learn and understand Infrastructure Advisory services and competencies to advise the team well and drive pipeline quickly. The professional will have deep experience working in large, matrix organizations as an advocate for a growing and entrepreneurial business, be adept at working with partners and ecosystem players, and have consummate collaboration skills to integrate campaigns with sector Heads of Marketing for the clients and audiences they serve.

The Head of Marketing for Infrastructure Advisory reports to the Chief Marketing Officer for Black & Veatch and is part of the company’s Marketing Leadership Team and highly collaborative with sales and market leadership. The role is based out of the Black & Veatch world headquarters in the Kansas City area, specifically Overland Park, Kansas. It is a player-coach role intended to both lead and execute strategic marketing initiatives supporting the growth strategies of Infrastructure Advisory consulting and managed services practices. From an industry perspective, an ideal candidate would have experience building industry awareness, client demand, partnerships and client relationships for professional and managed services within several of the following target client segments: power providers including power utilities, energy developers, integrated energy/oil/energy majors, water utilities, industrial manufacturers, and data center ecosystem players including developers and co-locators.

This role requires deep marketing consultation across a variety of executive stakeholders, significant presence in working with senior leadership, autonomy and initiative in researching and creatively marketing solutions and services, and heavy collaboration across marketing and sales partners in the US and around the world. The primary market segments for the Black & Veatch Infrastructure Advisory business span power providers, energy majors and developers, mining customers, water utilities, the data center ecosystem, industrial manufacturing and commercial clients, federal clients and public agencies and utilities. Practice areas include but are not limited to: Strategy, Sustainability, Planning & Optimization; AI, Digital & Program Excellent; Asset Management and O&M; Operational Technology including Cybersecurity; Transactions & M&A; and Infrastructure Technology. The role requires a high level of business acumen to understand the P&L of businesses across Black & Veatch and the drivers of business model types generating short- and long-term revenue for the company.

Key Responsibilities

The Head of Marketing will create and advise commercial and market strategy across Black & Veatch Infrastructure Advisory teams, some of whom serve existing markets and clients of the company, while others are serving new markets and new customer groups. The organization has formidable growth targets, and the Head of Marketing is responsible for bridging between Infrastructure Advisory teams and market and geography teams to create and execute marketing campaigns, shaping perception of the maturity of the Black & Veatch Infrastructure Advisory organization, driving demand, lead capture and accelerating funnel, and nurturing client relationships through creative and poignant client engagement.

Other responsibilities:

Building and advancing business relationships within Infrastructure Advisory including the President and leadership teams, solution and market teams, as well as key relationships with market segment Presidents and leadership teams throughout Black & Veatch to build value propositions and campaigns to cross-sell services.
Market research and understanding of target segments, organization types, buyer and influencer types and engagement opportunities. Responsible for understanding the current and emerging competitive landscape across market segments and buyer groups for Infrastructure Advisory.
Strategic marketing planning, campaign strategy, demand strategy, performance marketing, budget management and execution across global stakeholder groups.
Defining customer decisions journeys for services areas with sales and engagement touchpoints across the buyer cycle. The role will work closely with sales, client relationship and pursuit teams to provide campaigns and tools that support the sales and lifecycle processes.
Creating and testing messaging that resonates with audiences across the segments, subsegments and buyer groups targeted with Infrastructure Advisory services, and message consistency across all platforms and channels, including digital, print, and in-person communications.
Paid media strategies, tactics and measurements to monitor and adjust campaigns, promotions and spend as part of performance marketing cycles.
Outcomes-driven demand generation and funnel-building campaigns to build awareness of Black & Veatch Infrastructure Advisory business and its portfolios.
In-person and virtual events including industry trade and Black and Veatch hosted events supporting sales, client relationships, research and industry relations.
Presence and integration of Infrastructure Advisory services across the digital landscape with stakeholders including the full client lifecycle.
Keen understanding of sales and marketing metrics and ability to set and track KPIs throughout marketing performance lifecycles and make agile adjustments for continuous performance improvement.
Leading a small team of direct reports and a much larger team of influential functional and commercial partners in collaboration and execution.
Developing relationships and collaborating with marketing, business and regional teams, searching for win-wins to grow Infrastructure Advisory as part of segment value propositions.
Collaborating with marketing leaders and peers to build and execute marketing programs from start to finish, building consensus with stakeholder groups and strong internal communications networks with sales teams and account executives across the company.
Infrastructure Advisory portfolio positioning across applicable global markets including collaborating with regional sales and marketing leaders on regional/country-specific marketing plans.

Preferred Qualifications

Proven record of building businesses and providing commercial support to grow new and current customer relationships within a matrix consulting organization.
Experience working with infrastructure and energy solutions.
Strong skills in writing in various mediums, message development, story and presentation development.
Full strategic marketing planning and execution skill set.
Technical aptitude to translate highly technical offerings into value propositions and content for targeted audiences.
Strong project management, budgeting and measurement skills.
Experience marketing professional and managed services as well as technical solutions.
Minimum of 15 years of strategic marketing experience in B2B including strong digital marketing and demand generation experience.
Bachelor's degree in marketing, marketing communications, business marketing or related field. Master’s degree preferred.
Experience as a head of marketing in a matrix consulting organization with responsibilities across marketing domains supporting business sales, solution sales and regional account teams required.
Advanced marketing communications skills include writing, presenting and speaking including courageous and polished strategy pitches to senior leadership.
Advanced personal skills in excel required as well as analytics/data analysis skills.
Previous successful experience in customer segmentation, analytics and campaigns leveraging MarTech and SalesTech systems such as Sales Force. Successful experience and ability to design and execute complex marketing campaign management across digital channels for client and prospect segments.
Experience in partner and ecosystem marketing as well as client marketing including collaboration with marketing and sales executives on client value/story promotions and marketing tactics.
Deep experience in demand generation includes building prospect and current customer engagement across traditional and new mediums including content strategy and architecture by organization type and role, outbound communications to clients and bi-directional client insight/experience loops to improve client satisfaction.
Requires aptitude and discipline to autonomously research, explore, learn and understand the lifecycles of highly technical solutions and services.
Experience building industry partner and sponsor relationships, developing creative new ways to reach key audiences with sponsor organizations and planning and executing virtual and in-person executive events.

jobs.description:
Coupa makes margins multiply through its community-generated AI and industry-leading total spend management platform for businesses large and small. Coupa AI is informed by trillions of dollars of direct and indirect spend data across a global network of 10M+ buyers and suppliers. We empower you with the ability to predict, prescribe, and automate smarter, more profitable business decisions to improve operating margins.

Why join Coupa?

Pioneering Technology: At Coupa, we're at the forefront of innovation, leveraging the latest technology to empower our customers with greater efficiency and visibility in their spend
Collaborative Culture: We value collaboration and teamwork, and our culture is driven by transparency, openness, and a shared commitment to excellence
Global Impact: Join a company where your work has a global, measurable impact on our clients, the business, and each other.

Learn more on Life at Coupa blog and hear from our employees about their experiences working at Coupa.

The Impact of a Demand Generation Director at Coupa:

The Demand Generation Director is accountable for the integrated demand strategy and its execution across the Americas. The position owns the regional demand process end to end, including demand planning, sales play and outreach cadence design, pipeline health, and lead-to-deal conversion, and sets the foundation for how demand is generated and progressed in the Americas.

The position is the primary point of coordination between Sales, Marketing, Alliances, Advisory Services and Revenue Operations for demand matters in the Americas. It chairs the regional Demand Board, holds the integrated demand plan, and is accountable for the pipeline health and conversion outcomes that result. This is an individual contributor position that operates through influence across the demand ecosystem rather than through direct authority.

What You'll Do:

Demand strategy and planning

Leads the regional demand process, including planning, coordination and analysis, and is accountable for the integrated demand plan for the Americas
Develops integrated demand strategies that align marketing, sales and partner activity to regional pipeline and revenue objectives
Sets the demand planning calendar and the inputs required from each contributing function, and holds those functions to the agreed plan
Determines where demand investment is directed by segment, solution and route to market, and recommends reallocation where performance requires it

Demand execution and sales plays

Designs tactical sales plays and outreach cadences tailored to specific target audiences and aligned to business priorities, in partnership with Sales, Marketing and Sales Enablement
Accountable for the execution of the demand plan in the Americas, including sequencing, coverage of priority accounts and segments, and completion against the agreed calendar
Partners with the Revenue Systems directors on the platforms and configuration that support demand motions, including prospecting and contact data, sales engagement and cadence management, and submits requirements through the established intake process

jobs.description:
The Opportunity

We’re looking for a mission-driven growth marketer to become our hands-on owner of the paid search channel. Paid search is currently the largest of our digital paid media channels and a significant driver of enrollments, so your work directly ties to furthering Hinge Health’s mission to improve the lives of people suffering from chronic conditions.

You’ll join the paid media pod, the fastest-growing group of channels on the Growth team, with real autonomy to decide what the work is and how it gets done. As we launch new products, you’ll build the keyword strategy that takes Hinge Health into new categories and puts our care in front of more people who need it. The right candidate wants to go deep on one channel and loves working on both strategy and the details.

What You’ll Accomplish

Own paid search end to end: Build, launch, and manage campaigns across Google Ads and Microsoft Advertising, covering branded and non-branded search, Performance Max, and related formats.
Shape the channel strategy: Translate insights from new product launches, audience research, and company goals into channel strategy and experimentation roadmap.
Turn data into experiments: Find insights in the numbers and use them to design tests on messaging, ad formats, and other ad features.
Build optimized workflows: Create the playbooks, reporting, and automation, including AI-assisted workflows, that help the channel run smoothly, and accelerate test and learn cycles.
Own channel reporting: Create regular performance reporting on pacing, efficiency, and test results, and translate results into clear next steps.
Manage the platform relationship: Serve as our point of contact with Google account representatives, staying current on new features, betas, and policy changes that help us scale.
Collaborate cross-functionally: Work with the creative team on developing ad creative, with Data Science on tracking and measurement, and with the broader Growth team on how paid search fits into the overall acquisition strategy.

Who You Are

An owner of the channel: You own paid search end to end from the idea through strategy, execution, and optimization.
A data-driven experimenter: You dig into the data to find an insight, then design an experiment around it. You’re driven by curiosity and love to see which experiments work.
A detail-minded strategist: You are meticulous, and you own your numbers. You can also step back from the account and think about where the channel as a whole should go.
A Learn-it-all: You are always willing to learn and improve, whether that’s a new Google Ads feature, a new ad platform, or a better way to run your own week.
A mission-driven marketer: You care about making quality care easier to get, and you want your work tied to that.

Basic Qualifications

3+ years of experience managing paid search campaigns, including hands-on Google Ads work managing bid settings, determining campaign structure, and conducting keyword research.
Proven track record of managing meaningful budgets and hitting acquisition growth and efficiency goals
Experience using Mode, Mixpanel, Google Analytics or similar tools to build reports and analyze performance

Preferred Qualifications

Proven success managing a large paid search program, with budgets of at least $3 million annually
Demonstrated use of Claude Code, Codex, or similar tools to build workflows that support campaign strategy and execution
Working knowledge of SEO and AEO and how they intersect with paid search
Experience running structured tests on ad copy, landing pages, and other campaign settings and translating results into action
Hands-on Microsoft Advertising campaign management
A track record of testing emerging ad formats, including ChatGPT Ads
Background in healthcare or another regulated industry

Hinge Health Hybrid Model

This is a hybrid role based in the San Francisco office, requiring in-person attendance three days per week for a full 8-hour business day. On remote days, employees are expected to work during core business hours with flexibility. The office is part of a dog-friendly workplace program, and while travel is not regularly required, occasional off-site/on-site events may occur. Physical demands are minimal and primarily involve standard office activities such as sitting, typing, and video conferencing.

About Hinge Health

At Hinge Health, we’re using technology to scale and automate the delivery of healthcare, starting with musculoskeletal (MSK) conditions, which affect over 1.7 billion people worldwide. Our AI-powered, human-centered care model spans MSK, pelvic health, gastrointestinal (GI) and migraine care. With over 60 partnerships with health plans, PBMs and other ecosystem partners, Hinge Health is available to over 25 million people across more than 2,900 employers. The company is headquartered in San Francisco with additional offices in Montreal and Bangalore. Learn more at hingehealth.com.

jobs.title: Growth Marketing Lead
jobs.description:
ClassDojo's goal is to give every child on Earth an education they love.

We started by building a powerful network for communication. ClassDojo’s flagship app is the #1 communication app connecting K-12 teachers, children, and families globally. Teachers use it to share what’s happening throughout the day through photos, videos, and messages that make parents feel like they’re there. It’s actively used in over 95% of US schools, reaching over 45 million children in 180 countries, with a team of just around 200 people [1]. We are now beginning to use this network to give kids the best learning experiences in the world, far beyond those a standard school can provide.

We hire for talent density. Our team comprises the most talented, entrepreneurial, and innovative teammates from around the world, with experience in education and large scale consumer internet companies, including Instagram, Netflix, Dropbox, Stripe, Uber, Y Combinator, and more. We’re building a company where the most talented people want to work. We believe you’ll do the best work of your life here—and you’ll pioneer the future of education, too.

What You’ll Do

As Growth Marketing Lead, you’ll own how ClassDojo reaches new families beyond our existing network. For two exciting consumer products: Dojo Sparks, and Dojo Islands. Both products have grown fast, with Islands reaching millions of kids every month. You’ll set the strategy and personally execute on high-leverage acquisition experiments—building, testing, and scaling channels that drive net-new paid users for our consumer products.

This is a high-impact, high-autonomy, IC-first role. You’ll operate like a one-person growth marketing team initially: setting direction, running experiments end to end, analyzing results, and scaling what works. Over time, you’ll help build the systems, processes, and partnerships that allow growth to compound efficiently.

You’ll partner closely with Product, Creative, Data, and Marketing leaders, and work alongside another growth leader focused on internal ClassDojo network growth. Your mandate is external acquisition—finding repeatable ways to reach and convert families who don’t yet know ClassDojo.

This role requires a builder’s mindset: someone who thrives in ambiguity, moves quickly without perfect resources, and uses strong judgment and data to decide where to double down.

You Will

Set and own the strategy for new user acquisition across paid and unpaid channels, with an early focus on social and influencer partnerships
Personally run growth experiments end to end—defining hypotheses, launching tests, analyzing results, and making scale/kill decisions
Identify and validate new acquisition channels through scrappy, manual approaches first, then scale successful bets via agencies, tooling, and automation
Establish clear success metrics and ROI thresholds to guide investment and prioritization
Partner closely with Product and Creative and Product Marketing to test value propositions, landing experiences, and onboarding flows that improve conversion
Build a durable experimentation and measurement framework that enables fast iteration across messaging, targeting, and funnel steps
Leverage external resources and modern tools (including AI) to maximize impact without overbuilding internal teams
Help shape the long-term growth marketing muscle at ClassDojo, with potential to take on people leadership as impact is proven

You Will Be a Match If

8+ years of experience in growth, performance, or consumer marketing, ideally at high-growth consumer or marketplace companies
A proven track record of owning acquisition outcomes end to end—not just managing a single channel
Strong analytical judgment and comfort using data to evaluate ROI, conversion, and growth tradeoffs
Experience operating as a generalist in small or mid-sized teams (e.g., 30–150 people) where you “owned the whole thing”
Depth in at least one acquisition channel (e.g., paid social, influencer, partnerships, SEO, SEM), with strong mental models across others
A hands-on, execution-oriented mindset: you balance strategy with a willingness to roll up your sleeves and drive details
Comfort operating with high autonomy and ambiguity—able to self-direct and prioritize without heavy process
Clear, concise communication skills and the ability to partner effectively across Product, Creative, and Data

You Might Be a Good Fit If

You’ve built or scaled influencer- or creator-led growth programs
You’ve worked on consumer subscription or paid consumer products
You’ve operated in early-stage or fast-scaling environments as a builder or first marketing hire
You’re excited about using AI and new tools to move faster and experiment more effectively
You care deeply about product quality and long-term, sustainable growth—not just short-term wins

Use AI tools to accelerate research and copy development while maintaining quality and strategic judgment

Requirements

Job Description

Eurofins is seeking a Marketing Communications Manager - Medical Devices
to lead the development and execution of strategic marketing programs that support the growth of our Medical Device Testing and Consulting business.

This role will drive integrated marketing initiatives that increase brand awareness, generate qualified leads, and position Eurofins as a trusted partner for medical device manufacturers. Reporting to the Marketing Director, this position will collaborate closely with business leaders, technical subject matter experts, sales teams, regulatory consultants, and external agencies to deliver measurable business impact.

Develop and execute integrated marketing campaigns that support Medical Device Testing and Consulting services.
Create compelling content for websites, email campaigns, case studies, webinars, sales materials, presentations, and social media.
Translate complex scientific, testing, and regulatory information into clear, customer-focused messaging.
Partner with technical experts and business leaders to develop thought leadership and industry-focused content.
Manage demand generation programs, lead nurturing activities, and marketing automation initiatives.
Collaborate with sales teams to improve lead quality, conversion rates, and pipeline growth.
Track and analyze campaign performance, providing recommendations to improve engagement and ROI.
Support medical device industry trade shows, conferences, webinars, and customer events.
Coordinate agency partners, project timelines, budgets, and marketing deliverables.
Maintain brand consistency across all customer-facing communications and marketing materials.
Monitor industry trends, competitive activity, and market opportunities within the medical device sector.

8-10 years of marketing communications experience in medical devices, healthcare, life sciences, laboratory services, or another regulated B2B industry.
Proven success developing campaigns that drive brand awareness, lead generation, and business growth.
Strong understanding of medical device markets and customer needs.
Skilled at translating technical concepts into clear, compelling marketing messages.
Able to influence cross-functional teams and manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.

Education & Experience

Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Communications, Business, Life Sciences, or a related field.
8-10 years of experience in marketing communications, demand generation, content marketing, or related B2B marketing roles.
Experience supporting medical device, diagnostics, laboratory, CRO/CDMO, or healthcare organizations preferred.
Proficiency with CRM platforms, marketing automation tools, and marketing analytics.
Experience managing agencies, budgets, vendors, and marketing projects.

Experience marketing testing, consulting, compliance, regulatory, or laboratory services.
Knowledge of biocompatibility, microbiology, chemistry testing, packaging validation, sterility assurance, E&L, or quality and regulatory compliance.

Join our innovative product marketing team.

Partner with the best

Running developer and technical programs end to end, including podcasts, webinars, livestreams, workshops, and onboarding sessions
Turning DevRel content and expertise into repeatable programs that support Cloud and Security launches and campaigns
Supporting SLG with field events and customer briefings for target accounts, and PLG with programs that drive sign-ups
Leading Akamai's developer and open source presence across KubeCon, the CNCF, The Linux Foundation, and projects like Spin
Managing the budget, vendors, sponsorships, and ROI of each program, and reporting outcomes back to stakeholders
Owning the developer program calendar with DevRel and product marketing, scaling what works and retiring what doesn't

Do What You Love

To be successful in this role you will:

Have 8 years of relevant experience in developer, community, or program marketing and a degree in Marketing, another related field or its equivalent
Have experience running recurring developer, member, or customer programs such as webinars, livestreams, and newsletters at scale
Have supported sales-led teams through field events, sponsorships, and customer briefings, managing budgets, vendors, and ROI
Have partnered closely with DevRel teams to turn developer content into repeatable programs
Excel at written communication and making technical topics accessible to developers and buyers

At Akamai, we make life better for billions of people, trillions of times a day.

Whether you're streaming live events, scrolling social media, watching your favorite series, or managing your savings, we're the engine behind the scenes. We provide the world's most distributed platform from Cloud to Edge to help the giants of the digital world work faster and stay more secure, making the internet a better experience for everyone.

Our Focus Is Simple

Cloud and Edge:
Running apps closer to users for instant performance.

Security
: Neutralizing threats before they ever reach your data.

Content Delivery
: Scaling the world's biggest moments without a glitch.

AI
: Enabling our customers to build, secure, and scale AI apps on the world's most distributed cloud platform.

At Akamai, we don't just support the internet; we power and protect it, because behind every great digital experience is a massive hidden challenge. And we're the ones who solve it. When millions of people hit play or pay, Akamai ensures it just works.

Benefits at Akamai:
We support your health, well-being, finances, and life beyond work. See our benefits.

FlexBase adapts to your job's needs

Akamai's FlexBase program is yet another way we show our commitment to providing employees with an exceptional workplace experience. It's not about telling employees where to work; it's about supporting employees to do their best work.

We trust our incredible employees to work in ways that suit them best: at home, in an office, or a combination of both.

Connect with us on social and see what life at Akamai is like!

Akamai is committed to fair and equitable compensation practices. The Sr. Marketing Manager is responsible for translating brand, ownership, operator, and commercial priorities into a cohesive, integrated property marketing plan and ensuring disciplined execution across internal teams and external agency partners.

The right person can move comfortably from a revenue meeting to a creative review, from developing a Denver partnership to evaluating campaign performance. You’ll be responsible for protecting what makes Populus distinctive while contributing to new ways to turn that distinction into awareness, demand, loyalty, and revenue.

About Populus

Populus is the first carbon positive hotel in the United States, created around the belief that hospitality can be both exceptional and environmentally responsible.

Inspired by Colorado’s aspen groves, its architecture, interiors, restaurants, programming, and approach to hospitality are designed as parts of one interconnected ecosystem. Located at Civic Center Park in the heart of Denver, Populus is not a retreat from the city, but an active participant in it.

Guests come for the architecture and design. They discover Pasque, Stellar Jay, and Little Owl. And increasingly, Populus has become a gathering place for people interested in food, art, design, sustainability, culture, and the future of cities.

The Sr. Marketing Manager will help shape how Denver, our guests, and the broader hospitality industry experience that story while remaining accountable to the business behind it: occupancy, direct bookings, F&B performance, event demand, brand awareness, and return on marketing investment.

What You’ll Own

Marketing Strategy & Commercial Performance

Own the day-to-day execution of the property’s annual marketing strategy, calendar, and budget against revenue, occupancy, F&B, and ownership objectives. Manage marketing performance to approved budgets, including ongoing forecasting, invoice and spend oversight, variance management, and recommendations to reallocate investment based on business needs and demonstrated performance.
Partner closely with Revenue Management and Sales to identify need periods, demand opportunities, offers, and campaigns across rooms, restaurants, bars, and events.
Track marketing performance and translate results into clear recommendations, identifying what is working, what is not, and where investment should shift.
Establish and monitor clear KPIs across paid, owned, earned, CRM, social, partnerships, programming, rooms, and F&B marketing, connecting marketing activity to measurable commercial outcomes and return on investment.
Manage agency coordination and vendor relationships, ensuring scopes, budgets, timelines, and deliverables remain accountable to business objectives.
Lead and hold accountable external advertising, media, digital, PR, social, creative, and other specialty agency partners as applicable, providing clear briefs and direction, evaluating recommendations and work product, monitoring performance against scope and budget, and ensuring agency activity is integrated against property and ownership priorities.
Prepare marketing updates, reporting, and recommendations for hotel leadership, Crescent, and ownership. Brand, Creative & Storytelling
Serve as a day-to-day steward of the Populus brand, ensuring every expression of the property feels intentional, distinctive, and unmistakably Populus.
Guide creative execution across photography, video, social, email, digital, collateral, partnerships, programming, and campaigns.
Build and manage the property’s content calendar, identifying the stories, people, experiences, and cultural moments worth amplifying.
Partner with PR, social, digital, and creative agencies to turn those stories into meaningful earned, owned, and paid exposure.
Identify opportunities for Populus to participate in larger conversations around hospitality, architecture, food, sustainability, design, and Denver culture. Programming, Partnerships & Community
Help develop signature programming and activations that give people a reason to visit Populus beyond an overnight stay.
Partner closely with the Environmental Stewardship Team to translate the hotel’s environmental commitments into tangible guest experiences and compelling storytelling.
Build meaningful relationships with Denver’s artists, chefs, farmers, makers, nonprofits, cultural organizations, businesses, and civic community.
Develop partnership opportunities that increase relevance and reach to support rooms, F&B, events, community engagement, and earned media. Collaboration & Leadership
Serve as a connective tissue between departments, bringing marketing into operational conversations early, ensuring important property moments have the strategy, creative support, and lead time necessary to succeed.
Serve as the primary on-property marketing partner to Urban Villages’ Denver-based ownership marketing team, maintaining consistent communication and visibility into property priorities, performance, campaigns, programming, agency activity, budgets, and emerging opportunities. Ensure property-level execution remains aligned with the broader Populus brand strategy, standards, and portfolio priorities established by ownership.
Balance long-term brand building with the immediate commercial needs of a working hotel.
Manage, coach, and develop direct reports as the property marketing team evolves, establishing clear priorities, accountability, performance expectations, and professional development opportunities while building a high-performing and collaborative marketing function.
Effectively navigate the owner/operator relationship, understanding when decisions sit with property leadership, Crescent, or ownership and proactively bringing the appropriate stakeholders into planning and decision-making.

What Makes You Successful

You’re equally comfortable in a budget review and a creative review.

You understand that a great hotel brand is built through hundreds of decisions, not a campaign alone. You have a point of view on design, culture, hospitality, and storytelling, but you’re just as interested in whether the work drove bookings, covers, traffic, or revenue.

You’ve helped build, launch, or evolve something rather than simply maintaining a playbook someone else handed you.

You’re curious about Denver and want to participate in the city rather than market to it from the sidelines.

You care about sustainability because you believe business can be a force for something better, and you understand that credibility comes from substance rather than claims.

Most importantly, you know how to bring people together. You collaborate, ask good questions, give clear direction, and understand when to lead from the front and when to make someone else’s idea better.

THE POPULUS WAY

Rooted in Nature:
We draw inspiration from nature's resilience, stewardship, balance, and long-term thinking.

Generous:
We create value by giving back—to our guests, associates, community, and environment.

Curious:
We embrace creativity, innovation, continuous learning, and thoughtful collaboration.

Brave:
We lead with integrity, accountability, transparency, and the courage to challenge convention.

QUALIFICATIONS

Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Communications, Business, Hospitality, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.
7+ years of progressive marketing experience within lifestyle hospitality, luxury, travel, design, food and beverage, or culturally relevant consumer brands.
Demonstrated experience connecting brand and creative work to measurable commercial outcomes.
Experience managing marketing budgets, agencies, vendors, timelines, and cross-functional initiatives.
Strong working knowledge of digital marketing, social media, CRM/email, PR, content, paid media, and performance reporting.
Strong creative judgment with the ability to evaluate photography, copy, design, campaigns, partnerships, and brand experiences.
Ability to operate independently while collaborating effectively across property, corporate, ownership, and agency teams.
Genuine curiosity about sustainability, design, food and beverage, culture, and community.

Required

Demonstrated experience leading integrated marketing plans across multiple channels and business lines, ideally including hotel rooms, F&B, events, and local-market programming.

Demonstrated experience managing external advertising and marketing agencies, including briefing, scope management, creative evaluation, budget oversight, performance measurement, and accountability for results.

Demonstrated experience owning and managing meaningful marketing budgets, including forecasting, pacing, reconciliation, performance analysis, and investment optimization.

Prior people-management experience, including direct responsibility for coaching, developing, prioritizing work, and managing the performance of direct reports..

Come join the company at the center of how the world adopts AI securely. Cyera’s mission is to give enterprises the confidence to embrace AI safely — deciding exactly what it can see and do as it reaches deeper into the business. We started by solving the hardest problem in data security: finding and securing data faster and more precisely than anyone thought possible. That foundation is now the essential AI trust infrastructure for the Fortune 1000. We’re hiring mission-driven talent to put those leaders at the center of our story.

Cyera is building the next generation of AI and data security. Our platform empowers security teams to manage and protect all of their company’s sensitive data. As AI agents and non-human identities reshape the threat landscape, original security research has become one of the most credible ways to earn trust with security leaders. To power our next phase of growth, we are looking for a Senior Product Marketing Manager, AI Threat Research to turn Cyera’s data, AI, and identity security expertise into a research-led marketing engine. You will partner with our researchers and product teams to uncover, package, and publish original threat research that builds Cyera’s authority in the market and drives pipeline.
This position is 100% from anywhere in the US, eastern time zone strongly preferred.

Build and run a threat research publishing program, including AI security research, threat reports, vulnerability disclosures, and data-driven industry findings
Partner with Cyera’s researchers, Product, and Data Science to identify compelling research angles and translate technical findings into clear, credible narratives for security practitioners and executives
Create and manage the full research content portfolio: blogs, technical write-ups, flagship reports, briefs, webinars, and conference talks

Drive launch and amplification of research across media, analyst, social, and community channels, building relationships with security press and industry influencers
Track and report on research impact, including share of voice, media and analyst pickup, engagement, and influenced pipeline

Serve as a market-facing subject matter expert and thought leader for Cyera

Demonstrated ability to translate deeply technical research into compelling content for both technical and executive audiences

Working knowledge of the threat landscape, including AI and LLM security risks, data exposure, and identity-based threats
Experience launching research through PR, analyst relations, and owned channels

Exceptional communication and collaboration skills

Experience working directly with security researchers or a threat intelligence team
Familiarity with vulnerability disclosure and responsible publication practices
Background in a technical security role

ClassWallet's suite of products and services empowers agency administrators to dramatically increase efficiency of funds distribution and spend compliance, reduce programmatic costs, maximize the full potential impact of the program, and satisfy the needs and expectations of policymakers, constituents and public reporting. In its 11+ years in operation, ClassWallet has completed over 12M transactions, funded 1.1M recipients, processed over 5M applications, and now serves 300+ state and local agency clients, supported by a team of 280+ full-time staff.

The Company has developed an industry-defining digital wallet solution which has gained rapid traction among state and local agencies and school districts across America. ClassWallet ranks as the 61st fastest growing software company on the prestigious Inc. 5000 list of fastest-growing private companies and the 21st fastest growing financial technology company on the Deloitte Technology Fast 500 in 2023.

While the Company delivers immense business value, the social impact of ClassWallet is a fabric that runs through its mission and corporate culture. jobs.title: Manager, Product Marketing
jobs.description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, which manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Manager, Product Marketing based in the United States.

The Manager, Product Marketing will play a pivotal role in shaping and executing go-to-market strategies for enterprise B2B SaaS solutions within the digital supply chain technology sector. You will drive product positioning, messaging, launches, and promotional initiatives that strengthen market differentiation and accelerate business growth. Working closely with product, sales, and marketing teams, you will translate complex technology capabilities into compelling value propositions that resonate with enterprise buyers. Through customer research, competitive intelligence, and market analysis, you will identify opportunities to refine target audiences, optimize product packaging, and improve commercial performance. You will also equip sales teams with the resources and insights they need to increase pipeline generation, deal velocity, and conversion rates. This remote opportunity is ideal for a strategic, customer-focused marketing professional who thrives in a collaborative, fast-paced environment and is passionate about transforming supply chain operations through technology.

Accountabilities

Go-to-Market Strategy and Execution: Develop and execute comprehensive go-to-market strategies, product positioning, messaging, packaging, and promotional plans across a portfolio of enterprise SaaS solutions. Partner with sales and marketing leaders to refine ideal customer profiles (ICPs), establish quarterly growth priorities, and align initiatives with broader business objectives.
Product Launches and Portfolio Management: Lead end-to-end product launch planning, coordination, and execution, collaborating with cross-functional teams to ensure successful releases, effective market communication, and strong customer adoption across multiple products.
Market Research and Competitive Intelligence: Conduct customer research, analyze industry trends, and evaluate the competitive landscape to identify market opportunities, strengthen differentiation, and inform product marketing priorities, packaging decisions, and campaign strategies.
Sales Enablement and Revenue Growth: Develop and deliver sales enablement materials, competitive positioning tools, and practical resources that help sales teams communicate product value, accelerate sales cycles, improve win rates, and drive pipeline and revenue growth.
Customer-Centric Messaging and Content Development: Collaborate with content and marketing teams to create compelling marketing assets, including case studies, product videos, whitepapers, blog posts, and solution-focused materials. Translate complex technical concepts into clear, persuasive messaging tailored to different buyer personas and stages of the purchasing journey.
Cross-Functional Collaboration: Build strong working relationships with product management, sales, and marketing stakeholders to ensure consistent messaging, coordinated execution, and alignment between customer needs, product capabilities, and commercial objectives.
Performance Measurement and Optimization: Track and analyze product marketing KPIs to evaluate campaign effectiveness, product adoption, pipeline contribution, and business impact. Use performance insights to refine go-to-market strategies and continuously improve results.
Security and Data Responsibility: Follow established security best practices and maintain the confidentiality, integrity, availability, and privacy of company systems, work devices, communications, and customer data.

Requirements

Professional Experience: At least five years of product marketing experience within an enterprise B2B SaaS environment, ideally focused on supply chain management, supply chain execution, or supply chain planning solutions. Experience with demand-based planning is particularly valuable.
Product Marketing and Go-to-Market Expertise: A demonstrated track record of launching and managing a multi-product portfolio, developing effective go-to-market strategies, and contributing to measurable pipeline growth and commercial success.
Market Research and Competitive Positioning: Proven experience conducting customer and market research, analyzing competitors, identifying market opportunities, and developing differentiated product positioning that addresses enterprise customer needs.
Supply Chain and Technology Knowledge: A strong understanding of enterprise buyer requirements, supply chain technology market dynamics, and the SAP ecosystem. The ability to understand complex business processes and communicate the value of technology-driven supply chain solutions is essential.
Messaging and Communication Skills: Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to transform complex technical concepts into clear, compelling value propositions tailored to distinct customer personas and stakeholders throughout the buying journey.
Sales Enablement and Commercial Acumen: Experience developing sales tools, competitive intelligence resources, and product marketing content that supports sales effectiveness, improves conversion rates, and strengthens revenue performance.
Project Management and Organization: Strong project management skills, with the ability to coordinate cross-functional initiatives, manage multiple priorities simultaneously, and deliver high-quality work within competing deadlines.
Education: A bachelor's degree in Marketing, Business, or a related field is preferred. An MBA is considered an advantage.
Collaboration and Personal Attributes: A curious, accountable, and customer-focused mindset, combined with integrity, initiative, and enthusiasm for solving complex business challenges. The ability to work effectively with diverse teams and adapt to evolving market needs is important.
Location and Work Arrangement: This is a remote position within the United States. Candidates based in the Eastern or Central time zones are preferred.

Benefits

Flexible work arrangements: The opportunity to work remotely from a location within the United States.
Healthcare coverage: Access to health insurance options to support your well-being.
Voluntary insurance: Additional voluntary insurance options to help meet individual needs.
Paid time off and holidays: Paid leave and holiday benefits to support rest, personal commitments, and work-life balance.
Retirement savings: Access to a retirement savings program to help you plan for the future.
Bonus programs: Eligibility for bonus programs as part of the overall employee rewards offering.
Inclusive parental leave: Parental leave policies designed to support parents and caregivers.
Wellness and mental health: Initiatives and resources focused on employee well-being and mental health.
Employee engagement: Quarterly employee events that encourage connection, collaboration, and team spirit.
Employee referral program: A generous referral program that recognizes employees who help attract talented professionals.
Collaborative culture: An engaging work environment built around curiosity, integrity, accountability, and a shared commitment to delivering meaningful customer value.
Professional impact: The opportunity to contribute to digital supply chain innovation, shape enterprise marketing strategies, and support the growth of technology solutions used across global manufacturing and supply chain networks.

jobs.title: Social Media Manager
jobs.description:
I'm hiring a Social Media & Content Manager to join my team 🎯

I'm looking for someone to take real ownership of my content and social strategy. Someone who is not just executing posts, but understanding my audience deeply and running the engine that turns content into growth. This is a hands-on role for someone who wants to build something with me, not just manage a calendar.

What you'll own

Weekly reporting on total posts, total IG views, email/Manychat leads collected, and trials to my fitness app offering driven from social. You'll be close enough to the numbers to know what's actually moving the needle and help iterate from there.

Phase 1 — Get to know my audience

You'll dig into my DMs, community messages, in-app chat, and survey responses to build a real picture of who my audience is: their desired outcome, their biggest issues, and their limiting beliefs. From there, you'll define my content pillars and build out a swipe file of viral, high-performing content across those pillars to draw inspiration from (likely living in Notion).
Phase 2 — Run the content engine

Using a 70/20/10 approach, you'll manage my content pipeline: 70% doubling down on what's already working, 20% smart variations you develop, and 10% brand-new ideas you pitch and test (2–4 fresh concepts a week). You'll own my trial reels engine — 1–3 highly viral reels a day within my content pillars — handling post creation end to end, and reporting weekly on what worked, what didn't, and why.
Phase 3 — Grow beyond Instagram

Once Instagram is running like a well-oiled machine, we'll look at expanding to Facebook, YouTube Shorts, TikTok, and Pinterest, and figure out what team/support that would need.

What you need

Experience working in the social media creator space is a must — you should understand creator content, platform trends, and what makes short-form video perform. Experience in fitness is a plus! Beyond that, you should be comfortable going deep on research and audience psychology, then turning that into content that performs. I'm looking for someone who thrives on researching, testing, and iterating and has a passion for content creation!

How to Apply

• Apply via this Linkedin posting with your resume
• Include a short Loom video explaining why you’d be a good fit for the role, why you’re interested in working with Jorry, and showcasing examples from your portfolio

jobs.title: Strategic Events Marketing Manager
jobs.description:
Who we are

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.
Working at Samsara means you’ll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that’s shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you’ll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.
About the role:

We are looking for an energetic, highly organized, A-player who loves a fast-paced, high-performing environment. Working within Marketing, this role will support the production for Samsara's annual customer conference, Beyond, our global Go Beyond programs, and other hosted events throughout the year.
This role supports end-to-end production planning for Samsara's keynotes, breakouts, expo hall and general sessions, covering run-of-show creation, AV planning, rehearsal scheduling, and speaker management, all while executing alongside our production vendor onsite.
You'll manage relationships with production vendors and internal stakeholders while overseeing the workstreams and details that turn a production plan into a flawless live experience. Partnering closely with other members of the marketing, product, sales engineers, and customer success teams, you'll help shape programming and engagement that ladder up to Samsara's business objectives, driving best-in-class events.
This is a remote role open to candidates residing in the US except the San Francisco Bay Metro Area, NYC Metro Area, and Washington, D.C. Metro Area. This role requires travel, candidates must be open to traveling 30% of the time. 

You should apply if:

You want to impact the industries that run our world:
Your efforts will result in real-world impact – helping to keep the lights on, get food into grocery stores, reduce emissions, and most importantly, ensure workers return home safely.
You are the architect of your own career:
If you put in the work, this role won’t be your last at Samsara. We set up our employees for success and have built a culture that encourages rapid career development, countless opportunities to experiment and master your craft in a hyper growth environment.
You’re energized by our opportunity:
The vision we have to digitize large sectors of the global economy requires your full focus and best efforts to bring forth creative, ambitious ideas for our customers.
You want to be with the best:
At Samsara, we win together, celebrate together and support each other. You
will be surrounded by a high-calibre team that will encourage you to do your best. 

In this role, you will:

Coordinate keynote and breakout planning and execution across key internal stakeholders, Samsara’s main production vendor and venue partners.
Support content production by building timelines, scheduling rehearsals, sourcing vehicles and equipment, and managing exec schedules and internal/external speakers.
Review venue contracts to ensure production needs are being met.
Assist in managing expo production needs including coordinating details between internal stakeholders, vendors, and the venue.
Oversee multiple events and programs with overlapping schedules.
Bring energy, creativity, and new ideas to build a successful event experience.
Champion, role model, and embed Samsara’s cultural principles (Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, Win as a Team) as we scale globally and across new offices.

Minimum requirements for the role:

3+ years of experience in event management/production
Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience is required.
This role requires travel, candidates must be open to traveling 30% of the time. 
Experience using AI tools to work more efficiently.

An ideal candidate also has:

Strong communication, negotiation, and budget-management skills, with the ability to work across all levels of an organization.
Proven ability to manage multiple programs simultaneously in a fast-paced environment, navigate shifting priorities, and consistently deliver against deadlines without compromising execution quality.
Excellent project management and organizational skills, with exceptional attention to detail and the ability to build scalable processes, documentation, timelines, and operational frameworks.
Ability to work independently in an ambiguous and rapidly changing environment.

At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time.
Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you’re ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here.
Flexible Working 

At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. In these cases, the job description will clearly indicate any working location requirements. Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. All offers of employment are contingent upon an individual’s ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the company and in the specified work location, if applicable.

to own the day-to-day execution of website projects and recurring SEO deliverables. You'll establish internal schedules, assign and prioritize work, manage team capacity, lead daily production check-ins, oversee quality standards, and ensure commitments are met.

This is an internal production leadership role, not a hands-on designer, developer, or SEO specialist position
. You'll need strong website production knowledge and the confidence to direct specialists, address missed deadlines, and resolve bottlenecks.

You'll have authority over internal assignments, deadlines, and priorities, but no direct reports. You'll document recurring performance concerns and escalate formal personnel matters to leadership. Account Managers own all client communication; you own internal production execution.

Your job is to ensure the right work gets completed correctly and on time, without constant leadership intervention.

Key ResponsibilitiesWebsite Production Create and own internal schedules, assignments, priorities, and deadlines for active website projects.
Understand website discovery, copywriting, design, development, QA, and launch dependencies to sequence work appropriately.
Assign work across designers, developers, writers, and other specialists based on capacity and deadlines.
Monitor progress daily; identify stalled tasks, bottlenecks, and delivery risks before deadlines are missed.
Coordinate internal handoffs and communicate timeline changes to Account Managers and leadership.
Keep website production plans, ownership, and task statuses accurate in Monday.com.

SEO Production Own production operations for recurring monthly SEO deliverables, including scheduling, prioritization, workflow, and delivery consistency.
Work with SEO specialists to turn their strategies and planned deliverables into clear assignments and deadlines.
Coordinate content, optimization, technical SEO, and related tasks across specialists, writers, and developers.
Track completed, outstanding, and at-risk work for each SEO client; address delays before monthly commitments are missed.
Ensure established QA procedures are followed and recurring delivery problems are identified.

SEO specialists own strategy and technical execution. The Production Manager owns operational follow-through and timely delivery.

Daily Leadership & Accountability Lead daily production check-ins to clarify priorities, progress, blockers, and next steps.
Set clear expectations for task ownership, deadlines, and completion standards.
Follow up consistently, address missed commitments directly, and prevent overdue work from accumulating.
Rebalance assignments with specialists when workloads are unrealistic; communicate resulting timeline impacts.
Independently reprioritize production work to meet business commitments.
Document repeated missed deadlines or performance concerns and report them to leadership.

Quality & Workflow Oversight Ensure specialists complete technical QA and work meets established requirements before being marked complete.
Spot-check deliverables for completeness, accuracy, and adherence to production standards.
Return substandard work to the responsible specialist with clear corrections and a revised deadline.
Track recurring quality problems and recommend improvements to reduce rework.
Identify inefficient handoffs, scheduling problems, and production bottlenecks; recommend practical process improvements.

Monday.com, Reporting & Collaboration Use Monday.com
to actively manage assignments, deadlines, dependencies, workload, and project status.
Maintain live visibility into overdue work, upcoming milestones, and production capacity.
Prepare weekly production scorecards and risk updates for the Vice President / Integrator.
Coordinate regularly with Account Managers so they can accurately manage client expectations.
Communicate production risks proactively and escalate issues requiring leadership decisions.
Maintain clear internal documentation and reinforce accurate task updates across the team.

Internal schedules, assignments, priorities, workload balancing, production accountability, SEO delivery tracking, quality oversight, and reporting.
Account Managers:
Client relationships, communication, expectations, information collection, feedback, and approvals.

Technical execution, specialist-level QA, technical recommendations, and SEO strategy where applicable.

.

Direct Monday.com experience
managing projects, tasks, and deadlines.
Proven ability to establish schedules, assign work, prioritize competing demands, and enforce deadlines.
Experience coordinating multiple concurrent projects or recurring deliverables.
Strong organizational skills, attention to detail, follow-through, and independent judgment.
Confidence leading production meetings, addressing missed commitments, and holding contributors accountable.

Clear written and verbal communication and effective collaboration with technical and client-facing teams.
Ability to work in Charlotte, NC, under CGN's hybrid schedule.

Preferred Experience in a digital marketing, creative, or website development agency.
Familiarity with SEO workflows, content production, and recurring monthly deliverables.
Experience coordinating designers, developers, copywriters, and SEO specialists.
Experience building production dashboards, scorecards, or process improvements.

What Success Looks Like On-Time Delivery:
Website production milestones and monthly SEO deliverables are completed on schedule. Overdue work is actively resolved and risks are flagged early.
Quality:
Deliverables meet requirements, specialist QA is completed, and corrections are tracked through resolution.
Workload Management:
Team members have clear assignments and deadlines; priorities and capacity are adjusted proactively.
Production Visibility:
Monday.com reflects accurate progress, and weekly reporting gives leadership reliable insight into delivery performance.

Industry certifications, training, and ongoing learning opportunities.

Work with quality-driven, high-end interior remodeling contractors who value long-term partnerships.

2. Copywriting & Corporate Communications

* Write polished, engaging copy for long-form technical blogs, case studies, and website articles highlighting Bayport’s formulation capabilities and manufacturing technology.
* Draft and edit bi-weekly B2B email newsletters tailored for indie beauty founders, brand executives, and procurement teams.

3. Social Media Management & Executive Support

* Schedule and publish daily content across LinkedIn, Instagram, TikTok, and YouTube Shorts using social scheduling tools.
* Actively engage with prospective clients, industry partners, and community followers in comments and direct messages, escalating qualified sales leads to business development.

4. Trend Forecasting & Market Intelligence

  + **Passionate in about the beauty space**

jobs.title: Social Media Marketing & Community Outreach Coordinator
jobs.description:
**Job Title: Social Media Marketing & Community Outreach Coordinator**
======================================================================

**SMS Clinical Research | Mesquite, TX**

About SMS Clinical Research

SMS Clinical Research is an established clinical research site conducting Phase I–IV clinical trials across multiple therapeutic areas, including vaccines, internal medicine, pulmonology, dermatology, gastroenterology, cardiometabolic diseases, and more. We are committed to advancing medical research and connecting eligible participants with opportunities to contribute to the development of new treatments.

We are seeking a creative, organized, and proactive **Social Media Marketing & Community Outreach Coordinator** to support our clinical trial recruitment efforts, strengthen our online presence, and build relationships within the local community.

Key Responsibilities

**1. Social Media Marketing & Clinical Trial Recruitment**

Develop, design, and publish engaging social media content and advertisements for ongoing clinical trials at SMS Clinical Research.  

Create and manage IRB-approved advertisements and recruitment materials in accordance with study-specific requirements.  
Manage social media platforms, including Facebook, Instagram, LinkedIn, and other relevant channels.  
Develop targeted campaigns to increase awareness of clinical trials and attract potentially eligible participants.  
Monitor campaign performance, engagement, and recruitment leads, and recommend improvements.  

**2. Landing Pages & Lead Management**

Create and maintain landing pages for individual clinical trials and recruitment campaigns.  

Develop online forms to collect prospective participant information and interest.  
Organize, track, and manage incoming leads and ensure timely follow-up or transfer to the appropriate research team.  
Maintain accurate recruitment reports, campaign metrics, and lead-tracking databases.  
Coordinate with the research team to improve the participant inquiry and recruitment process.  

**3. Community Outreach & Public Relations**

Plan and participate in community outreach initiatives to increase awareness of clinical research.  

Represent SMS Clinical Research at health fairs, community events, local organizations, and other outreach activities.  
Establish relationships with community groups, local businesses, healthcare providers, and other potential referral partners.  
Help develop brochures, flyers, presentations, and other educational materials.  
Identify new opportunities to engage diverse populations and expand clinical trial awareness.  

**4. Coordination & Compliance**

Work closely with the clinical research and recruitment teams to understand study requirements and recruitment goals.  

Ensure all trial-specific advertising and recruitment materials receive the required IRB approval before use.  
Follow applicable privacy, confidentiality, and data-protection requirements when collecting and handling prospective participant information.  
Maintain organized records of advertisements, approvals, campaigns, outreach activities, and recruitment results.  

Qualifications

Experience in social media marketing, digital advertising, marketing coordination, or a related field.  

Strong written communication, graphic design, and content creation skills.  
Experience with platforms such as Canva, Meta Business Suite, Facebook Ads Manager, and Instagram.  
Familiarity with landing-page builders, online forms, CRM systems, and lead-tracking tools.  
Excellent organizational skills and attention to detail.  
Strong interpersonal and communication skills, with the ability to represent the organization professionally at community events.  
Ability to work independently, manage multiple projects, and meet recruitment deadlines.  
Reliable transportation and willingness to attend local community outreach events.  

Preferred Qualifications

Experience in healthcare marketing, clinical trial recruitment, medical practice marketing, or pharmaceutical research.  

Familiarity with Institutional Review Board (IRB) advertising approval requirements and clinical research recruitment processes.  
Experience with lead-generation campaigns, landing-page optimization, and digital marketing analytics.  
Experience working with diverse communities and developing community partnerships.  

Ideal Candidate

We are looking for someone who is both creative and results-driven, with the ability to turn marketing campaigns into measurable recruitment opportunities. The ideal candidate is comfortable working in a healthcare environment, communicating with the public, managing digital campaigns, and representing SMS Clinical Research professionally in the community.

Position Details

* **Location:** Mesquite, TX
* **Position Type:** Full-time or part-time, depending on experience and organizational needs
* **Compensation:** Competitive and commensurate with experience

How to Apply

Interested candidates should submit their resume to info@smsclinicalresearch.com and, if available, examples of social media campaigns, advertisements, landing pages, or other marketing projects they have developed.

Join SMS Clinical Research and help connect our community with opportunities to participate in medical research and advance healthcare.
