jobs.title: Senior Manager, B2B Outbound Marketing (Remote)
jobs.description:
**Company Description**

**About M3:** A Japanese global leader in the provision of ground-breaking and innovative technological and research solutions to the healthcare industry. The M3 Group operates in the US, Asia, and Europe with over 5.8 million physician members globally via its physician websites which include mdlinx.com, m3.com, research.m3.com, Doctors.net.uk, medigate.net, and medlive.cn. M3 Inc. is a publicly traded company on the Tokyo Stock Exchange (jp:2413, NIKKEI 225) with subsidiaries in major markets including the US, UK, Japan, South Korea, and China, and in 2020 was ranked in Forbes’ Global 2000 list. The M3 Group provides services to healthcare and the life science industry. In addition to market research, these services include medical education, ethical drug promotion, clinical development, job recruitment, and clinic appointment services. M3 has offices in Japan, UK, France, Germany, Brazil, Sweden, China, USA, and South Korea, as well as India.

**M3 USA** is seeking a **Senior Manager, B2B Outbound Marketing** to develop and execute targeted outbound strategies across our portfolio of healthcare businesses.

This is a hands-on, strategically focused role centered on identifying the right business decision-makers, building targeted prospect audiences, and generating qualified sales conversations through personalized, multichannel outreach.

You will work closely with sales and marketing leadership across multiple business units to develop buyer personas, build outreach campaigns using email, LinkedIn, and sales engagement platforms, and continuously optimize performance to drive measurable pipeline growth.

This is not a traditional digital advertising or paid media position. We are looking for a B2B marketing professional with demonstrated experience building and executing outbound programs that connect sales teams with qualified prospective customers.

 **Job Description**  

* Build and own a full digital outreach path for each subsidiary by identifying decision makers for each product, define specific buyer personas for each business sales activity and grow contact lists from verified sources and research.
* Run multi-channel outbound sequences across email, LinkedIn and other social and digital channels, tailored by subsidiaries, with messaging that speaks to a targeted audience.
* Coordinate efforts with email deliverability specialists for all outbound email domains: authentication and IP warming, sender reputation monitoring, inbox placement testing, list hygiene, and compliance with Google, Yahoo, and Microsoft sender requirements, to reach corporate inboxes protected by enterprise filters.
* Systematize a cross-subsidiary strategy that converts M3's proprietary data assets, such as a network of physicians or health-system relationships— into a repeatable pipeline of qualified conversations through referrals and warm introductions.
* Use AI-assisted research and personalization: build account and contact intelligence, generate personalization at scale, test and refine messaging, while maintaining M3 human review and brand standards.
* Partner with the business development and marketing leads of each subsidiary on target account lists, handoff criteria, follow-up cadence, and feedback on message performance;
* Operate designated BU’s technology stack for outreach (sequencing, Sales Navigator,), integrate it with their CRM’s and recommend new or advanced tech tools.
* Report weekly on placement, reply and positive-reply rates, and pipeline sourced by subsidiary and persona, and use the data to retire what does not work and scale what does.

  
**Qualifications**  

* Bachelor's degree in marketing, communications, business, or a related field, or equivalent experience.
* Certifications in email deliverability, sequencing platforms, or LinkedIn Sales Navigator preferred.
* 7+ years in B2B digital outreach, demand generation, or sales development, with at least 3 years owning persona marketing for outbound commercial revenue generation
* Demonstrated success reaching senior decision makers in healthcare, health systems, experience selling recruitment, staffing, or physician placement services strongly preferred.
* Hands-on experience with sequencing platforms (e.g., Outreach, Apollo, HubSpot Sequences), LinkedIn Sales Navigator, contact enrichment and verification tools, deliverability monitoring tools, and CRM integration.
* Experience supporting or consulting for multiple business units, clients or brands with distinct customers.
* Working knowledge of email authentication (SPF, DKIM, DMARC, BIMI), domain and IP warming, reputation monitoring, and inbox placement testing, and of how Microsoft 365, Google Workspace, Proofpoint, Mimecast, and similar filters treat outbound mail.
* Ability to identify and verify the true buyer within a target organization (budget owner, decision maker, and influencers), distinguish them from adjacent or easier-to-reach contacts, and hold a disciplined outreach cadence toward that person without defaulting to volume.
* Understanding of how health systems, medical groups, and staffing firms recruit physicians, and who own those decisions
* Strong writing skills: short, specific with the ability to adapt voice by persona and by subsidiary brand.
* Working knowledge of CAN-SPAM, CASL, GDPR/UK GDPR, TCPA, and LinkedIn terms of service as they apply to outbound outreach.
* Ability to use AI tools for research, personalization, and testing, with judgment about accuracy, brand, and disclosure.
* Ability to manage several concurrent programs independently, prioritize across businesses, and report clearly to sales and marketing leaders.
* Analytical fluency with campaign, deliverability, and CRM data; comfortable building simple dashboards.

  
**Additional Information**

**Benefits:**

A career opportunity with M3USA offers competitive wages, and benefits such as:

* Health and Dental
* Life, Accident and Disability Insurance
* Presc

jobs.description:
About The Wells Michael Collective

The Wells Michael Collective is an independent luxury real estate brokerage in Ladue, Missouri, led by partners Justin Michael and Suzie Wells. We represent significant homes across St. Louis and present them through architecture, design and the lives lived inside them.

The role

You will be the creative voice of The Wells Michael Collective across every screen and every printed page. You will own our social presence from concept to camera to caption, build the content strategy behind it, and design the brochures, mailers and campaigns that put our homes and our people in front of the right audience.

You will sit at the table with both partners and shape how the brand looks and sounds as it grows. Your ideas will move from sketch to published within days, with no agency layers or committee approvals in between. This is an in office and in field position, split between our Ladue office and shoots, listings and events across St. Louis.

What you will own

**Social media production and publishing**

* Plan, shoot, edit and publish content for Instagram, Facebook, LinkedIn, TikTok and YouTube
* Produce short form video, reels and stories for every listing, from Coming Soon through Sold
* Direct photographers and videographers on set so every shoot matches the brand
* Write captions with an editorial voice: precise, warm and free of real estate clichés
* Manage the posting calendar, community replies and direct messages

**Content strategy**

* Build and run a monthly content strategy tied to listings, market moments, advisors and the St. Louis lifestyle
* Track performance every month and turn the numbers into next month's plan
* Develop recurring series that give people a reason to follow us: home stories, architecture, neighborhoods, design
* Grow audience quality as well as audience size, with the goal of reaching the clients who buy and sell significant homes

**Brand design**

* Design listing collateral in Canva: brochures, feature sheets, postcards, mailers and presentation pieces
* Keep every asset on brand using our Canva Brand Kit, palette and typography
* Prepare print files with correct bleed and specs for our print partners
* Build InDesign layouts for longer editorial pieces as the brand expands

**Brand expansion**

* Launch new advisors with a polished public profile and content plan
* Support press, magazine ads, events and community partnerships
* Help build the visual playbook that will carry the brand into new markets

What you bring

**Required**

* 3+ years producing social content and design work for a brand, ideally in luxury, hospitality, fashion, design or real estate
* Advanced Canva skills, with a portfolio that proves it
* An eye for elevation: you know the difference between expensive and significant, and your work shows restraint
* Strong photo and video skills on a phone and in an editing app such as CapCut, Premiere Rush or Lightroom
* Clear, polished writing with a natural editorial voice
* Comfort with analytics on Meta, TikTok and LinkedIn
* Organized, self directed and able to run a calendar with many moving parts
* Based in St. Louis and able to be on site at shoots, events and the Ladue office

**A plus**

* Adobe InDesign, Photoshop or Illustrator
* Experience with print production and working with print vendors
* Experience directing photographers, videographers or stylists
* A following or portfolio built around architecture, interiors or St. Louis

Please include a portfolio. We hire on the strength of the work.

Growth path

This role is designed to grow into the head of marketing as the company grows. The path is tied to results, and you will review progress with both partners every quarter.

* **Marketing & Brand Content Manager.** Own social, content strategy and listing design. Build the systems and the calendar.
* **Senior Brand Manager.** Lead campaigns, press and partnerships. Manage freelance photographers, videographers and designers.
* **Director of Marketing & Brand.** Lead a marketing team, own the brand budget and guide the brand into new markets.

You will also receive an annual professional development budget for courses, conferences and creative tools, plus direct mentorship from two partners who have built a luxury brand from the ground up.

Compensation, bonus and benefits

* **Base salary:** based on experience and portfolio
* **Annual bonus:** tied to company growth milestones you helped drive
* **Paid time off:** PTO and major holidays, with a quiet week between Christmas and New Year's
* **Professional development:** an annual budget for courses, conferences and creative tools
* **Your tools (provided by the company):** a laptop, Canva Pro, Adobe Creative Cloud and the gear you need to shoot
* **Access:** a front row seat inside some of the most significant homes in St. Louis, and direct connection to the clients, designers, architects, builders and community leaders who shape them, with real networking opportunities through our events and partnerships

How to apply

Send your resume, a portfolio link and three pieces of work you are proudest of to team@wellsmichael.com. Tell us in a few sentences what you would change first about our Instagram. We read every application, and finalists will complete a short paid creative exercise.

Pay: From $50,000.00 per year

Benefits:

* Paid time off

Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Search Engine Optimization Specialist
jobs.description:
**About the Role**

We are hiring an SEO Specialist to improve client search rankings, strengthen local visibility, and help websites attract relevant organic traffic. You'll review website performance, identify technical and content issues, manage local search listings, and use campaign data to guide ongoing improvements.

This role is suited to someone with at least two years of SEO experience who can work methodically, write clear recommendations, and understand that meaningful search improvements take time. You'll be expected to monitor campaigns consistently, respond promptly when problems arise, and report results accurately without making promises the data cannot support.

**What You'll Be Responsible For**

* Audit client websites to identify technical SEO issues, content gaps, indexing problems, and opportunities for improvement.
* Develop practical optimisation plans based on website audits, keyword research, and client objectives.
* Manage local business listings, check profile accuracy, and monitor customer reviews.
* Research keywords and search intent to identify opportunities for new pages and existing content improvements.
* Prepare clear content briefs outlining page objectives, target keywords, search intent, and recommended content structure.
* Monitor keyword rankings, organic traffic, local visibility, and other relevant SEO performance indicators.
* Use Google Search Console and appropriate SEO tools to investigate changes in performance and identify potential issues.
* Review page titles, meta descriptions, internal links, headings, and other on-page SEO elements.
* Track campaign progress and prepare reports explaining performance changes, completed work, and recommended next steps.
* Investigate ranking declines, traffic changes, indexing issues, and other problems that may affect campaign performance.
* Keep campaign records, audit findings, and performance data accurate and organised.
* Respond promptly to client and team enquiries, particularly when a campaign requires investigation or corrective action.
* Communicate progress, concerns, and realistic expectations clearly to the relevant stakeholders.

**What You'll Bring**

* **At least 2 years of professional experience in SEO.**
* Practical knowledge of technical SEO, on-page optimisation, and local SEO.
* Familiarity with Google Search Console and relevant SEO research, auditing, and tracking tools.
* Understanding of keyword research, search intent, website indexing, and organic search performance.
* Good writing skills and the ability to prepare clear content briefs and optimisation recommendations.
* Ability to interpret ranking and traffic data and explain what the figures do—and do not—demonstrate.
* Strong attention to detail when auditing websites, checking business listings, and reviewing performance reports.
* A methodical approach to investigating technical issues and identifying opportunities for improvement.
* Good organisational skills and the ability to manage several tasks or campaigns at once.
* Clear communication skills and the ability to provide timely, accurate updates.
* Patience and consistency when managing campaigns where results develop over time.

**What to Expect in the Role**

You'll be expected to track SEO activity carefully, check your findings before reporting them, and communicate honestly about campaign performance. When rankings or traffic change unexpectedly, you should investigate the possible causes and explain what is known, what remains uncertain, and what action is recommended.

SEO requires ongoing attention rather than one-time fixes. We value consistent optimisation, realistic expectations, and prompt communication when a technical issue or campaign concern needs attention.

**Working Arrangements**

**Schedule:** Monday to Friday, 9:00 AM–5:00 PM  
**Location:** 135 Henry St, Dayton, Ohio 45403  
**Employment Type:** Full-time

**How to Apply**

Apply through Indeed with your current Resume. Highlight your SEO experience, website auditing skills, familiarity with Google Search Console, and work with local search campaigns. Include examples of SEO projects you've supported and the performance indicators you used to evaluate progress.

**EQUAL EMPLOYMENT OPPORTUNITY**

**Applicants will be considered based on job-related skills, experience, and qualifications, in accordance with applicable employment laws.**

Pay: $78,000.00 - $82,000.00 per year

Benefits:

* 401(k)
* Dental insurance
* Employee assistance program
* Flexible schedule
* Health insurance
* Paid time off
* Parental leave
* Vision insurance

Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Technical Marketing, Growth Manager
jobs.description:
**A****BOUT ROOTSTOCK**

Rootstock Software builds Cloud ERP for manufacturers, distributors, and supply chain teams, native to the Salesforce Platform. Our customers run inventory, production, and supply chain operations on Rootstock, and we are investing heavily in AI across the product and our go-to-market.

**THE ROLE**

We are hiring a technical, hands-on marketer to own paid acquisition and the growth engine behind roughly half of our top-of-funnel pipeline.

This role is built around budget ownership. You will run hundreds of thousands of dollars in Google Ads and AdRoll spend, decide where every dollar goes, and scale what works. You will also be the builder behind it: shipping pages, experiments, and automation in Claude Code, and running technical SEO, without waiting on an engineering queue.

It is a great fit for a digital or growth marketer a few years into their career who already owns paid budgets and leans technical, or for an associate-level consultant who has run strategy and execution for clients and wants to own it in-house.

***This is a remote position, based in the United States or Canada.***  
*Please, no agencies/recruiters.*

**WHAT YOU WILL DO**

* **Own paid performance.** Run Google Ads and AdRoll against our ICP terms and target accounts, scale spend into the hundreds of thousands, and make incremental spend decisions backed by data.
* **Drive technical SEO and conversion.** Find which terms and accounts convert to MQLs, run constant experiments, and grow top-of-funnel conversion week over week.
* **Build in Claude Code.** Ship and iterate on web pages, integrations, and automation that power the growth engine.
* **Measure what works.** Track performance across every channel, build the reporting you need to make spend decisions, and present results to leadership with confidence.
* **Shape AI and review-site discoverability.** Manage our presence on G2 and similar review sites, including how Rootstock gets surfaced and recommended by AI tools.
* **Support content and campaigns.** Contribute to case studies, sales enablement collateral, and persona-basedoutbound email and LinkedIn sequences as needed.

**WHAT YOU BRING**

The profile below is what we would like to see, but we are open to the right candidate. Strong analytical ability, theability to learn quickly, and a willingness to roll up your sleeves and contribute from day one matter more thanchecking every box.

* Ideally 3 to 5 years in growth, digital, paid, or performance marketing at a startup or B2B software company, or in an associate-level consulting role focused on marketing strategy and execution
* Direct ownership of ad spend and paid budgets in Google Ads, AdRoll, or similar, with accountability for results
* A technical, builder mindset: you are already experimenting with Claude Code or similar AI tools, and you are comfortable with automation, spreadsheets, SQL, or scripting
* Technical SEO experience, including keyword strategy and conversion optimization
* An analytical brain: you make spend decisions from data, not instinct
* A scrappy, high-ownership approach; you are comfortable running many experiments at once and grinding through the daily numbers
* Executive presence: you can own a number that matters to leadership and communicate results clearl

  

**NICE TO HAVE**

* Agency, consulting, or freelance experience managing paid budgets across multiple clients
* A founder or first-marketing-hire background at a startup
* Experience with ERP, supply chain, inventory, or manufacturing software
* Incrementality or A/B testing on paid channels
* Experience with G2 or other product review platforms
* Familiarity with Salesforce or Hubspot

**FIRST 90 DAYS**

The headline goal: scale our digital ad investment and prove it pays off.

* **Day 30:** Audit current paid, SEO, and conversion performance, learn the ICP and target accounts, and get your reporting baseline in place.
* **Day 60:** Launch your first wave of experiments across Google Ads, AdRoll, and technical SEO, and start reallocating spend toward what converts.
* **Day 90:** Run a scaled, measurable ad program with a clear line from spend to MQLs, and a roadmap for what you will build next.

**INTERVIEW PROCESS**  
**STEP 1:** Hiring Managers  
**STEP 2**: BDR Manager  
**STEP 3**: Sales Leadership  
**STEP 4:** CRO/Executive  
**STEP 5:** Case study/Panel interview

**The Basics:**

* **Location**: Remote, US-based
* **Work Authorization:** This position requires candidates to be authorized to work in the United States on a full-time basis. Rootstock is not able to sponsor, extend, or transfer work visas for this position now or in the future — this includes but is not limited to H-1B, TN, O-1, E-3, and OPT/STEM OPT extensions. Candidates who will require sponsorship at any point during their employment will not be considered.
* **Compensation:** Base salary, annual bonus, and a long-term incentive plan (LTIP).
  + Base Salary: The anticipated salary range for this role is $110,000 to $ 1200,000. Base pay offered is based on market location and may vary further depending on individualized factors for job candidates, such as job-related knowledge, skills, experience, and other objective business considerations.
* **Benefits:**
  + Time Off: Flexible time-off, 12 paid holidays, 10 sick days, volunteer time off, and paid parental leave.
  + Recurring cell/Internet stipend
  + 401(k) via Fidelity + 2% Employer annual matching
  + Comprehensive healthcare with dental and vision coverage; life, accident and disability insurance; tax-advantaged flexible spending and health savings accounts; employee assistance program; other voluntary benefit programs such as supplemental life and AD&D, legal plan, pet insurance, critical illness, accident & hospital indemnity.

jobs.title: Manager, Performance Marketing
jobs.description:
**About Eleanor Health**

Eleanor Health is rethinking addiction by treating it as a chronic condition and building an integrated care model that expands access to effective, whole-person treatment to drive sustained recovery. Our goal is to improve upon earlier generations of opioid and substance use disorder treatment to create more accessible clinic- and community-based care.

Eleanor Health and its associated health care providers deliver best-in-class substance use disorder care utilizing Medication-Assisted Therapy (MAT), behavioral health therapy, care management, and social support and wrap services. As a multi-site, outpatient treatment organization, Eleanor delivers accessible, evidence-based, and excellent clinical care, supported by innovative technology.

If you are passionate about growing your career in a business that makes a difference, we seek highly skilled, motivated, and compassionate individuals who take responsibility and adapt quickly to change to join our deeply committed and collaborative team.

**About the Role**

Every month, thousands of people decide they are ready to do something about their substance use. They search, they scroll, they stream, they click, they call, they fill out a form. This role exists to make sure that as many of them as possible find us in more places than a search results page, and that it costs less to reach them each quarter.

This is a paid media role, and it is not a paid search role. Google Ads and Microsoft Ads are our largest channels today, and a dedicated specialist runs them day to day. This role exists to build and scale everything around that foundation: affiliate, programmatic and streaming audio, Meta, and Reddit. We are hiring for depth in those channels, along with the website experimentation that turns more traffic into more members.

**Where we are**
----------------

We have built a real foundation over the past two years. Paid cost per new member has been reduced by more than half. Conversion tracking is clean and includes offline conversion data, so campaigns optimize toward people who actually enter care rather than toward form fills. Campaign structure has been rebuilt, landing page experience has improved substantially, and bid strategy and targeting have moved from manual management to value-based approaches.

This is a performance marketing function with good bones, clear measurement, and meaningful results already behind it.

**Where we are going**
----------------------

Three priorities define the next phase of the work.

* **First —** Paid channel diversification. Paid search carries too much of the load today. We need to build and prove affiliate, programmatic and streaming audio, Meta, and Reddit, and to test others worth testing, so growth does not depend on a single auction that gets more expensive as we scale. Each new channel earns its budget by proving member-level economics, not lead volume.
* **Second —** Testing rigor. Our experimentation program is young, and there is substantial gain available from running it properly: structured A/B testing on landing pages and creative, and disciplined testing of newer bid strategies and campaign types, including AI Max.
* **Third —** Website conversion. The website is the front door for every channel. Landing pages, forms, and the online self-scheduling experience decide how much of the traffic we buy turns into a lead, and every point of lift improves every channel at once.

**The channels**
----------------

The channels in scope are Google Ads, Microsoft Ads, affiliate, programmatic and streaming audio, and Meta and Reddit. A paid search specialist runs the day-to-day on Google and Microsoft. This role leads the rest, builds the strategy across all five, and decides where each dollar goes.

**How the funnel is shared**
----------------------------

Marketing does not own the entire path on its own. This role owns the path from first impression to a submitted lead or call: the channels, the landing pages, the forms, and the online self-scheduling experience. From there, our Access team is the first human point of contact for every prospective member who reaches out, by phone, by web form, or through online self-scheduling. They handle insurance verification, appointment scheduling, pre-visit support, and follow-up when someone misses an appointment. The Access team reports separately to the Chief Marketing Officer, alongside this role rather than within it.

The lifecycle communications that carry a prospective member from inquiry to first visit, including confirmations, reminders, pre-visit content, and no-show recovery, are owned by the Organic & AI Acquisition team, which also owns the content behind them. This role partners with that team and with Access, because paid cost per new member depends on what happens after the lead. A standing intake funnel review brings all three together.

**What this role is accountable for**
-------------------------------------

The primary measure is paid cost per new member, and it is deliberately end-to-end: spend divided by members who complete a first visit, not by leads generated. It does not improve by producing more form fills. It improves when more of the people we reach actually enter care.

Alongside it sit website-visitor-to-lead conversion, owned outright by this role, and the mix of paid acquisition itself: the share of members coming from channels beyond paid search, and each new channel's cost against a defined target before it earns more budget. Lead-to-member conversion is owned by Access and the lifecycle function, and blended cost per acquisition across all channels, paid and non-paid together, sits with the Chief Marketing Officer.

**What You'll Do**

**Paid Media Strategy & Performance**

* Own paid cost per new member as a quarterly target, understanding that monthly variance in this category is largely seasonal rather than performance-driven
* Own budget pacing and allocation across all five ch

**JOB TITLE:** Associate Director of Marketing

**REPORTS TO:** Executive Director of Marketing

**EXPECTED SALARY RANGE:** $65,000 – 75,000; plus The University of Vermont Foundation’s progressive benefits package, which includes a comprehensive health plan; dental, vision, and life insurance; a robust paid time off package; a 403(b) plan with immediate vesting and contributions; and tuition remission.

**EFFECTIVE DATE:** November 15, 2026, or a mutually agreed-upon start date

**FTE:** Full-Time

**LOCATION:** Burlington, Vermont

**JOB-TYPE/HOURS:** Hybrid. The UVM Foundation operates on a 3-2 hybrid schedule which allows employees to work 2 days per week from a local remote location. Specific schedules are discussed with and approved by supervisors.

**JOB SUMMARY:**

The Associate Director of Marketing for Digital Communication Platforms manages the organization's website, email marketing, and text messaging platforms to advance the philanthropic and alumni engagement missions of the UVM Foundation and UVM Alumni Association. This role serves as the organization's primary subject matter expert for digital communications platforms, ensuring content is strategic, audience-focused, data-informed, and aligned with organizational goals.

Reporting to the Executive Director of Marketing, the Associate Director is responsible for the administration, optimization, governance, and ongoing enhancement of the Foundation's digital communication channels, including the website, email marketing platform, and texting platform. The position provides strategic guidance and technical support to colleagues across the organization while leveraging analytics and best practices to improve engagement, user experience, and campaign performance.

**ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS**

**40%** Manage, Update, and Optimize the UVM Foundation website

* Serve as primary administrator for the UVM Foundation website, overseeing content updates, site structure, accuracy, functionality, accessibility, and user experience while aligning with brand standards.
* Collaborate with marketing colleagues and content owners across the organization to create, update, and publish website content across the organization.
* Monitor website performance and user behavior using Google Analytics and platform reporting tools; collect data and provide recommendations to improve engagement and conversion outcomes.
* Lead ongoing efforts to enhance website usability, accessibility, search engine optimization (SEO), and overall user experience.
* Develop and maintain website governance processes, content standards, workflows, and documentation.
* Identify opportunities to improve landing pages, donation pathways, event registration experiences, and other high-priority user journeys.
* Troubleshoot website issues and coordinate with vendors or technical partners as needed to ensure optimal platform performance.

**40%** Manage, Maintain, and Optimize Email Marketing

* Serve as primary administrator and subject matter expert for the organization's email marketing platform.
* Develop and maintain email marketing standards, templates, processes, and best practices to improve consistency, efficiency, and effectiveness.
* Build and deploy email communications and sequences while providing guidance and strategic support to staff responsible for creating and sending their own messages.
* Collect and review email performance metrics and provide actionable recommendations to improve open rates, click-through rates, audience engagement, and conversion outcomes.
* Develop audience segmentation strategies that deliver more relevant and targeted communications.
* Establishing and enacting thoughtful data maintenance and hygiene processes, including conducting A/B performance testing, as well as creating dashboards or other reporting mechanisms to help stakeholders evaluate campaign effectiveness in service of making data-informed decisions. Ensure compliance with applicable privacy, consent, and email marketing regulations and best practices.
* Monitor emerging trends and technologies in email marketing and implement enhancements where appropriate.

**15%** Manage, Maintain, and Optimize Texting

* Serve as administrator for the organization's texting platforms and help establish a long-term strategy for text-based engagement.
* Develop processes, standards, and best practices governing the use of SMS communications across the organization.
* Partner with fundraising, alumni engagement, and event teams to expand texting initiatives to include event reminders, volunteer engagement, stewardship, and other strategic communications.
* Monitor engagement and response metrics to evaluate effectiveness and identify opportunities for growth.
* Ensure compliance with applicable consent, privacy, and communication requirements.
* Develop reporting tools and recommendations that support continuous improvement of texting efforts.

**5****%** Other duties as assigned

**MINIMUM SKILLS & ABILITIES**

* Experience managing content within a website content management system (CMS).
* Experience creating, deploying, and evaluating email marketing campaigns.
* Experience using analytics tools to measure performance and inform decision-making.
* Demonstrated ability to manage multiple projects, priorities, and deadlines simultaneously.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills.
* Design sensibilities preferred and experience adhering to branding guidelines.
* Collaborative approach to working across teams.
* Demonstrated commitment to the principles of diversity, equity and inclusion, combined with the ability to meaningfully apply those principles to strategy development and implementation.

  

**PREFERRED EDUCATION & EXPERIENCE**

* Bachelor's degree and at least 2-3 years of experience in digital marketing, digital communications, email marketing, website management, and/or experience from which comparable knowledge, skill, and abilities have been developed.

**Fair warning: this is not a “sit at the desk” job.**

At 9am you might be checking in a patient who’s nervous about their first treatment. At 10:30 you’re on the phone with a doctor’s office about an order. By noon you’re picking up dry ice because a shipment goes out today. By 3 you’re posting on Instagram or updating a page on our website. Next month? You could be at a conference, shaking hands with med spa owners who want what we’ve got.

If that sounds chaotic, this isn’t your job.

If that sounds *fun*, keep reading.

**Who we are**

The Stem Cell Club helps people dealing with joint pain, injuries, and life’s wear and tear explore regenerative medicine. ATOM Stem Cells, our sister company, supplies stem cell products to clinics across the country.

Same team. Two companies. Growing fast in Vegas, St. George, and nationwide.

**The hats you’ll wear**

* **Patient Hat.** Answer calls and texts, call back new leads, greet patients, check them in and out, and follow up after treatment so nobody feels forgotten.
* **Computer Hat.** Keep patient records spotless in our CRM, confirm appointments, and track follow-ups. If it’s not in the system, it didn’t happen.
* **Social Media Hat.** Create and post content on our social channels. Patient stories (with permission), behind-the-scenes moments, and stuff from our content calendar.
* **Website Hat.** Update pages, put up new content, and help build out websites as we grow.
* **Doctor Hat.** Visit with physicians and partner clinics, help with ATOM orders, and be the friendly face of the brand.
* **Logistics Hat.** Dry ice runs, shipment prep, and making sure the cells get where they need to go, cold and on time.
* **Road Trip Hat.** Conferences, trade shows, and meetings with med spas and clinics.
* **Whatever’s Next Hat.** We’re growing, and new hats show up every month. You’ll get first dibs.

**Don’t know how to do half of that? Good. Neither did we.**

We’ll train you on all of it: the CRM, social media, websites, the products, the science. You don’t need to show up knowing everything. You need to show up willing to learn it.

**What we can’t train**

A smile. A good attitude. The kind of person who’s genuinely happy to be here.

That’s the whole job, honestly. Our patients are often in pain and nervous, and a warm, happy face at the front desk changes their entire experience. Doctors and clinics feel it too. Skills we can teach. Happy, we hire.

**Let’s be real about the pace**

It gets busy. Phones ring, shipments are due, a patient needs something *right now*. Some days are stressful.

But here’s how we see it: it’s just work. We take care of people seriously, and we don’t take ourselves too seriously. Nobody here is going to lose their mind over a missed call. We figure it out, we laugh about it, and we keep moving.

**You’ll crush it here if you…**

* Smile without being told to (people can hear it on the phone, too)
* Say “I’ve got it” before anyone asks
* Can switch from a patient to a physician to a FedEx counter without missing a beat
* Love learning new things, especially tech
* Want to grow *with* a company, not just collect a paycheck from one
* Have a sense of humor (required, non-negotiable)

**You won’t love it here if you…**

* Think “that’s not my job” is a complete sentence
* Need every day to look the same
* Let a busy day ruin your whole week

**What you get**

* Full training on everything: CRM, social media, websites, products, and more
* A real shot at growing into a bigger role as we expand. The people who start here are the ones who’ll lead later.
* A front-row seat to one of the fastest-moving fields in medicine
* A small team where your work actually gets noticed

**Nice to have (not required):** medical office or front desk experience, bilingual English/Spanish

**How to apply**

Send your resume or call us.

Pay: $15.00 - $22.00 per hour

Work Location: In person

We started in 2015 as a 45-day pop-up and stayed for years. No shortcuts. We just kept picking up the phone. We don't do "swag for the sake of swag." We make things people actually want to wear.

You'll be the voice of Ink'd online. Instagram, Facebook, LinkedIn, TikTok and everything else: the content, the calendar, the community and the paid ads. You'll turn a busy print floor and a 10-year founder story into posts that get people to stop scrolling, and you'll turn those posts into leads.

**What you'll do**

Own the feeds. Plan and run the content calendar on Instagram, Facebook, LinkedIn and TikTok (X and YouTube too). Every channel gets its own voice, and all of it sounds like Ink'd.

Make the content. Shoot and edit short-form video and photos on the floor: presses running, kits getting packed, logos on Lululemon and Patagonia, finished drops landing. Write captions that sound like a person, not a promo catalog.

Run the ads. Build, launch and optimize paid social campaigns (Meta, plus LinkedIn as we grow) aimed at the people who buy merch: HR, people-ops, marketing and office leaders. Test, read the numbers, cut what's not working and scale what is.

Tell the story. Turn Jay's Blog, client wins, new-hire kits and seasonal drops into posts, reels and carousels.

Work LinkedIn. Grow the company page and help amplify the founder's voice where our B2B buyers actually spend their time.

Listen and engage. Reply to comments and DMs, watch what competitors and the promo industry are doing, and spot trends early.

Measure everything. Track reach, engagement, traffic and leads with native analytics and Google Analytics. Report what worked, what didn't, and what you'll try next.

**What you bring**

Real social media experience: a brand, a business, a club, a creator account, or your own feed with results you can show us.

A strong eye for short-form video and the ability to shoot and edit it yourself (CapCut, Premiere, Final Cut, or similar).

Tight, punchy writing. You can say it in five words when everyone else uses twenty.

Hands-on experience with Meta Ads Manager, or the drive to get great at it fast.

Comfort with numbers. You know what CTR, CPM and CPL mean and you care when they move.

Ownership. You see something that needs doing and you do it without being asked.

Speed and organization. You can juggle a calendar, a shoot and an ad test in the same week.

Adobe Creative Suite (Photoshop, Illustrator) and/or Canva

A scheduling tool such as Hootsuite, Buffer, Later or Meta Business Suite

LinkedIn Ads and B2B social experience

SEO basics and social listening tools

Experience working with influencers or creators

Some familiarity with apparel, merch, printing or e-commerce, or just a love for good gear

**Why join**

You own it. Your ideas go live fast, and you'll see exactly what they do for the business.

There's a lot to film. Presses, embroidery, a million-plus items, and brands like Patagonia, Vuori and YETI coming off our floor.

Real people. A small, close team where everybody picks up the phone and owns the details.

Apply on Indeed and include **links to Reels or TikToks you shot and edited yourself**, with one sentence on each about what you did. Applications without links won’t be considered.

**About Bizzabo**

Bizzabo is the Event Experience Operating System for modern enterprise organizations, and the intelligence behind every great event. Corporate event teams use Bizzabo to run complex event portfolios across in-person, virtual, webinar, and field events, unify their data, and prove the business impact of every event they run.

We've powered more than 100,000 events for millions of attendees. We're a Leader in the Forrester Wave for B2B Event Management Technology and the only vendor in that evaluation named a Customer Favorite. Founded in 2011, we're headquartered in New York with offices in Montreal, Kyiv and Tel-Aviv.

The category is changing fast. Event teams are being asked to run more programs with fewer people and prove revenue impact on every one of them, and AI is reshaping what an event platform should do. We're building for that future, and we need someone to tell that story.

**About the role**

You'll own how Bizzabo is understood: by buyers, by our sales team, by analysts, and by the AI agents our own teams now work with every day.

This is a lead role with real scope. You'll own positioning, messaging, launches, competitive strategy, sales enablement, and analyst relations for the full Event Experience OS, including the agentic capabilities we're bringing to organizers, attendees, and sponsors. You'll sit at the intersection of Product, Sales, Account Management, and Marketing, and you'll report directly to our Co-founder and CMO.

We're looking for a builder. You'll have strong partners across Brand, Demand Generation, and Enablement, but no layers between you and the work. If you want to shape a category, not maintain someone else's messaging deck, this is the role.

You'll also get to work the way we work. Claude is part of everyone's day at Bizzabo. Our teams use Claude and Claude Cowork daily, with Skills built on our own messaging, product, and competitive knowledge, and you'll have the freedom to automate anything that slows you down.

  
Requirements:  
  

**What you'll do**

* Own positioning and messaging for the Event Experience OS. Translate new agentic capabilities into clear, provable value for enterprise event leaders, and keep the story consistent from the website to the last call before signature.
* Run launches end to end. Partner with Product on what we build and why, then own the go-to-market: narrative, pricing and packaging input, launch plan, field readiness, and customer communication.
* Help us win competitive deals. Own competitive intelligence against legacy event management platforms and newer point solutions. Build battlecards, landmine questions, and objection handling that reps actually use, and run win/loss analysis to sharpen them.
* Equip the field. Build the pitch narrative, demo storylines, one-pagers, and RFP content. Partner with Sales and Solutions leadership to train the team and make sure every new capability is sold, not just shipped.
* Lead analyst relations day to day. Own our Forrester and Gartner relationships, evaluation submissions, and briefings, plus our presence on peer review sites like G2, TrustRadius, Capterra, and Gartner Peer Insights.

* Own the context layer. Our messaging, product, and competitive knowledge powers the Claude Skills our teams use to write, sell, and support. You'll keep that source of truth current and use AI to automate your own GTM workflows.

**﻿What success looks like**

In your first 90 days:

* You've listened to dozens of sales calls, interviewed customers and lost prospects, and can explain in plain words why we win and why we lose.
* You've refreshed our core competitive materials and the field is using them in live deals.
* You've taken ownership of our next analyst evaluation and our peer review strategy.
* You've shipped your first launch end to end.

In your first year:

* Our competitive win rate is measurably higher, and you can show which of your work moved it.
* Every major release goes to market with a clear story, trained reps, and customer adoption plans.
* Our analyst and peer review position reflects where the product actually is.
* The messaging that powers our people and our AI agents is sharp, current, and trusted across the company.

**﻿What you need**

* 5+ years of product marketing in B2B SaaS selling to mid-market and enterprise buyers, including time as the lead or sole product marketer.
* An AI-native way of working. You've used AI agents, ideally Claude, to automate real GTM workflows, and you can show us what you built.
* A track record of positioning complex platforms for both business and technical buyers, and of winning against an entrenched incumbent.
* Strong sales enablement instincts. You build narratives and assets that get used in the field, and you know how to check that they do.
* Hands-on experience with analyst relations, ideally including a Forrester Wave or Gartner Magic Quadrant evaluation.
* Excellent writing. You make complicated things simple without making them generic.
* Comfort building without a big team around you: you set your own priorities, move fast, and ship.

**﻿Nice to have**

* Hands-on experience with Claude Cowork, Claude Skills, or similar agentic tools in your day-to-day work.
* Experience in event technology, martech, or another platform sold to marketing teams.
* Experience marketing agentic or AI-first products to enterprise buyers.
* Experience with a three-sided value story (in our case, organizers, attendees, and sponsors).
* Fluency with Salesforce, HubSpot, and Gong, and comfort pulling your own data from them.

As Senior Marketing Manager at Teton Outfitters (a subsidiary of Polaris Inc.), you will lead global marketing strategy and execution for the KLIM and 509 brands, reporting directly to the General Manager. This role oversees the team focused on brand positioning, consumer engagement, communications, public relations, content strategy, athlete and ambassador programs, events, and integrated marketing campaigns across global markets. Working closely with Product, Sales, Consumer Direct, Creative, and Operations, you will align marketing initiatives with business objectives while maintaining each brand's distinct identity and market position. The position offers broad ownership of the marketing function, including team leadership, brand development, and go-to-market execution, with a direct impact on brand equity and long-term business growth.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Lead, coach, and develop the global marketing team of approx. four direct reports (seven total) by establishing clear priorities, performance expectations, and development plans while promoting accountability, collaboration, and continuous improvement.
* Develop and execute global marketing strategies for KLIM and 509 that strengthen brand positioning, support business objectives, and maintain consistent messaging and storytelling across markets and consumer touchpoints.
* Lead integrated marketing campaigns across owned and earned channels, including seasonal product launches, promotional initiatives, and consumer engagement programs that increase brand awareness, consideration, loyalty, and advocacy.
* Partner with Product, Sales, Consumer Direct, Creative, and Operations teams to align marketing priorities with product roadmaps, seasonal business objectives, and go-to-market strategies while maintaining clear functional accountability.
* Establish and oversee content and creative strategies, including product photography, video, brand storytelling, and marketing materials, ensuring consistent brand standards and effective communication of product innovation and performance benefits.
* Direct global public relations and brand communications strategies, including media relations, press releases, executive communications, industry partnerships, and crisis communication planning and response.
* Lead athlete, ambassador, influencer, and sponsorship programs, building relationships with key partners and ensuring initiatives strengthen brand credibility, consumer engagement, and business objectives.
* Oversee event marketing strategies, experiential activations, product shows, and industry events, ensuring effective execution and measurable value from sponsorships and partnerships.
* Analyze consumer insights, market trends, competitive activity, and campaign performance to guide marketing decisions, optimize investments, and identify opportunities to strengthen brand positioning across domestic and international markets.
* Develop and manage an annual marketing budget of approx. $2.5M, allocate resources based on business priorities, monitor spending, and evaluate agency, vendor, and partnership performance to maximize effectiveness and ROI.
* Champion consistent brand experiences across global markets by maintaining brand standards, aligning internal stakeholders, and adapting marketing communications to regional consumer preferences and market conditions.

**Desired Competencies:**

* Leadership: You inspire, guide, and empower others to achieve their best by setting clear direction, fostering trust, and creating an environment where people feel supported, motivated, and accountable for delivering results.
* Business Acumen: You understand how your work impacts financial performance, operational efficiency, and organizational goals, and you make decisions with the broader business context in mind.
* Collaboration: You work effectively with others across functions and levels, contributing to shared goals while respecting different perspectives.
* Strategic Thinking: You set the direction for the Brand Marketing team and initiatives that align with the Company's strategic priorities.

**Qualifications:**

* BS in Marketing, Communications, Business, or a related field.
* 8+ years of progressive marketing experience, including leadership responsibilities.
* Experience managing and developing marketing teams, including coaching employees, establishing performance expectations, and coordinating cross-functional marketing initiatives.
* Demonstrated success developing and executing integrated marketing strategies, brand positioning initiatives, consumer engagement programs, and go-to-market campaigns.
* Experience building and growing consumer brands within the outdoor, powersports, apparel, sporting goods, or adjacent industries.
* Strong understanding of consumer behavior, market research, brand management, and the application of consumer insights to marketing strategy.
* Excellent communication, presentation, and interpersonal skills, with the ability to influence stakeholders and collaborate effectively across organizational functions and levels.
* Strong strategic thinking and analytical capabilities, including experience evaluating marketing performance, managing priorities, and making data-informed decisions.
* Experience leading global or multi-market marketing organizations, managing athlete, ambassador, sponsorship, or event marketing programs, and familiarity with digital marketing channels and consumer-direct business models preferred.
* Passion for powersports, outdoor recreation, or technical apparel industries preferred.

jobs.title: Community & Brand Manager
jobs.description:
**Community & Brand Manager**
=============================

**Company:** CyberNut

**Reports to:** CEO and VP of Marketing

**Location:** Los Angeles preferred (in-office; finding someone in LA is our ideal scenario). Remote within the US considered.

**Travel:** Frequent travel across the country to customer sites, school districts, and K-12 conferences

**Type:** Full-time

**About CyberNut**
------------------

CyberNut is a fast-growing K-12 cybersecurity startup protecting more than 1 million students and staff across hundreds of school districts. Schools are one of the most targeted sectors for phishing and ransomware, and most security training was built for corporate boardrooms, not classrooms. We built CyberNut for schools.

Our platform trains teachers, staff, and students to spot phishing, scams, and account compromise as they happen, not once a year. Districts get automated, always-on phishing simulations themed to the tools schools actually use, one-click threat reporting right from the inbox, and short, gamified lessons that take minutes instead of hours. Our squirrel mascot, acorn rewards, and school leaderboards have turned security training into something staff and students actually talk about.

**About the role**
------------------

We are looking for a Gen Z or millennial content creator who lives on social media and wants to build a brand people genuinely root for. You have native experience building, publishing, and creating content on TikTok, Instagram, and LinkedIn, and you know what makes people stop scrolling.

This is a boots-on-the-ground role at a fast-growing startup. You will travel around the country to meet our districts, show up at conferences, film content on site, and turn customer love into customer engagement. You will be part community builder, part brand ambassador, and the voice and face of CyberNut on social.

Why it exists: many of our districts like the brand as much as they use the platform. Leaderboards get posted, swag gets worn at conferences, and IT directors call themselves "a CyberNut school." Nobody on the team is accountable for growing that energy on purpose. This role owns it.

You will report directly to our CEO and our VP of Marketing, and work closely with Customer Success.

**What you will own**
---------------------

Your time will split roughly across three areas: brand activation (about 35%), community and engagement (about 35%), and brand, social media, and content (about 30%). The split will flex by quarter.

### **1. Brand activation in every district**

Buying CyberNut is not the same as being a CyberNut school. Activation is the work of making the brand visible, felt, and owned inside a district, and it looks different for a 2,000-student rural district than for a 40,000-student suburban one.

* Build an activation plan for every new customer during onboarding, alongside their Customer Success Manager: who the champion is, where the brand will show up (staff kickoff, hallways, the IT newsletter, the board meeting), which program launches first, and what the district will be proud of in 90 days.
* Track the activation level of every existing account (dormant, launched, visible, owned), review the lowest tier with Customer Success each month, and bring a plan to move each account up.
* Create and ship the activation kit: launch decks for staff meetings, mascot and poster assets, leaderboard displays for IT offices and staff lounges, email templates for superintendents and principals, and swag for the first winners.
* Run the launch moment. The first leaderboard reveal or the first trophy delivery should be an event, not an email.
* Tailor the plan to each district. A single champion IT director needs a different plan than a district with a cabinet-level sponsor. The goal is the same: staff say "we're a CyberNut school" without being prompted.

### **2. Community and engagement**

* Run competitive leaderboard programs across customers: district vs. district, school vs. school, department vs. department. For example, a fall "Phish Bowl" where 25 districts compete on report rate for six weeks, with sponsored prizes and a trophy that travels.
* Design and ship recurring promotions and events: Cybersecurity Awareness Month kits, end-of-year awards, a "first 90 days" challenge for new customers, and a winter swag drop for top performers.
* Build and host customer community calls to learn which gamification loops drive the most excitement and engagement: a customer call where IT directors share what worked, and an online community space.
* Partner with Customer Success on low-engagement accounts. When participation is flat, you bring the activation play (a leaderboard launch, a principal challenge, a superintendent shout-out) instead of another reminder email.
* Make engagement visible outside the district. A school that climbs the leaderboard sees itself celebrated on CyberNut's channels the same week.

### **3. Brand ambassador, social media, and content**

You own CyberNut's social channels. We want CyberNut showing up everywhere: TikTok, Instagram, and LinkedIn. What Duolingo did with its owl, we want you to help us do with our squirrel.

* Own the company social accounts on TikTok, Instagram, and LinkedIn with a weekly content calendar you run. Marketing sets brand guidelines and campaign priorities; you create, film, and publish the day-to-day content, about 4 to 5 posts a week, most of them built from what customers are doing.
* Bring the CyberNut squirrel to life as a personality people follow, with recurring formats, trends, and moments that make the mascot recognizable well beyond our customers.
* Get on camera. Film on site at districts and conferences, try new formats, and do fun, creative things that push the brand forward.
* Own the swag program end to end: what we make, who earns it, how it ships, and the budget. Think limited editions for top performers and referrers, not giveaways for everyone.

**POSITION****SUMMARY:**
========================

The Marketing & Communications Coordinator develops and executes integrated communications, marketing, digital media, and community engagement strategies that strengthen Kodiak Community Health Center (KCHC) internally and externally. The position serves as a central resource for organizational communications, brand management, media relations, digital and social media content, community outreach, and strategic partnerships. The Coordinator creates timely, engaging, and accessible content; strengthens communication with employees, patients, partners, and the broader Kodiak community; builds alliances that advance KCHC’s mission and visibility; and uses data and community feedback to improve communications and marketing efforts. The role works closely with the CEO, leadership team, providers, staff, and community partners to ensure KCHC is visible, connected, responsive, and consistently represented across all communication channels.

* Develop, implement, and maintain an integrated communications, marketing, and community engagement strategy aligned with KCHC’s mission, strategic priorities, services, and growth goals.
* Serve as a central coordinator for internal communications, helping ensure employees receive timely, clear, and consistent information regarding organizational priorities, initiatives, events, accomplishments, operational updates, and other important matters.

* Maintain a proactive content calendar and regularly identify creative communication opportunities rather than relying solely on requests from departments or leadership.
* Work directly with providers, employees, and leadership to identify stories, accomplishments, programs, services, and personalities that can be highlighted internally and externally.
* Manage and regularly update KCHC’s website and other public-facing digital platforms, including provider information, services, events, news, patient resources, and organizational information.
* Develop targeted marketing campaigns to increase awareness and utilization of KCHC services, promote providers and programs, communicate access opportunities, and support organizational growth and patient engagement.

jobs.description:
Chervon is one of the world’s largest power tool and outdoor power equipment manufacturers with a rich history of innovation. Chervon’s commitment to build a better world by building better tools is evident in the products we manufacture and our green approach to manufacturing. We design, engineer and market power tools and outdoor power equipment within our brand portfolio- EGO, FLEX and FLEX and for other highly respected private brands. With world-class R&D, design, manufacturing, supply chain, marketing, sales, and service teams throughout the world, we do it all.

**Summary of Responsibilities**

The Channel Manager is responsible for driving profitable share growth across the entire market by managing the development of the channel harmonization strategies. This includes developing pricing and promotional strategies across channels that deliver top line sales and bottom-line profit with efficient utilization of working capital.

Brand Responsibility: EGO

Channel Responsibility: Key Channels including Home Centers, Hardware, Construction Supply, STAFDA, and E-Commerce.

**Key Job Responsibilities**

*National Promotions*

* Develop and execute the promotional strategy to drive demand and share gains for our national brands and minimize channel conflict.
* Develop a Pro Forma based approach to analyze promotional plans.
* Develop reporting to manage, track and analyze key data to measure promotional effectiveness and set KPIs.
* Attend product line reviews with major channel partners to strategize and present Chervon’s national and channel specific strategies.
* Analyze and track inventory, market share and competitive landscapes.

*Channel Promotions*

* Work with channel/customer to identify, develop, and implement channel/customer specific programs – channel promotions, strategic programs, events, etc.
* Support promotional plans to manage excess inventory at a customer level.
* Review Pro Forma financials, discuss channel conflicts and work through solutions with Sales, Brand and Product Development teams.

*Product Pricing Strategy*

* Determine market-based pricing strategies to stimulate sales to maximize share while managing profitability and channel harmonization.
* Align with Brand Managers and Product Management to ensure the right selection, positioning and pricing strategy for current products and new product launches at a SKU level.
* Work with the back-end Brand Business Management (BBM) team and senior leadership teams to create a Pro Forma reporting to analyze pricing scenarios.
* Monitor online marketplaces via third party vendor to protect the integrity of our brands in the digital space.
* Manage price changes as necessary driven by current business conditions from inflation to tariffs, from freight expense to competitive threats.
* Work with BBM team develop pricing files for all brands, including MSRPs; troubleshoot anomalies.
* Work with BBM team to maintain channel price files.
* Align with Sales teams and Back End Account Management (BEAM) teams in Nanjing, China on pricing direction, alignment and execution.

*Marketing Support*

* Align pricing and promotional strategies with Brand Managers.
* Working with the Brand Management teams, support the planning and marketing execution to drive the promotional success both online and in-store.

**Required Education and Experience**

* A bachelor's degree in business or equivalent and at least 5 years of proven success as a channel manager, account manager, or other related experience.
* Experience in building and successfully executing product pricing strategies within the retail environment
* Appreciates and thrives within an entrepreneurial environment
* Experience with sales performance metrics reporting and analytics
* Excellent communication skills
* Team management skills
* Strong analytical and organization skills
* Fluency in key business measures – sales, gross margin, etc.
* Demonstrated ability to manage multiple projects
* Salary Range: $115k to $145k base + bonus opportunity

**Travel**

This position requires up to 15% travel. International travel may be required on occasion.

**Work Environment**

Chervon North America operates in a casual and fun environment. Our North American headquarters is located one block from I-88 in a state-of-the-art LEED certified facility with high-end amenities such as a gourmet café, gym, outdoor terrace, landscaped patio, ergonomic height-adjustable desks, and open collaborative spaces. We offer a very competitive benefits package including health, dental, vision, short/long-term disability, life insurance, parental leave, a generous 401(k) match, an open PTO program and a hybrid work environment.

**Farmer Group | Cortland, NY (Hybrid, 3 days/week in office) | Full-time, Exempt**

**Pay range:** $65,000 to $85,000 per year

**About Us**

Farmer Group is a fast-growing cannabis company and the home of five in-house brands: Florist Farms, Head & Heal, Blotter, Tune, and Hudson. We take pride in being a legitimate, well-run company in an industry where that's often missing, and we're looking for people who want to grow with us.

**The Role**

We're looking for an organized, collaborative Brand Manager to bring our brands to life. Reporting to the Brand Director, you'll turn brand priorities into well-run projects. You'll work closely with Sales, Creative, Product Development, and Production to deliver the materials and support our teams need.

The role combines marketing project management, brand content, retail merchandising, and vendor coordination. If you like bringing structure to a busy environment, communicate clearly, and see projects through from first brief to final delivery, we'd like to hear from you.

* Track marketing spend against plan, report regularly, and recommend priorities to the Brand Director

At The Hershey Company, our culture is rooted in purpose and inspired by Milton Hershey’s enduring vision that business should create opportunity for others. Through our commitment to corporate philanthropy, we create positive impact by supporting communities, helping children thrive, and operating as a business for good. This includes our deep and long standing partnership with Milton Hershey School, where we invest in education, workforce readiness, and hands on engagement to help students succeed beyond the classroom. At The Hershey Company, our culture is rooted in purpose and inspired by Milton Hershey’s enduring vision that business should create opportunity for others. Through our commitment to corporate philanthropy, we create positive impact by supporting communities, helping children thrive, and operating as a business for good. This includes our deep and long standing partnership with Milton Hershey School, where we invest in education, workforce readiness, and hands on engagement to help students succeed beyond the classroom. Supported by strategic grantmaking, product donations, cross brand collaboration, and strong employee volunteerism, Hershey offers a place to work where making a difference—locally and globally—is part of how we do business every day.

**About The Hershey Company**

The Hershey Company is an industry-leading snacks company known for making more moments of goodness through its iconic brands. With a strong portfolio across chocolate, confectionery, and salty snacks, Hershey delights consumers every day. Our beloved brands include Hershey’s, Reese’s, KitKat®, Dots Pretzels, Lesser Evil, Jolly Rancher, Twizzlers, Ice Breakers, and more.

  

At Hershey, we are committed to making a meaningful difference in the communities where we live, work, and do business. This commitment originated with our founder, Milton Hershey, and continues to shape who we are today.

  

Guided by our employee value proposition, Lead Today. Create Tomorrow, we empower our people to drive impact now while shaping what comes next. The Hershey Company is proud to be recognized as a top employer in the United States, reflecting our commitment to our people, culture, and purpose.

**How will you fit in the big picture?**
----------------------------------------

Kit Kat is one of the world’s most recognizable and distinctive brands, and this role will shape both what the brand stands for and how the business grows. * Own the brand’s performance narrative through disciplined tracking, business analysis, and forecasting; identify drivers, risks, and opportunities and mobilize cross-functional action to deliver business objectives
* Collaborate closely with the Commercial team to translate brand strategy and annual plans into customer- and channel-relevant programs, ensuring execution pulls through to drive conversion at the moment of choice.

**Experience:**

Initially built to take the pain out of peer-to-peer payments, Cash App has gone from a simple product with a single purpose to a dynamic ecosystem, developing unique financial products, including Afterpay/Clearpay, to provide a better way to send, spend, invest, borrow and save to our 50+ million monthly active customers.
