jobs.description:
Description

Regional Media Buyer — Paid Media

Description

At Xe, we live currencies. We provide a comprehensive range of currency services and products, including our Currency Converter, Market Analysis, Currency Data API and quick, easy, secure Money Transfers for individuals and businesses. We leverage technology to deliver these services through our website, mobile app and by phone. Last year, we helped over 300 million people access information about the currencies that matter to them and over 225,000 people used us to send money overseas.

About This Role

We are looking for a Regional Media Buyer to build, launch, and optimise paid media campaigns for your assigned region. This is a hands-on execution role at the core of how Xe acquires customers. Day to day, you will be inside the platforms — building campaigns, managing budgets, and tracking performance across Google Ads, Meta Ads, TikTok Ads, and Apple Search Ads.

Xe runs paid media as a centralised, best-practice-led function. That means you will not be inventing your own way of doing things in isolation: you will execute against shared briefs, campaign structures, and naming conventions, apply the standards the global paid media team sets, and keep your region's setup consistent with the rest of the business. Your value is in flawless, fast, and accurate execution — campaigns that go live correctly, budgets that pace to plan, and data that everyone can trust.

We believe in using AI to optimise how we work. We want someone who is AI-forward — using it to build smarter systems and integrations, speed up competitor research, and take the manual weight out of execution and reporting — while keeping their own judgment firmly in the driver's seat. AI is a tool that makes a sharp buyer sharper; it is not a substitute for understanding the platforms, the data, and the strategy behind the work.

You will report to the Global Manager of Paid Media and work closely with the other regional buyers, as well as with design, analytics, and the wider marketing team. This is a strong role for someone early in their paid media career who wants to go deep on execution across every major channel and grow within a global team.

OUR PRINCIPLES

AMBITION - We dream big, try things out and always ask "why not?" and "what if?" We're ambitious in our thinking and our delivery.

RESPONSIBILITY - We get involved, bring our perspective, and are always open to new ideas. We take personal responsibility.

COMMUNITY - We value a sense of belonging, trusting each other and encouraging authenticity. We contribute to our community.

Roles & Responsibilities

Building & Executing Campaigns

Build, launch, and manage paid campaigns across Google Ads (Search, Performance Max, Display, and YouTube), Meta Ads, TikTok Ads, and Apple Search Ads for your assigned region.
Set up campaigns to the shared standard — consistent structures, naming conventions, tracking, and audience/keyword configuration — so your region's account is clean, organized, and easy to read.
Write and traffic ad copy, keywords, audiences, and creative assets into each platform, and coordinate with design to get the assets you need on time.
Turn briefs from the global paid media team into live, correctly configured campaigns, and get them to market quickly and accurately.

Optimization & Best Practices

Stay current on platform changes, new ad formats, beta features, and best-practice updates across Google, Meta, TikTok, and Apple Search Ads, and put them into practice in your accounts.
Run day-to-day optimization — bids, budgets, audiences, keywords, negatives, placements, and creative rotation — to improve performance against targets.
Support and execute structured tests (creative, audience, bidding, landing page) and document what you learn so it can be applied across regions.
Flag opportunities and risks early and bring ideas for what to try next.

Working AI-Forward

Use AI tools to work faster and smarter — drafting and iterating ad copy, generating and analyzing competitor research, summarizing performance data, and taking the repetitive work out of setup and reporting.
Look for ways to build AI into your systems, integrations, and workflows so your region runs more efficiently, and share what works with the wider paid media team.
Apply your own judgment to everything AI produces — validating outputs, sense-checking against the data, and owning the final decision. We want AI accelerating your work, not doing your job for you.

Budget Management

Manage and pace campaign budgets to plan — monitor daily and weekly spend, avoid over- and under-delivery, and reallocate within your region as performance dictates.
Keep accurate records of spend by channel and campaign, and reconcile against the plan.
Escalate pacing issues, budget shortfalls, or unexpected cost changes promptly.

Data Tracking & Reporting

Own accurate tracking for your campaigns — UTMs, conversion tracking, and correct tagging — so results are measured cleanly and consistently.
Pull performance data from each platform and Xe's reporting tools, and maintain clear, up-to-date reporting on the metrics that matter (spend, CAC, conversions, and channel efficiency).
Use the shared measurement framework and metric definitions so your region's numbers line up with the rest of the business.
Surface insights from the data — what's working, what isn't, and what you'd change — in regular reporting to the Global Manager of Paid Media.

Position Requirements

1–3 years of hands-on experience building and managing paid media campaigns, ideally in-house or at an agency.
Direct, in-platform experience with at least two of Google Ads, Meta Ads, TikTok Ads, and Apple Search Ads, and the appetite to become strong across all four.
Comfortable building campaigns from scratch — structures, keywords/audiences, ad copy, and tracking — and keeping accounts organized and consistent.
Solid understanding of paid media fundamentals: bidding, budgeting, audience targeting, and the core metrics (CPC, CPA/CAC, ROAS, conversion rate).
Experience managing and pacing campaign budgets, with a careful, detail-oriented approach to spend.
Comfortable working with data: pulling performance reports, setting up conversion tracking and UTMs, and reading results accurately.
Highly organised and reliable, able to manage multiple live campaigns at once and follow shared processes and standards closely.
Eager to keep up with a fast-changing landscape and put new platform features and best practices into use.
AI-forward: you actively use AI tools to speed up execution, research, and reporting, and to build better systems and integrations — while relying on your own judgment to check the output and make the calls.
Strong communicator who can report clearly on performance and collaborate across a distributed team.
Experience with Google Analytics, Looker, or similar reporting/BI tools is a plus.
Experience in fintech, payments, financial services, or another regulated, multi-market business is a plus.

Perks & Benefits

401K Plan with Match
Employee Stock Purchase Plan
Paid Vacation / Sick Leave
Hybrid Work Schedule

Growth Opportunities
Corporate gatherings, team bonding events, and much more!

Spanning Growth, Consumer Marketing, Enterprise Marketing, Brand & Creative, the team is focused on expanding Coursera’s reach, attracting new learners and enterprise customers, and building a lifecycle marketing system that supports learners throughout their careers.

As a Senior SEO Manager, you will contribute to organic growth by increasing Coursera’s visibility across search engines, AI-powered search experiences, and emerging discovery platforms. You will own and evolve SEO strategy for key areas of Coursera’s platform, collaborating with cross-functional teams to improve discoverability, engagement, and conversion throughout the learner journey.

Prioritize and execute SEO roadmap, driving content, technical, and programmatic SEO initiatives with measurable impact
Partner with the SEO Content team, organic social, and paid media to optimize and scale discovery, aligned to user intent and business goals
Act as an SEO subject matter expert, partnering with cross-functional teams to drive adoption of best practices across marketing, product, and content work-streams
Lead technical SEO initiatives (indexing, site performance, structured data, crawl optimization) and measure impact, partner with Product and Engineering teams to incorporate SEO into platform development, site architecture, and user experience
Establish reporting to track visibility, traffic, engagement, and conversion, and communicate insights to stakeholders

7+ years of experience managing SEO programs in-house for large-scale websites, marketplaces, or platforms
Experience leading technical SEO initiatives in partnership with engineering teams
Experience using SEO & data platforms (e.g., Google Search Console, Screaming Frog, Ahrefs, Semrush, Looker, Tableau, Google Analytics) to analyze performance and identify opportunities
Demonstrated history of influencing cross-functional stakeholders and driving measurable impact through SEO initiatives

Preferred Qualifications:

Experience optimizing for additional discovery surfaces beyond web search (e.g., app stores, social platforms, or marketplaces)
Experience using AI-driven search tools and methods for analysis and optimization (e.g.: Profound, Promptwatch)
Experience driving SEO strategies for large content catalogs or programmatic page generation
Experience optimizing international or multi-language websites, including localization strategy and regional search considerations
Experience partnering with product, content, or growth teams to integrate SEO into roadmaps and workflows
Experience using data tools or languages (e.g., SQL, Python, BI tools) to support analysis and experimentation

If this opportunity interests you, you might like these courses on Coursera:

Marketing Analytics
The Power of Team Culture

jobs.description:
About Legence

Legence (Nasdaq: LGN) is a leading provider of engineering, consulting, installation, and maintenance services for mission-critical systems in buildings. The company specializes in designing, fabricating, and installing complex HVAC, process piping, and other mechanical, electrical, and plumbing (MEP) systems—enhancing energy efficiency, reliability, and sustainability in new and existing facilities. Legence also delivers long-term performance through strategic upgrades and holistic solutions. Serving some of the world’s most technically demanding sectors, Legence counts over 60% of the Nasdaq-100 Index among its clients.

Content Development & Social Media Manager

Reports to: Vice President, Marketing, Legence
Position Type: Direct-Hire / Full-Time
Location: Remote; Ability to Travel up to 10%

Position Overview

Legence is seeking an experienced Content Development & Social Media Manager to lead the development and activation of compelling content across Legence and its portfolio of Business Unit brands.

This is a highly collaborative, hands-on role for a strong writer, storyteller, and social media strategist who can translate complex technical expertise, projects, and business priorities into clear, engaging content for a range of audiences and channels.

This individual will help bring consistency and scale to social media across a multi-brand organization. They will partner closely with Business Unit marketing contacts, subject matter experts, executives, creative resources, communications, and the enterprise marketing team to strengthen the visibility of Legence and its companies while preserving the distinct expertise and voice of each brand.

Experience within construction, engineering, architecture, consulting, energy, the built environment or another complex B2B industry is strongly preferred.

Key Responsibilities

Content Strategy & Development

Develop high-quality content that strengthens the visibility, reputation, and market positioning of Legence and its Business Units.
Proactively identify compelling stories, projects, expertise, trends, and perspectives from across the enterprise and turn them into meaningful marketing content.
Write and edit content across a variety of formats, including:
Website and landing page copy
Thought leadership articles
Case studies and project profiles
Social media content
Executive and subject matter expert thought leadership
Email and digital campaigns
Industry and end-market content
Marketing collateral
Video scripts and supporting copy
Press releases
Campaign messaging

Interview executives, technical leaders, subject matter experts and project teams to develop credible, differentiated content.
Translate complex engineering, construction, maintenance, sustainability, energy, and technical concepts into clear, compelling stories for both technical and nontechnical audiences.
Repurpose strong content across multiple formats and channels to extend its value and reach.
Maintain editorial quality and ensure content reflects appropriate voice, messaging and brand standards while recognizing the distinct identities of individual Business Units.
Partner with marketing, communications, and creative teams to identify opportunities for integrated campaigns and storytelling.

Social Media Strategy & Management

Help lead and execute social media strategy across Legence and supported Business Unit brands, working alongside the communications team who leads culture, recruiting, and investor related content.
Develop and maintain editorial calendars in collaboration with Business Unit marketing contacts, communications, and enterprise stakeholders.
Manage the development, review, approval, scheduling, and publishing of social content.
This role is not managing direct reports or a team.
Draft and edit social copy spanning corporate and industry content, projects, thought leadership, services, and Business Unit stories.
Adapt content appropriately across Legence and Business Unit channels while maintaining alignment with enterprise brand and messaging standards.
Manage day-to-day social media workflows using Sprout Social and Asana.
Coordinate with creative resources on social graphics, photography, video, and other visual assets.
Support employee advocacy and amplification programs designed to expand the reach of Legence and Business Unit content.
Monitor social channels, comments, messages, mentions and relevant industry conversations, escalating issues when appropriate.
Identify opportunities to amplify strong Business Unit stories across enterprise channels.

Campaigns & Digital Content

Partner with the broader marketing team to develop integrated content campaigns supporting priority markets, services, business initiatives and growth objectives.
Develop content that can be activated across social, web, email, thought leadership and other digital channels.
Support campaign development and execution through HubSpot, where appropriate.
Collaborate with marketing and Business Unit teams on targeted thought leadership and campaigns tied to services and priority market sectors.
Apply SEO and emerging AI-search/GEO best practices to digital content to strengthen discoverability.
Identify opportunities to extend the life and value of content by strategically repurposing it across audiences, brands and channels.

Analytics & Optimization

Track and evaluate content and social performance to understand which topics, formats and channels generate the strongest engagement and results.
Use insights from Sprout Social, web analytics, HubSpot, and other available platforms to continuously improve content strategy.
Evaluate performance across content categories, formats and Business Units.
Translate data and performance trends into clear recommendations for future content, campaigns and channel strategy, aligning with Legence’s Data and Analytics Manager.

Qualifications

Required

5–8 years of professional experience in content development, content marketing, social media, digital marketing, communications, or a related discipline.
Exceptional writing, editing and storytelling skills, with a portfolio demonstrating the ability to communicate complex subjects clearly and compellingly.
Demonstrated experience developing content for multiple formats, audiences, and digital channels.
Hands-on experience managing corporate or B2B social media channels and editorial calendars.
Strong understanding of how content, social media, and digital channels work together to build brand visibility and support broader business objectives.
Excellent project management and organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple simultaneous priorities and deadlines.
Strong interpersonal skills and the ability to develop productive relationships across functions, businesses, and levels of an organization.
Ability to work independently, proactively identify opportunities, and move projects forward without extensive direction.

Preferred

Experience within construction, engineering, architecture, consulting, energy, sustainability, commercial real estate or another technical B2B environment.
Experience working within a multi-brand, multi-business or decentralized enterprise organization.
Experience supporting multiple businesses with different audiences, priorities, and levels of internal marketing support.
Experience with Sprout Social or a comparable enterprise social media management platform.
Experience with Asana or another enterprise work management platform.
Experience with HubSpot or comparable marketing automation technology.
Familiarity with web CMS platforms, SEO, AI search/GEO principles, digital analytics and content performance measurement.
Experience developing executive and subject matter expert thought leadership.
Experience supporting employee advocacy or social amplification programs.
Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Communications, Journalism, English, Public Relations or a related discipline, or equivalent professional experience.

Compensation

Suggested salary range: $115,000-$130,000

Benefits Overview

Currently match contributions dollar-for-dollar up to 4% of eligible pay; immediate vesting.

Health & Welfare Benefits:
Employer provided medical, dental, vision, prescription drug, Employee Assistance Program and accident & illness coverage.

Life and Disability Insurance
: Employer provided basic life insurance and AD&D valued at 50K coverage amount with the option for voluntary buy up for additional coverage.

Time Off:
Flexible non-accrual vacation; company holidays per policy. (For California employees, this is separate from California paid sick leave, if applicable.)

Expenses

Position Overview

Riviera Dining Group is seeking a creative, visually driven, and highly organized Social Media Manager to oversee social media execution across its hospitality brands. This role requires a strong understanding of social media, nightlife culture, luxury hospitality, and visual storytelling, with the ability to capture compelling content and translate live experiences into engaging digital narratives.

The ideal candidate is equally comfortable managing online communities, capturing on-site content, curating photoshoots and video shoots, and collaborating with internal teams to ensure key events, offerings, and activations are effectively communicated and promoted across social platforms. This individual must also demonstrate strong communication and critical thinking skills, proactively identify opportunities for improvement, and confidently bring forward strategic proposals and solutions that support business objectives.

Key Responsibilities

Social Media & Community Management

Manage daily community engagement across assigned brand social media accounts, including responding to direct messages, comments, tags, and guest inquiries in a timely and professional manner
Maintain each brand’s unique tone of voice, visual identity, and digital presence
Actively engage with influencers, DJs, tastemakers, industry professionals, and relevant local communities to build brand awareness and strengthen online engagement
Monitor social media activity, identify relevant trends, and participate in timely conversations that align with each brand

On-Site Event Coverage & Content Creation

Attend on-site events, activations, and special events to capture real-time social content

Identify compelling moments, details, and experiences that translate into engaging Instagram Stories, Reels, and other social-first content
Publish timely, engaging Stories and live updates during events while maintaining each brand’s established visual direction

Photoshoot & Video Shoot Curation

Collaborate on the ideation, planning, and execution of photoshoots and video shoots across assigned brands
Develop creative concepts, mood boards, visual references, shot lists, and content direction in collaboration with the creative, social media, and production teams
Identify content opportunities that support upcoming campaigns, seasonal initiatives, menu launches, brand storytelling, and key promotional moments
Coordinate shoot requirements, including shot priorities, styling references, location considerations, and required deliverables
Ensure all produced content aligns with brand guidelines, creative direction, and the intended aesthetic of each venue
Review captured assets and collaborate with the creative team to identify the strongest selects for social media use

Content Planning & Promotional Coordination

Manage the timely development and execution of social media content calendars across assigned brands
Proficiency in scheduling platforms, managing content calendars, and ensuring posts are scheduled accurately and published on time
Collaborate with the graphic design, video, and project management teams to ensure consistent communication and promotion of key activations, special events, collaborations, and announcements
Ensure promotional messaging, announcements, lineup releases, and supporting creative assets are aligned across relevant social media platforms and published according to established timelines
Proactively communicate upcoming promotional priorities and content needs to ensure all key events and initiatives receive appropriate social media support
Manage content ideation, trend research, caption writing, and creative planning
Maintain an organized content library, ensuring assets are properly labeled, uploaded, and accessible to the wider team
Ensure content calendars and scheduled posts are maintained and updated in accordance with team workflows and deadlines

Editing & Creative Execution

Edit short form video content for Instagram Reels, and other social platforms using Adobe Premiere Pro, CapCut, and other relevant editing tools
Apply strong visual judgment when selecting footage, editing sequences, incorporating transitions, and adapting content to platform specific formats
Ensure all content maintains a cohesive visual identity, appropriate pacing, and a high standard of quality
Collaborate with videographers, photographers, and graphic designers to refine assets and deliver polished, on-brand content
Stay current on editing techniques, trending formats, and creative tools to enhance the quality and relevance of social content

Strategic Thinking & Development

Proactively identify opportunities to improve social media performance, audience engagement, brand visibility, and the overall digital presence of assigned brands
Bring forward well considered proposals, creative concepts, and actionable solutions that support business objectives and enhance brand performance
Apply critical thinking to assess challenges, evaluate opportunities, and recommend effective approaches to social media strategy, content execution, and promotional initiatives
Collaborate with internal teams to identify opportunities for event promotion, brand partnerships, audience growth, and increased guest engagement
Communicate recommendations clearly, support ideas with relevant insights or performance data when available, and follow through on approved initiatives
Stay informed about industry trends, competitor activity, and emerging opportunities relevant to luxury hospitality and nightlife

Performance & Reporting

Monitor social media engagement, reach, views, and audience growth across assigned accounts
Identify high-performing content formats and opportunities to improve engagement and audience development
Contribute insights and recommendations to monthly social media reporting and future content strategies
Evaluate the performance of event promotions, creative campaigns, and content initiatives to inform future planning

Qualifications & Skills

3-5 years of professional social media management experience, preferably within hospitality, nightlife, luxury lifestyle, or entertainment
Strong understanding of Instagram, including Stories, Reels, short form video, and algorithm best practices
Familiarity with nightlife culture, events, and the hospitality landscape
Scheduling tools: Proficiency in scheduling platforms, managing content calendars, and ensuring posts are scheduled accurately and published on time
Deadline management: Ability to manage competing priorities, meet deadlines consistently, and deliver high-quality work within established timelines
Content planning: Reinforced accountability for organizing and scheduling content and campaign assets
A keen visual eye with a strong understanding of aesthetics, composition, lighting, and storytelling
Ability to manage competing priorities, meet deadlines consistently, and deliver high-quality work within established timelines
Ability to confidently capture high quality content using an iPhone, as well as a professional camera
Experience capturing content in dynamic, fast paced, and low light environments
Proficiency in Adobe Premiere Pro and familiarity with editing and creative tools such as CapCut and Canva
Experience curating photoshoots and video shoots, developing creative concepts, and translating brand direction into visual content
Excellent communication and critical thinking skills, with the ability to articulate ideas, collaborate effectively across teams, and approach challenges with sound judgment
A proactive, solutions-oriented mindset with the ability to recognize opportunities, develop strategic proposals, and recommend actionable improvements that support business goals
Strong project coordination skills and the ability to align promotional efforts across multiple teams and priorities
Excellent written communication skills and the ability to adapt to different brand voices
Strong organizational skills, attention to detail, and the ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines
Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, high-pressure environment, adapt quickly to last-minute changes, and maintain a high standard of work under pressure

Ability to work flexible hours, including evenings, weekends, holidays, and peak event periods, as required

Job Description Summary

The Director of Growth Marketing is a member of WPI's in-house team of experts in marketing strategy, messaging, creative, social media, multimedia, and production management. Under the direction of the AVP of Marketing Communications and in collaboration with campus partners, this team leads WPI's integrated brand strategy and the campaigns that support it. With a heavy focus on student enrollment, the Director of Growth Marketing leads strategy and execution of demand generation initiatives that drive awareness, inquiries, and student pipeline growth across undergraduate and graduate studies and pre-collegiate programs.

Job Description

Growth Strategy

Lead the university's enrollment growth marketing strategy across the full student acquisition funnel, driving awareness, audience acquisition, inquiries, engagement, and pipeline growth through integrated multichannel campaigns, digital nurture programs, and performance optimization across paid, owned, experiential, and CRM-enabled channels.
Develop and lead pre-college engagement and retention strategies that cultivate long-term enrollment pipelines, progressing students from WPI middle school and high school programs toward undergraduate inquiry, application, and enrollment.

Drive innovation through experimentation, testing, and evaluation of emerging channels, technologies, and audience engagement strategies to improve enrollment marketing performance.

Lead planning, execution, optimization, and performance management of enrollment marketing campaigns in partnership with Creative and Digital Operations teams.
Lead strategy for enrollment marketing platforms and third-party lead generation ecosystems (e.g., Niche, CollegeVine, U.S. News & World Report), maximizing visibility, engagement, and ROI.
Drive continuous improvement of enrollment marketing assets and campaign experiences in partnership with Creative and Digital Operations teams.
Work with partners in Admissions to design and optimize CRM-enabled nurture programs and omnichannel student journeys that improve engagement, conversion, and enrollment outcomes.

Experiential & Partnership Marketing

Lead recruitment-focused experiential marketing initiatives, including conferences, competitions, trade shows, robotics events, and other strategic activations.
Manage external marketing partnerships and sponsorships that support prospective student engagement and enrollment growth.

Leadership & Cross-Functional Collaboration

Lead a team of two marketing professionals, cultivating talent, collaboration, high performance, and a data-driven culture focused on growth and measurable outcomes.
Lead cross-functional planning and execution across Admissions, Marketing Communications, Creative, Digital Operations, university stakeholders, agencies, and vendors to deliver integrated enrollment marketing initiatives and measurable business outcomes.

Represent the Marketing team in leadership settings and in interactions with stakeholders within the campus community.
Provide direction, prioritization, and performance oversight across enrollment marketing campaigns, initiatives, and investments.
In partnership with the Creative Director and aligned with the university brand, ensure consistent application of positioning and messaging across recruitment marketing initiatives.

Data, Analytics & Performance

Use analytics, attribution, and performance insights to optimize marketing investment and campaign effectiveness.
Monitor and report regularly on funnel performance, inquiry growth, campaign ROI, and pipeline contribution.
Establish testing frameworks and performance benchmarks across creative, audience targeting, messaging, and conversion strategies.
Use AI-enabled tools and predictive insights to improve targeting, personalization, operational efficiency, and enrollment marketing outcomes.
Performs all other duties and responsibilities as assigned or directed by the supervisor.

Qualifications

Bachelor's degree required.
A minimum of eight years of progressive experience in growth marketing, enrollment marketing, demand generation, or related marketing disciplines, including at least three years of supervisory experience.
Demonstrated success leading enrollment and growth marketing initiatives that drive measurable awareness, inquiry generation, lead acquisition, engagement, and enrollment pipeline growth.
Proven ability to develop and execute data-informed marketing strategies across paid, owned, experiential, CRM-enabled, and marketing automation channels.
Experience with CRM and enrollment marketing platforms, including Salesforce, Slate, lead generation ecosystems, marketing automation technologies, audience segmentation, nurture campaigns, and prospective student journey development.
Strong analytical, strategic thinking, and problem-solving skills, with experience using analytics, attribution, AI-enabled tools, and performance insights to optimize marketing effectiveness and operational efficiency.
Demonstrated ability to influence and lead cross-functional teams and initiatives within complex organizations.
Excellent written, verbal, interpersonal, presentation, and stakeholder management skills.
Strong project management and organizational skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities, budgets, agencies, sponsorships, external partners, and marketing investments.
Proven experience in higher education.
Agency, consumer, or direct-to-consumer marketing experience preferred.

Social Media Marketing Manager - Contract Role

Overview

The Social Media Marketing Manager (Contract) will be responsible for developing and executing social media strategies to enhance brand awareness, foster customer engagement, drive online reviews, and support business objectives. This hands-on role requires a creative, resourceful, and results-driven professional who can operate within a fast-paced environment, leveraging low-cost platforms and cost-efficient tactics to maximize impact for a small company.

Key Responsibilities

Strategy Development: Design and implement a comprehensive social media strategy aligned with Lavu’s goals and budget, focusing on platforms such as Instagram, TikTok, Facebook, Linkedin, Google reviews and X to increase brand visibility, customer engagement.
Content Creation & Scheduling: Produce or oversee the creation of compelling content (e.g., posts, videos, stories) that resonates with target audiences. Schedule posts for optimal engagement, serving as a designer, copywriter, or content curator as needed.
Audience Engagement: Monitor and respond to comments, messages, and mentions within 24 hours to build community, address inquiries, and foster customer loyalty.
Advertising Campaigns: Manage targeted paid ad campaigns, optimizing for cost-efficiency and achieving a strong return on investment (ROI) within Lavu’s budget constraints.
Analytics & Reporting: Track and analyze performance metrics (e.g., reach, engagement, conversions) using platform analytics and tools like Google Analytics. Provide monthly reports with actionable insights to refine strategies.
Trend Awareness: Stay current on social media trends, platform algorithms, and emerging features (e.g., Instagram Reels, X Spaces), incorporating viral formats and innovative tactics to enhance campaign performance.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

The Success Of The Social Media Marketing Manager Will Be Measured By The Following SMART KPIs, Tailored To Lavu’s Objectives And The Contract’s Temporary Nature

Strategy Execution:

Deliver a documented social media strategy targeting 2-3 platforms with defined goals (e.g., 10-15% increase in brand awareness and making sure we have a minimum of 12 new 4.5 ave Google reviews each month).
Achieve a 10-15% increase in brand awareness metrics (e.g., follower count, impressions, mentions) by contract end.

Content Performance:

Publish 3-5 high-quality posts per week per platform, with an average engagement rate of 3-5% per post.
Produce 12-20 posts monthly per platform, with 50% original content and 50% curated or repurposed.

Audience Engagement:

Maintain a 90% response rate to comments and messages within 24 hours.
Increase Google reviews by 15-25% through social media prompts.

Paid Advertising:

Assist with the paid advertising team’s needs.

Analytics & Insights:

Submit monthly performance reports at month-end, including 2-3 actionable recommendations.
Drive a 10-15% increase in website traffic from social media referrals.

Trend Integration:

Incorporate 1 trending format or feature monthly, achieving 20% higher engagement than average posts.

Provide 1-2 trend updates or training sessions per quarter to the team.

jobs.title: Director of Marketing
jobs.description:
What We Do

Build the insurance behind the physical world.

The world is building data centers, energy projects, hospitals, schools, and critical infrastructure. Every one of those projects needs insurance to move forward. Yet the process of getting that insurance still depends on scattered documents, manual work, and weeks of back-and-forth.

Shepherd is rebuilding commercial insurance with software, data, AI, and deep underwriting expertise. We started in construction and energy, where understanding the specifics of a project matters and better decisions have consequences far beyond a screen.

We develop insurance products, decide which risks to insure and how to price them, and partner with established insurers to back the coverage. We own the platform our team uses to turn complex submissions into coverage for the builders and operators shaping the world around us.

Real problems. Real ownership.

Our engineers, designers, underwriters, and actuaries build together. The problems span turning messy documents into reliable data, making pricing more precise, and designing AI agents that can take on increasingly complex underwriting work.

The ambition is a platform where experts spend more time on judgment and relationships, supported by software that handles the work around them. Join us to build systems whose decisions help real projects get built.

630+ customers / $500B+ insured project value

Our investors

Capital to build. Partners to grow with.

$67M total funding / $42M Series B in March 2026

Shepherd is backed by Intact Private Capital, Costanoa Ventures, Spark Capital, Susa Ventures, and Y Combinator. In March 2026, we announced a $42M Series B led by Intact Private Capital, bringing our total funding to $67M.

Intact is also a capacity partner. Alongside its investment, Intact works with Shepherd to bring insurance products to market. That relationship connects our platform and underwriting expertise with the resources of a global insurer.

A bigger opportunity ahead

We are investing in new insurance products, our underwriting team, and the path toward autonomous underwriting. For the people joining Shepherd, that means the chance to shape both the technology and the business it makes possible.

Our backing brings together investors who build technology companies and partners who understand insurance. We are building a company that earns the confidence of both.

Director of Marketing

About The Role

As Director of Marketing, you will own how Shepherd reaches and engages commercial insurance brokers, both online and in person. Brokers are our distribution channel, and marketing in commercial insurance has historically been limited. We think there's an opportunity to do things differently.

You'll build our brand, develop content that brokers actually want to engage with, and run events that bring the right people together. You'll work closely with underwriting, business development, and leadership to make sure our marketing programs are reaching the right brokers and ultimately driving more submissions.

This is a hands-on role. You'll set the strategy, run programs yourself, experiment with new ideas, and build the team as we grow.

In This Role, You Will

Field marketing and events

Build our events program, from smaller broker dinners and roundtables to roadshows and activations at major industry conferences.
Work with underwriting and business development to identify the right brokers, offices, and markets to target.
Create repeatable event playbooks that our teams can run across different regions, with clear follow-up and measurement.
Come up with new ways to bring brokers together and give them a reason to spend time with Shepherd.

Content and digital marketing

Own our content strategy across LinkedIn, email, newsletters, and other channels where we can reach brokers.
Work with underwriters and other subject matter experts to create content that's useful, interesting, and relevant to our audience.
Build campaigns that keep Shepherd top of mind with brokers, whether they've never worked with us or submit regularly.
Experiment with different formats and channels, measure what works, and double down on the ones that drive engagement.

Brand marketing

Build Shepherd's brand in the commercial insurance market, particularly among the brokerages and producers we want to work with.
Develop creative campaigns that help us stand out from traditional carriers and MGAs.
Own how Shepherd shows up across our events, content, campaigns, and other marketing channels.
Find new ways to get Shepherd in front of the right audience, beyond the standard insurance marketing playbook.

Measurement and team

Work with revenue operations and analytics to measure the impact of our programs, from broker engagement to first submission and repeat submissions.
Own marketing priorities, budgets, and reporting. Know what's working, what's not, and where we should invest more.
Hire, coach, and grow the marketing team, and manage the agencies and vendors behind our programs.

About You

You're a marketing leader who wants to build something from the ground up. You've run successful events, built brands, and developed content that gets people to pay attention. You understand how marketing can support a relationship-driven business, and you can point to programs you've built and the results they produced.

You're creative, but you're also an operator. You like coming up with ideas, and you care just as much about getting them done. You're excited by the opportunity to do your best work in an industry where there's still a lot of room to try something new.

You'd be a great fit if you have:

8+ years in B2B marketing, including experience owning programs or leading teams at a high-growth company.
A track record of building and running field marketing programs, including proprietary events, conferences, and other in-person activations.
Strong content marketing experience, including developing content strategies and growing engagement across digital channels.
Good brand instincts. You know what makes a company stand out, and you've helped build a brand that people recognize and trust.
Experience marketing to a professional audience, particularly in a business where relationships matter.
A data-driven approach. You set goals, measure results, and change course when something isn't working.
Creativity, hustle, and strong execution. You come up with ideas, do the work to bring them to life, and aren't afraid to try something that hasn't been done before.
AI-native working habits. You use AI tools to move faster, produce content, and find better ways to run programs.
Experience in insurance, insurtech, fintech, construction tech, or another B2B industry is a plus, but not required.

How we work

Shepherd runs on four values. Here's what each one means in this seat.

Think big, build big. We exist to protect progress and the industries that rely on it. The work here is aimed at a system that runs on its own, and the roadmap gets sequenced backward from that rather than forward from what's easy.
Win together. We rise as one. We support each other, raise the bar, and celebrate collective success. Come set a standard the rest of the team inherits.
Cross the aisle. Collaboration wins. We listen deeply, work across boundaries, and prioritize shared success over individual lanes. The best product calls here come from engineers who've sat with underwriters and underwriters who understand where the model breaks, and much of this job is listening closely enough on both sides to make that happen.
Go get it. We act with urgency, move with confidence, take smart risks, and push forward with intention. Nobody hands you the roadmap, the data, or the meeting invite. You pull the failing runs, book the time with the underwriters, and decide what matters.

Benefits

🏥 Premium Healthcare

100% contribution to health, dental, and vision

🥕 Fertility benefits and family building support

🏖️ Flexible PTO

Flexibility to take the time off, recharge, and perform

🥗 Daily lunches, dinners, and snacks

We work together, and enjoy meals together too

🖥️ SF, NYC, Dallas-Fort Worth, Chicago and LA Offices

📚 Professional Development

Access to premium coaching, including leadership development

401(k) Plan

🐶 Dog-friendly office

This role will be key in the successful execution of U.S. Lubricants and its family of brands commercial and strategic marketing plans. The Marketing Specialist II will turn sales priorities, supplier programs, product information, and customer needs into clear, well-executed initiatives. This individual must be an organized, commercially minded storyteller who brings demonstrated communication excellence, strong business acumen, creativity, and cross-functional follow-through to improve the customer and team member experience.

This position can be based onsite in Baltimore, Maryland or Appleton, Wisconsin.

Job Responsibilities

Commercial Program Execution

Coordinate commercial programs from launch through completion, including objectives, timelines, owners, deliverables, communications, and results tracking.
Support supplier, product, pricing, customer retention, and sales growth initiatives across U.S. Lubricants.
Maintain a centralized calendar and tracker for promotions, product launches, price changes, supplier commitments, sales campaigns, and customer communications.
Partner with Sales and Finance to track program participation, volume, revenue, gross margin, and return on investment.
Identify execution gaps, follow up with owners, and escalate risks that could affect customers, suppliers, or financial results.

Sales Enablement & Communications

Develop clear sales communications, talking points, FAQs, presentations, customer letters, sell sheets, and other field-ready materials.
Translate supplier updates, product changes, pricing actions, operational constraints, and company priorities into concise messages for sales teams and customers.
Maintain an organized library of current sales tools, product materials, templates, and program resources.
Support sales meetings, business reviews, training sessions, customer events, and supplier presentations.
Gather feedback from the field and improve tools and communications based on seller and customer needs.

Marketing & Content Support

Coordinate with the corporate Marketing team to execute targeted B2B campaigns supporting customer acquisition, retention, cross-sell, and product growth.
Draft and edit email campaigns, web content, product announcements, case studies, internal updates, and customer-facing communications.
Ensure materials are accurate, consistent with brand standards, and approved by the appropriate business partners.
Coordinate outside vendors when needed for design, print, promotional materials, or events.
Support content planning for priority industries, products, suppliers, and customer segments.

Reporting & Continuous Improvement

Build and maintain simple dashboards and recurring reports showing program activity, adoption, pipeline influence, volume, revenue, gross margin, and results.
Use CRM, ERP, survey, and campaign data to identify trends and recommend practical improvements.
Document repeatable processes, templates, and standard work for commercial programs and communications.
Manage project details independently while keeping stakeholders informed of progress, decisions, and risks.
Cultivate U.S. Venture’s values while inspiring, empowering, recognizing, and guiding team members.
Live our values of High Performance, Caring Relationships, Strategic Foresight, and Entrepreneurial Spirit.
Find A Better Way by championing continuous improvement and quality control efforts to identify opportunities to innovate and improve efficiency, accuracy, and standardization.
Continuously learn and develop self professionally.
Support corporate efforts for safety, government compliance, and all other company policies and procedures.
Perform other related duties as required and assigned.

Qualifications

Required:

College degree in Business, Marketing, Communications, or equivalent experience.
2 to 4 years of experience in B2B marketing, sales enablement, commercial operations, program coordination, communications, or a related role.
Demonstrated ability to manage cross-functional projects with multiple deadlines and stakeholders.
Outstanding interpersonal skills, self-direction, project management skills, and strong business acumen.
Excellent writing, editing, proofreading, presentation, and verbal communication skills.
Ability to interpret sales and financial information, including volume, revenue, gross margin, and program performance.
Experience using Excel, PowerPoint, Word, Teams, Outlook, and other MS Office applications.
Strong attention to detail, follow-through, judgment, and organizational skills.
Ability to work independently and remotely.
Experience with CRM systems, marketing automation, project management tools, Canva, and dashboard reporting is preferred.

jobs.title: Senior Social Media Marketing Specialist
jobs.description:
At ArenaNet, we’ve always believed that games are art. They have the power to communicate ideas and tell stories. They can change the way we think, reflect our cultures, and move us. As the developer of the award-winning Guild Wars game series, we’re proud to share our passion for the online worlds we’ve created with over 21 million players worldwide.

ArenaNet develops and publishes games for every kind of person, which means our games need to be built by every kind of person. We believe the best experiences come from working together, celebrating differences, and helping each of our team members shine.

We are looking for a creative, strategic, and highly engaged Senior Social Media Marketing Specialist to bring the world of Guild Wars to life across social platforms. In this role, you'll own and execute social media strategies that connect with players, celebrate our community, and grow the franchise's reach and engagement.

You'll combine creative storytelling, hands-on content creation, and data-driven insights to develop compelling, platform-native content that resonates with gaming audiences. From producing engaging TikToks and YouTube videos to identifying emerging trends and amplifying player-generated content, you'll play a key role in shaping how Guild Wars shows up across social media.

Working closely with our Brand, Creative, Community, and Marketing teams, you'll help bring campaigns, game updates, and franchise moments to life while ensuring our social presence remains authentic, relevant, and connected to our players.

What You'll Do

Own and execute social media strategies across TikTok, YouTube, Instagram, Facebook, X, and emerging platforms, tailoring content and engagement strategies to each audience.
Develop platform-specific content plans that reflect franchise priorities, player interests, cultural trends, and the Guild Wars brand voice.
Create engaging social-first content, including gameplay clips, memes, short-form videos, behind-the-scenes features, and franchise storytelling.
Concept, script, shoot, edit, and publish video content for TikTok, YouTube, and other social platforms.
Engage with the Guild Wars community, identify trending conversations, and curate and amplify player-generated content.
Partner with Brand, Creative, Community, PR, and Marketing teams to support campaigns, game updates, live events, and creator and influencer activations.
Brief internal creative teams and external agencies on content requiring additional production support, providing creative direction and managing vendor budgets as needed.
Monitor social media performance, audience engagement, platform trends, and algorithm changes to continuously refine content strategy and improve results.
Ensure social content meets accessibility, localization, and brand standards across platforms.
Participate in an on-call rotation to support time-sensitive communications and emergency messaging as needed.
Travel several times per year for industry events and other business needs.

What We're Looking For

Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Communications, or a related field, or an equivalent combination of education and experience.
4+ years of relevant professional experience (5+ preferred), including at least 3 years in social media management and 2 years in game development or publishing.
Proven experience building, growing, and engaging audiences on TikTok and YouTube.
Hands-on experience creating, shooting, and editing social-first video content.
Strong understanding of social media platforms, algorithms, internet culture, creator ecosystems, and emerging content trends.
Ability to develop channel strategies, identify target audiences, establish success metrics, and create content that drives engagement.
Experience analyzing social media performance data and translating insights into actionable improvements.
Strong creative storytelling, copywriting, editorial judgment, and video content development skills.
Proficiency with video editing tools such as Adobe Premiere Pro, CapCut, or mobile-native editing applications.
Ability to independently produce engaging content using a smartphone or lightweight production equipment.
Experience providing creative direction and collaborating with internal production teams, agencies, or external partners.
Ability to translate game content, player sentiment, and community conversations into engaging, platform-native storytelling.
Strong collaboration and communication skills, with the ability to manage competing priorities and work effectively across teams.
Knowledge of gaming culture, MMO communities, and player engagement.

NICES TO HAVE

Familiarity with the broader Guild Wars franchise.
Experience working with gaming creators, influencers, or online gaming communities.
Fluency in French, German, Spanish, or Korean.

This role is remote-friendly, but we are currently prioritizing candidates who are local to the Bellevue, WA area and open to occasional onsite collaboration.

Pay Range: $97,702 - $146,569

Please note that the pay range listed in this job posting reflects the full salary range for this position. While we provide this range to offer transparency, our target hiring range typically falls between the minimum and the midpoint, allowing room for growth potential within the role.

Total compensation includes base salary plus annual bonus potential. We strive to provide competitive and equitable compensation packages to all our employees.

This role is also eligible for medical, dental, vision and life insurance, short and long term disability, 401(k), flexible and dependent care spending accounts, PTO, paid holidays and parental leave.

Thriveworks is one of the leading mental healthcare companies in the USA, with over 2,800 employees, founded by and still led by clinicians. We have recently launched a new vision to become America's most valued mental healthcare company—where our teams can fulfill their purpose and do their best work, where clients are treated with warmth and respect, and where communities benefit from access to high-quality care that helps them heal and thrive in life. Thriveworks is committed to providing accessible, top-tier mental health services through a network of licensed therapists and mental health professionals. As we enter this exciting new chapter, our mission remains focused on helping people live happier, healthier lives through both in-person and online counseling services.

About The Job

We're looking for a Senior Performance Marketing Manager to join our marketing team. This is a high-ownership, high-visibility role that sits at the center of how Thriveworks grows: managing significant spend across Google, Meta, Microsoft, and emerging channels to connect people in need with the mental health care that can change their lives.

jobs.description:
Great benefits. Competitive pay. We know these are some of the things people look for in a job.

If you’re the kind of person who believes that honoring and empowering our nation’s veterans is more than just a cause — that it’s a calling — then we’re ready to meet you.

When you join Wounded Warrior Project® (WWP), you’re committing to making a difference. We make a commitment to you, too – helping you to find that spark, ignite your passion to serve, and embark on a career with meaning and purpose.

At WWP™, we recognize our mission cannot be accomplished without our talented teammates, which is why we’re proud to offer benefits such as:

A flexible hybrid work schedule (three days in the office, two days’ work from home)
Full medical, dental, and vision coverage for both teammates AND family members
Competitive pay and performance incentives
A fun, mission-focused, and collaborative team environment

A mission that matters is just the beginning, so if you’re ready to get started, we’re ready for you.

The Wounded Warrior Project (WWP) Vice President of Marketing Strategy & Audience Growth leads the development of audience-centered marketing strategies that increase awareness, acquisition, engagement, advocacy, and brand affinity across warriors, donors, supporters, and other key stakeholder groups. This role oversees audience insights, market intelligence, and integrated planning, translating research and data into strategies that advance organizational priorities and long-term growth. As a member of the Marketing & Communications leadership team, the Vice President sets the strategic direction for brand positioning, audience planning, campaign development, fundraising marketing, and program marketing. Working closely with senior leaders across the organization, this role ensures marketing efforts are aligned, audience focused, and positioned to achieve WWP goals.

DUTIES & RESPONSIBILITIES

Lead enterprise-wide audience growth strategies that increase awareness, acquisition, engagement, retention, and advocacy in support of WWP's mission, strategic priorities, recruitment objectives, fundraising goals, and brand growth.
Serve as the organization's subject matter expert on audience behavior, motivations, and emerging market trends, identifying opportunities and risks that may impact growth and relevance.
Lead the development and application of audience research, market intelligence, brand studies, and performance analytics, translating insights into strategic recommendations that improve audience growth, campaign effectiveness, and brand performance.
Establish audience segmentation frameworks, personas, and audience journey maps that inform marketing strategy, planning, and execution.
Lead integrated marketing strategy and annual planning processes, aligning audience needs, organizational priorities, and business objectives.
Provide strategic direction for major campaigns, fundraising initiatives, program marketing efforts, and enterprise-wide marketing priorities.
Partner with organizational leaders to identify opportunities and coordinate marketing strategies across audiences, channels, and stakeholder groups to maximize impact.
Guide long-term brand positioning strategies that strengthen awareness, trust, and relevance among key audiences.
Partner with the Communications leadership team to ensure audience insights inform messaging, storytelling, and stakeholder engagement efforts.
Lead and develop a high-performing team responsible for audience strategy, research, planning, and growth initiatives.
Present strategic recommendations, performance results, and market insights to executive leadership and key stakeholders.
Foster a culture of innovation, accountability, continuous learning, and data-informed decision-making.
Attend and actively participate in required training and/or meetings, including but not limited to New Teammate Orientation, WWP Cares, ASIST Suicide Prevention training, Leadership training, culture/team based training, or departmental huddles.
Other related duties as assigned.

KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS, & ABILITIES

Deep expertise in audience strategy, growth marketing, brand strategy, and integrated campaign planning, with demonstrated success developing enterprise strategies that drive measurable audience growth and organizational outcomes.
Advanced understanding of audience segmentation, persona development, customer journeys, market research, and analytics, with the ability to translate data and insights into actionable recommendations.
Ability to develop cohesive enterprise strategies across marketing, communications, digital, content, and external engagement.
Strong executive presence with demonstrated success influencing senior leaders, Board members, and external partners and building consensus across complex stakeholder groups.
Exceptional critical thinking, strategic judgment, and problem-solving abilities, with the ability to balance long-term vision and practical execution.
Excellent written and verbal communication, facilitation, and presentation skills, with the ability to convey complex strategies and insights clearly to executive, Board, and stakeholder audiences.
Proven ability to lead through change, navigate ambiguity, prioritize competing opportunities, and allocate resources toward the highest-value initiatives.
Strong leadership, coaching, talent development, and team-building skills.
High emotional intelligence and cultural competency, with demonstrated sensitivity to military and veteran experiences.
Demonstrated commitment to ethical leadership, accountability, collaboration, and organizational stewardship.
Passion for mission-driven work and the ability to translate audience insights and marketing strategy into meaningful impact for warriors and their families.
Unequivocal commitment to the highest standards of personal and business ethics and conduct.
Mission-driven, guided by core values, and a pleasure to work with.

jobs.description:
Oak View Group

Oak View Group (OVG) is the global leader in premium live entertainment infrastructure and services, with a platform spanning venue development and end-to-end capabilities across venue management, hospitality, and sponsorship sales. Founded in 2015, the company serves a collection of seven world-class owned venues and a client roster of the most iconic arenas, stadiums, convention centers, music festivals, performing arts centers, and cultural institutions, spanning four continents.

Position Summary

Oak View Group is seeking a dynamic Marketing Manager
to lead promotional campaigns across Lexington's premier entertainment portfolio: Rupp Arena, Central Bank Center, the Lexington Opera House, and the OVG Concert Series at Gatton Park. This Marketing Manager position will develop, manage, and execute strategic marketing plans to ensure the success of events. The position will serve as a venue marketer, responsible for overseeing event advertising budgets, the media buying process, public relations, and grassroots promotions for concerts, family shows, and conventions.

This role pays an annual salary of $50,000 - $55,000.

Benefits for Full-Time Roles: Health, Dental, and Vision Insurance, 401(k) Savings Plan, 401(k) matching, and Paid Time Off (vacation days, sick days, and 11 holidays)

This position will remain open until December 31, 2026.

About The Venue

Lexington is an active and thriving market, craving an active and welcoming venue for events. The heart of any thriving community is its downtown—and Lexington Center and the historic Rupp Arena
are truly the heart of downtown Lexington and one of the most widely recognized entertainment venues in North America. Rupp Arena in Lexington, Kentucky, is fast becoming THE must-play venue. The 20,000-seat arena, affectionately referred to by some as “the Cathedral of College Basketball," is home to the National Champion University of Kentucky men’s basketball program and has played host to some of the most talented and award-winning musicians/artists in the world, including U2, Paul McCartney, Elton John, Justin Timberlake, Kenny Chesney, Taylor Swift, and many others.

Central Bank Center is our convention side, with over 99k sf of exhibition space, 24k sf each of meeting and ballroom space, 50k of hospitality space, 10k sf of flexible space, and over 2500 covered and uncovered parking spaces. Both venues are additionally joined in entertaining this area by the Lexington Opera House, showcasing Broadway talent through collaborative bookings of Broadway shows, small venue concerts, and local arts.

CommonSpirit Health Stage at Gatton Park is a 5,000-capacity outdoor venue located in the center of Lexington. From live music and stand-up comedy to unforgettable experiences set against a stunning park backdrop in the center of the city.

Founded in 2021, Lexington Sporting Club is an American professional soccer team based in Lexington, KY. The soccer complex off Athens-Boonesboro Road near I-75 opened in August 2024 in time for the organization’s first USL Super League season.

Responsibilities

Conceptualize, develop, and execute comprehensive marketing campaigns to promote concerts, comedy shows, theater productions, and live events at Rupp Arena, the Lexington Opera House, Central Bank Center, and the OVG Concert Series at Gatton Park
Develop and implement creative cash/trade proposals with media partners, including digital, radio, print, TV, and outdoor
Create and maintain collaborative relationships with local media partners, promoters, tour marketers, and community partners to ensure fully aligned event campaigns
Explore and execute cross-marketing opportunities throughout the community and execute grassroots marketing, including but not limited to ticket giveaways, on-site activations, and third-party partnerships
Manage internal marketing assets, oversee digital displays and marquee messaging, and maintain the venue website
Manage event advertising budgets, oversee the media buying and billing process, and implement multi-channel advertising strategies
Draft, distribute, and follow up on press releases, pitching feature stories to local and regional media for upcoming events and venue initiatives
Conceptualize and collaborate on social media campaigns, email and SMS marketing, and promotions to drive ticket sales and fan engagement
Track, analyze, and compare event ticket sales information, adjusting digital targeting parameters and overall efforts based on gathered analytics from previous events
Prepare post-show recaps and manage post-event survey evaluations to measure attendee feedback and analyze venue operations
Research and follow current venue and event marketing trends, implementing best practices in day-to-day activations
Recruit and manage marketing interns and part-time employees
Perform other duties as assigned

Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree from an accredited college or university or equivalent work experiences
3-5 years of previous event or entertainment marketing experience preferred
Intermediate to strong knowledge of Adobe Creative Suite
Strong knowledge of social media platforms (Facebook, Instagram, X, TikTok, etc.)
Demonstrated proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite
Basic photography and videography skills with proficiency in editing images/videos using the following software: Adobe, Canva, and CapCut
Independent decision-making skills; ability and knowledge to apply judgment in resolving problems of moderate scope and complexity
Highly organized, resourceful, quick learner, and able to handle multiple projects simultaneously
Ability to prioritize and meet deadlines
Must be adaptable with the ability to work under pressure to meet deadlines
Must be able to work a flexible schedule inclusive of weekends, nights, and holidays required
Frequent bending, lifting objects, sitting, exposure to multiple external elements, extensive walking through the building

Strengthened by our Differences. United to Make a Difference

At OVG, we understand that to continue positively disrupting the sports and live entertainment industry, we need a diverse team to help us do it. We also believe that inclusivity drives innovation, strengthens our people
, improves our service
, and raises our excellence
. Our success is rooted in creating environments that reflect and celebrate the diverse communities in which we operate and serve, and this is the reason we are committed to amplifying voices from all different backgrounds.

Equal Opportunity Employer

Oak View Group is committed to equal employment opportunity. We will not discriminate against employees or applicants for employment on any legally recognized basis (“protected class”) including, but not limited to veteran status, uniform service member status, race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, physical or mental disability, genetic information or any other protected class under federal, state, or local law.

Marketing Manager - Las Vegas Resident Shows

Sales, Marketing & Communications

Full-Time Position

Cirque du Soleil Entertainment Group (“CDSEG”) is seeking a dynamic and results-driven Marketing Manager to lead promotional and strategic marketing efforts for our Las Vegas resident shows.

Reporting to the Director of Marketing, this role is responsible for developing, executing, and optimizing integrated marketing strategies that drive awareness, engagement, and ticket sales. The ideal candidate is a creative thinker with strong analytical skills, thrives in a fast-paced entertainment environment, and is passionate about storytelling and audience growth.

Key Responsibilities

Strategic Planning & Execution

In collaboration with the Director of Marketing, and Senior Director of Marketing & Brand, define and implement the annual marketing strategies for Cirque du Soleil Las Vegas resident shows
Develop and oversee comprehensive marketing plans to reach both visitor and local audiences, maximizing visibility across traditional, digital, and experiential channels
Monitor performance against KPIs, proactively adjusting strategies to meet revenue and attendance goals within approved budget parameters
Identify new opportunities and innovative marketing tactics to test and refine throughout the year

Market & Media Oversight

Serve as the in-market marketing lead, providing ongoing assessments of visibility, competitive positioning, and new opportunities across Las Vegas
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to optimize media and advertising for maximum ROI and implement initiatives to support short-term and long-term growth opportunities
Manage agency relationships and oversee campaign execution, including creative production, trafficking, and performance analysis

Partner with the creative teams to maintain the integrity of each show’s brand identity while innovating on-market creative approaches
Lead the development of new advertising materials, print, digital, video, out-of-home, and experiential, to ensure consistent storytelling across all platforms
Collaborate on photo/video shoots, in-market activations, and content initiatives supporting seasonal campaigns and special events

Partnerships & Collaboration

Foster strong working relationships with property and partner marketing teams to align campaigns, cross-promotions, and on-property visibility
Ensure compliance with all partnership agreements and coordinate approvals as needed

Budget & Administration

Manage annual marketing and media budgets for assigned shows, including forecasting, accruals, and invoice processing
Track and evaluate campaign results, compiling post-campaign recaps and actionable insights for leadership
Oversee vendors and production schedules to ensure timely and cost-effective delivery of assets

Additional Duties

Represent Cirque du Soleil’s Resident Shows Division at select industry, partner, or community events
Support cross-show portfolio marketing initiatives when applicable
Complete all other job-related duties as assigned

Qualifications & Skills

Bachelor’s Degree in Marketing, Communications, Business, or related field
At least 3 years of marketing experience, preferably in entertainment, hospitality, or live events
Proven track record managing integrated marketing campaigns from strategy to execution
Strong analytical, project management, and presentation skills
Excellent communication and relationship-building abilities across all organizational levels
Experience managing external agencies and cross-functional teams
Proficient in Microsoft Office and comfortable analyzing data to inform strategy
Knowledge of Las Vegas market and visitor trends is highly preferred
Ability to work flexible hours and occasionally attend events or activations on evenings and weekends
Fluent in English, both written and spoken
Verification of the right to work in the United States for Cirque du Soleil Entertainment Group, as demonstrated by completion of the Form I-9 upon hire and the submission of acceptable documentation (as noted on the Form I-9) verifying one’s identity and work authorization

As you can imagine, working with a circus can be quite different from other organizations, and at Cirque du Soleil Entertainment Group, we embrace these differences loudly with enthusiasm. We realize that one size fits none and invite you to come create your own specialized experience with us to see exactly what we’re talking about, firsthand.

Our emotion-provoking shows are just the tip of the iceberg: laced throughout our organization, you will find creative minds who are empowered to use their voices and be themselves, their truest selves. Diversity to us means various perspectives, fresh ideas and continuous improvement of the way we do things. We won’t pretend like we have every answer, that’s why we need you! The employees here are the center of what we do, the voices behind the final product and amazing performances on stage.

When you think of your ideal workplace, what comes to mind? For us, it looks (and really is) like this:

Teamwork - we thrive with collaborative teams, regardless of titles or departments;
Respect - when we ask someone to join our team, it’s because we trust and respect you;
Integrity - whether you work behind-the-scenes or in the office, you’re being counted on. We are a team and integrity goes a long way here, and like we mentioned previously, trust is important;
Authenticity - we want you to bring your full self to work, this is a place where you don’t need to fit into a box to belong; diverse perspectives foster even more creativity in the workplace. We embrace the human behind the employee number;
Being heard - you have access to everyone in the organization, use your voice on development questions or suggestions on how to improve the experience. We value open and transparent communication, and we want you to be heard!

Description

About Us: Born in artistry, built for real life, and fueled by a global community, Morphe delivers high-performance, high-design beauty without the prestige price tag. Leveraging exceptional product development, regulatory, and supply chain capabilities, we make innovative products that invite creativity and celebrate the freedom to look how you want, when you want. Join us in shaping what’s next in beauty.

Summary of Position
The Senior Manager, Social Media sets the strategic vision for our social presence, building an ownable, unmistakable brand point of view across every channel and translating it into a content system the team can execute against day to day. This role strategically programs content, develops ownable content series and a distinct aesthetic, and keeps the brand consistently ahead of trend and culture. The Senior Manager owns performance rigor across the social portfolio, leads the brand’s expansion into new channels including YouTube and Pinterest, and manages a team of two. This is a strategy-first role with a clear path to Director within two years for the right candidate.

Principle Accountabilities

Set and own cross-channel social strategy across Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, Pinterest, and emerging platforms, translating brand and marketing priorities into a distinct, ownable social point of view.
Strategically program content: develop ownable content series, franchises, and a consistent aesthetic that build brand recognition over time, not one-off posts, and keep them evolving as trends, formats, and culture shift.
Push the brand consistently on trend and cultural relevance, spotting content opportunities and white space before they peak, and coaching the team to move on them quickly and confidently.
Build out and scale the brand’s YouTube and Pinterest strategies, and lead early strategic thinking on a future Reddit presence.
Manage, coach, and develop a team of two direct reports, the Social Media Manager and Social Creative Manager, setting clear priorities, giving regular feedback, and building each of their growth paths.
Own performance rigor: track TY/LY (this-year vs. last-year) KPIs across every channel, ensure the team consistently delivers against agreed metrics, and turn results into next actions and resourcing decisions.
Partner cross-functionally with Marketing, Influencer, Creative, and Retail teams to keep brand voice and campaign moments consistent across owned and earned channels.
Own strategy recaps and performance reporting up to leadership, translating data into a clear narrative on what’s working and what’s next.
Represent social strategy in cross-functional planning, ensuring social has a seat at the table for major launches, campaigns, and brand moments.

Key Working Relationships

Direct reports: Social Media Manager and Social Creative Manager.
Cross-functional partners: Marketing, Influencer Marketing, Creative Services, Copy, and Retail/commercial teams.
External: content creators, agency partners, and platform partners as needed.

Required Skills & Experience

5+ years of social media marketing/strategy experience, including at least 1–2 years directly managing people. Beauty or CPG industry highly preferred.
Demonstrated experience building ownable content series, franchises, or a distinct brand aesthetic that scaled over time.
