jobs.description:
Entry-Level Sales & Marketing Assistant

Location:
Chicago, IL
Employment Type:
Full-Time | Face-to-Face

About Soul Society

At Soul Society, we help brands grow by connecting them directly with people. We specialize in face-to-face sales, customer acquisition, and brand marketing, creating opportunities for businesses to reach new customers through engaging, personalized conversations.

Our approach is built around communication, relationship-building, and results. We believe successful sales start with understanding people, communicating value, and creating positive customer experiences.

As we continue to grow, we’re looking for an ambitious individual who wants to develop their sales skills, contribute to campaign performance, and build a rewarding career in a people-focused, results-driven environment.

The Role

We’re looking for a confident, motivated Entry-Level Sales & Marketing Assistant to join our Chicago team.

This is a hands-on, customer-facing sales role suited to individuals who enjoy meeting new people, starting conversations, and turning customer interest into action.

You’ll represent partner brands through face-to-face marketing campaigns, introduce products and services to potential customers, explain their benefits, and help generate new business. You’ll work towards campaign objectives while developing the communication, sales, and customer acquisition skills needed to succeed in a competitive marketplace.

No previous sales experience is required. We provide training and ongoing support to help you learn our approach, build confidence, and develop your abilities.

If you’re motivated by meeting people, improving your sales skills, and seeing the results of your efforts, this could be the opportunity for you.

What You’ll Be Doing

Generate new customers:
Engage potential customers through direct, face-to-face conversations and introduce them to relevant products, services, and offers.
Drive sales and conversions:
Communicate product benefits, address questions, overcome objections professionally, and encourage customers to take the next step.
Represent leading brands:
Act as a professional brand representative during in-person marketing campaigns and promotional activities.
Build customer relationships:
Establish trust through effective communication, active listening, and a customer-focused approach.
Work towards targets:
Contribute to individual and team sales objectives, customer acquisition goals, and campaign performance.
Develop sales techniques:
Learn how to approach customers, identify their needs, present solutions, and improve conversion rates.
Collaborate with the team:
Share insights, learn from experienced colleagues, and contribute to a motivated, performance-focused team environment.

Who We’re Looking For

We’re interested in people with the drive to learn, the confidence to communicate, and the determination to achieve their goals.
You may be a great fit if you are:
Confident approaching and speaking with people face-to-face.
Interested in sales, persuasion, marketing, and customer acquisition.
Motivated by achieving goals and improving your performance.
Resilient, positive, and comfortable learning from feedback.
Able to communicate product information clearly and professionally.
A team player who also takes ownership of personal development.
Available to work full-time, with flexibility for occasional evenings and weekends where required.

Previous experience in sales, retail, hospitality, customer service, or other customer-facing roles can be beneficial, but it isn’t essential. We value ambition, a strong work ethic, and a willingness to learn.

What Soul Society Offers

Sales training and development:
Build practical skills in customer engagement, sales conversations, objection handling, and customer acquisition.
Performance-based incentives:
Competitive weekly pay and additional performance incentives.
Career development opportunities:
Develop your commercial skills and explore potential progression into senior sales, team leadership, and campaign management.
A dynamic working environment:
Spend your workday interacting with people rather than being tied to a desk.
A supportive team:
Learn alongside people who value collaboration, personal growth, and shared success.
Transferable skills:
Gain experience in communication, negotiation, relationship-building, and business development.

Ready to Build Your Sales Career?

If you enjoy talking to people, thrive on new challenges, and want to develop skills that can open doors to future opportunities, we want to hear from you.

Join Soul Society and take the first step towards building your career in face-to-face sales and customer acquisition.

How to Apply

Please submit your application with an up-to-date email address and phone number. Our recruitment team aims to contact suitable applicants within 1–3 business days.

jobs.title: Head of Marketing (Creator Economy)
jobs.description:
Job title:
Head of Marketing (Creator Economy)
Company:
HotDrop
Workplace type:
Remote
Employment type:
Part-time
Seniority:
Mid-Senior level

About HotDrop

HotDrop is a social platform built for the creator economy. Creators use it to keep their communities together, show their work and connect with each other. Fans use it to stay close to the creators they support.

Every creator gets a Circle, a home for their community that connects to their Twitch and YouTube. Around it, HotDrop gives creators a feed, stories, messaging, and a Site and media kit they can share with brands and collaborators. HotDrop is live on iOS, Android and the web, with Reels and a desktop app coming by the end of the year.

The product is built. What HotDrop needs now is someone who knows how to get creators and their communities to show up, and to keep coming back.

The role

You’ll own HotDrop’s marketing from day one: the strategy, the voice and the hands-on work. This isn’t a role where you hand things off to an agency or a team. You’ll run our social channels yourself, shape how we pitch HotDrop to creators and fans, and lead our launches.

You’ll work directly with the founder and our Head of Creator Growth. They bring creators onto the platform; you make sure those creators’ audiences hear about HotDrop, want to join and have a reason to stay.

What you’ll do

Social and content
Run HotDrop’s social accounts day to day, including X, TikTok, Instagram and YouTube
Turn what’s happening on HotDrop (creators, communities, moments, milestones) into content people want to share
Build a consistent HotDrop voice and look across every channel

Launches
Own our launches, starting with Reels and our desktop app later this year
Line up creators before each launch, seed the content and drive the launch itself
Plan campaigns that bring past users back when there’s something new to see

Creators and their communities
Help creators invite their audiences into their HotDrop Circles: what they say on stream, what they post in their Discord and on social, and when
Write the playbooks and assets that make inviting easy for creators: templates, clips, graphics and talking points
Work with our Head of Creator Growth on our creator programs

Positioning
Sharpen how we explain HotDrop to creators and to fans
Keep our website, emails, app store pages and social posts telling the same story
Shape and promote the HotDrop Twitch show with the founder

Measurement
Track what brings people in and what keeps them coming back
Double down on what works and cut what doesn’t, quickly

What success looks like

More new people arriving each week, and more of them staying. Within your first 90 days, you’ll have:

Taken over HotDrop’s social channels and set a regular posting rhythm
Shipped a creator invite playbook our pilot creators actually use
Led at least one launch from planning through results
Set up a simple weekly view of what’s bringing people in and what’s keeping them

What we’re looking for

You’ve grown an audience or a community yourself, whether a channel, a brand account or a creator’s following, and you can show the results
You know the creator economy from the inside. You understand how streamers, YouTubers, mods and fans think, and what makes a creator promote something to their audience
You’ve done hands-on social and growth work, not just strategy
You write well and fast, and you can make short-form video and graphics or get them made
You’re comfortable building from scratch at an early-stage startup, with a small team and a lot of ownership
You’re self-directed: you’ll set your own priorities week to week and tell us what you need

Nice to have

Experience at a creator platform, a gaming company, a creator agency or an esports organization
Experience on Twitch or in gaming communities
Experience running app launches or growth campaigns for a consumer app
Connections with creators, mods or community managers

How we work

Remote, 10 to 20 hours a week, scheduled around your other commitments
You’ll work directly with the founder, with real say over what we do
We move quickly, ship often and decide based on what we learn

Compensation

This role is paid in equity. There’s no cash salary at this stage, and that’s why we’re looking for someone who wants to own a meaningful piece of what they help build. Equity vests over time, and we’ll share the specifics in our first conversation.

How to apply

Apply with Easy Apply and answer the two screening questions. We care more about what you’ve built than about your resume.

HotDrop is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome applicants of every background, identity and experience.

Range depends on skill level and overall experience.

A Little Bit About Us:
You might know us from our founder and CEO, Dave Ramsey, who's given no-nonsense money advice on the radio since 1992. Three decades later, Ramsey Solutions is a household name in personal finance, with a mission to change the toxic money culture for good.

Our Mission: Ramsey Solutions provides biblically based, commonsense education and empowerment that give HOPE to everyone in every walk of life.

Here's a Taste Of Our Benefits

Health insurance (includes plans eligible for an HSA—with a company match up to $500!)
401(k) retirement plan with 4% match/company contribution
Annual wellness, counseling and grocery membership reimbursement
On-campus cafe with subsidized pricing for breakfast, lunch and coffee bar
Dependent care FSA
Tons of cultural activities, like weekly devotional, leadership development courses, Battle of the Bands, and one epic Christmas party!

Where And How You'd Work

Ramsey Solutions Headquarters is located just outside of Nashville in Franklin, Tennessee. We value our strong, unified company culture because we believe the best work is done together. That's why all of our team members work on-site under the same roof. But work-life balance is also important to us, so we offer flexible work schedules to take the stress out of appointments, family obligations and other needs that may pop up.

While every team member has a designated workspace (with an electronic sit-stand desk), our campus was designed to house a variety of unique work and play zones (e.g., quiet library space, coffee bar/lounge areas, recreational game zone, and outside/patio work and break areas).

What You'd Do In This Role

Ramsey's investing content reaches millions of people trying to build wealth the right way, and this role owns turning that message into content that stops the scroll. You'll set the strategy, content calendar, and publishing standards across Instagram, Facebook, X, and TikTok, spotting the moments worth turning into a clip and shaping the hooks, formats, and cadence that move people from casual followers to loyal fans of the brand. You'll dig into the numbers, impressions, engagement, and retention, and use what you find to sharpen the strategy in real time. And you'll be a steady hand for the Video Editors you brief, giving them clear direction so the content that goes out consistently sounds and feels like Ramsey.

You're Probably a Match If

You've grown business-focused social accounts and know how to turn content into real audience growth, not just likes.
You think like a strategist, someone who owns the plan, reads the audience, and makes intentional calls, rather than just posting content.
You've got 2+ years of experience building and growing social accounts, with a track record of content that connects with an audience.
You're comfortable in the numbers, digging into platform analytics and turning what you find into a clear next move.
You can talk about money and investing in a way that feels warm, approachable, and easy to follow, never intimidating.
You represent the brand's voice and Ramsey's investing principles clearly and consistently.
You're a self-starter who brings ideas to the table and moves things forward without needing a lot of direction.

What Winning Looks Like

Growing engagement across platforms in a way that reflects a clear, consistent content strategy, not just more posts.
Moving people from casual followers on third-party platforms to loyal fans of Ramsey's owned channels.
Turning platform data into next steps, testing new ideas quickly, and adjusting course based on results.
Building a steady rhythm for sharing insights and recommendations with stakeholders so decisions get made with the numbers in hand.
Staying ahead of platform and industry trends and explaining clearly why they matter for the strategy.
Giving Video Editors clear direction and feedback that makes their work stronger and keeps the content on brand.
Owning the final call on content decisions while staying genuinely open to input along the way.

Other Stuff To Know

We're looking for people who are passionate about our mission. This isn't just a J-O-B. We experience resistance every day because what we believe is absolutely countercultural. We actually hate debt. We actually cut up our credit cards . . . like, for real. Some of us are still fighting our way out of debt, but we aren't going back. If you don't know much about Ramsey Solutions and our founder, Dave Ramsey, we encourage you to download the Ramsey Network mobile app and consume our content.

If Ramsey Solutions sounds like a workplace where you can get excited about Mondays, apply today. We can't wait to hear from you!

jobs.title: Director, Demand Generation: Public Sector & Expanding Markets
jobs.description:
A Note On How To Reach Us

We're truly grateful that so many people have Foundant on their radar — it means a lot that our work resonates with others. That said, due to the high volume of direct messages and emails we receive, cold outreach isn't the preferred way to be considered for a role, and we're not able to prioritize applications submitted this way. To apply for open positions, please visit our careers page, which is the fastest and most effective route to being considered.

About Foundant

At Foundant, we build mission-critical software for the social good ecosystem — helping foundations, grantmakers, nonprofits, and community organizations streamline their work, strengthen relationships, and maximize their impact. We serve the giving community worldwide with a comprehensive suite of solutions spanning grant management, community foundation software, and giving analytics.

We're a unified company shaped by strong roots across our product portfolio, and we operate with intention and purpose. Our team of ~350 people across six countries is connected by a shared North Star: to be the trusted partner and strategic advisor to the communities we serve.

Where You’ll Work

As a remote-first workplace, we believe in offering flexibility and the freedom to work where it suits you best, while staying connected through technology. Our global network of talent is supported by physical office hubs and virtual collaboration, fostering a dynamic environment where innovation and growth thrive.
With office locations in Bozeman, MT, Toronto, Canada, and Dublin, Ireland, you'll be part of a globally connected team. Whether you're working remotely or from one of our office locations, you'll be contributing to a vibrant, collaborative culture focused on driving meaningful impact across the world.

What You’ll Do

Demand generation strategy & execution

Own and execute the demand generation strategy for our government and public sector segment, plus other new segments, building lists, driving MQLs and creating pipeline that consistently meets or exceeds targets
Build and run integrated, multi-channel campaigns (email, paid, events, content) tailored to segment buyer behavior and budget cycles
Bring an inventive, test-and-learn approach, piloting new channels and tactics rather than relying solely on established playbooks

Account-based marketing

Lead ABM strategy and execution for targeted accounts, including account selection, personalization at scale, and close alignment with Sales on account engagement
Partner with Sales to define and refine target account lists across assigned segments including local and state government prospects

Cross-functional partnership

Work closely with Content, Product Marketing, and Sales to ensure messaging and campaigns resonate with buyer pain points
Partner with Events on segment-focused field and virtual events, from conference presence to webinars and roundtable lunch and learns
Align with Sales and RevOps on lead scoring, channel metrics, and handoff to ensure marketing-sourced conversions

Metrics & reporting

Take a highly metrics-driven approach to pipeline generation, with fluency in attribution, funnel conversion, and pipeline efficiency reporting
Report regularly on segment performance against pipeline and revenue targets, adjusting strategy based on results
Other duties as assigned

What You’ll Need

Proven track record leading demand generation through a period of rapid company growth, ideally including experience operating through M&A or platform/product integration
History of consistently meeting or exceeding pipeline and revenue targets at a fast-growing B2B SaaS company
Strong command of account-based marketing (ABM) strategy and execution
Experience marketing B2B SaaS into government buyers, particularly at the local and state level
Highly metrics-driven, with fluency in attribution and funnel/pipeline reporting
Comfortable operating with ambiguity and building process from the ground up as a segment scales
Strong collaborator — experience working closely with Content, Product Marketing, Events, and Sales/RevOps to drive integrated demand generation
Must be legally eligible to work in the United States

Nice to have

Experience in adjacent regulated or mission-driven verticals (nonprofit, education, public sector tech)
Experience with grant management or grantmaking software, or adjacent nonprofit tech
Experience in demand generation at a rapidly growing government focused B2B SaaS company
Familiarity with public sector procurement processes, budget cycles, and messaging tailored to government stakeholders at the local and state level particularly
Relationships within government and public sector networks and associations relevant to grantmaking

What You’ll Bring To Our Team Dynamics

Strategic Thinking

Translates Foundant's North Star into a concrete strategy for scaling into government, public sector, and other emerging segments — building the playbook, list, and pipeline from scratch rather than inheriting an existing one

Performance Advancement

Sets a high bar for pipeline and revenue performance in a brand-new segment, using attribution and funnel data to catch what's working — and what isn't — before quarterly targets are at risk

Decision-Making

Uses evidence and a test-and-learn approach to make fast, well-reasoned calls on new channels and tactics in a segment with no existing playbook to fall back on

Collaboration and Learning

Builds real working relationships across Content, Product Marketing, Events, Sales, and RevOps — because a segment this new only scales if the whole team is pulling in the same direction

Why You’ll Love Working At Foundant

At the heart of everything we do is a commitment to innovation and making a positive impact. Whether you’re working on projects that empower not-for-profits, community foundations, or corporations, your contributions will help drive real-world change.
We offer competitive salary and benefits, including tuition, and lifestyle reimbursements, and bespoke mindfulness and fitness initiatives.
With our Flexible PTO policy, you’ll have the freedom to manage your time in a way that supports your personal well-being and professional success.
We’re committed to your professional and personal development. With our merger, you'll have the chance to collaborate across teams, giving you exposure to diverse ideas, expertise, and projects that span multiple industries.
As part of a larger organization, you’ll have even more opportunities to grow your career. Whether it’s exploring new roles, leadership opportunities, or shifting to a different department, we support internal mobility to help you achieve your career goals
You’ll enjoy autonomy and responsibility, empowering you to approach your work creatively and independently, fostering innovation and independent thought.
Employee recognition is a core part of our culture. When you do a great job, we make sure everyone knows about it!

Foundant is an equal opportunity employer, committed to building a diverse workforce that represents the communities we serve. We welcome and encourage applications from all qualified candidates, and will consider all applicants without regard to race, color, citizenship, religion, sex, marital/family status, sexual orientation, gender identity, Indigenous status, age, disability, or individuals who may require accommodation.

Foundant is also committed to providing accommodations throughout the interview and employment process. Accommodations are available upon request for candidates participating in all aspects of the selection process. If you have accessibility requirements during the recruitment process and require accommodation, please contact hr@smartsimple.com.

This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Social Media Marketing Manager based in United States.

We are seeking an experienced Social Media Marketing Manager to lead social media strategy, content creation, and audience growth for a leading blockchain ecosystem. In this high-impact role, you will shape the brand's digital presence, manage multiple social accounts, and develop engaging content that connects with global Web3 communities. You will transform complex technical concepts, product updates, and campaign narratives into compelling, platform-native stories that drive engagement and adoption. Working closely with leadership and cross-functional teams, you will oversee creative execution, video content, community engagement, and performance optimization. You will also leverage AI-powered tools to streamline workflows, enhance creativity, and scale content production while maintaining brand integrity. This fully remote contract opportunity is ideal for a strategic, data-driven marketer who thrives in fast-moving technology environments and understands the evolving social media landscape.

Accountabilities

Social Media Strategy and Channel Management: Develop and execute comprehensive social media strategies, primarily focused on X/Twitter, while managing and growing five or more brand accounts with consistent messaging and strategic alignment.
Growth and Performance Optimization: Establish KPIs and performance benchmarks, monitor audience growth, engagement, and conversions, and identify opportunities to improve channel performance through data-driven decisions.
Content Strategy and Creation: Translate brand positioning, technical developments, product launches, and marketing campaigns into engaging, platform-native content tailored to target audiences and community interests.
Creative and Video Production: Develop and direct high-quality content across multiple formats, including short-form videos, livestreams, and serialized content. Collaborate with designers, motion specialists, and other creative partners to deliver impactful social experiences.
Editorial Planning: Maintain a strategic editorial calendar that balances consistent daily publishing with major announcements, campaign launches, and timely industry developments.
AI-Powered Workflow Optimization: Use AI tools to accelerate content ideation, research, drafting, production, and publishing. Identify new technologies and implement efficient workflows without compromising quality, authenticity, or brand consistency.
Analytics and Reporting: Own organic social performance tracking, analyze trends and audience behavior, and present clear insights, results, and recommendations to senior leadership on a regular basis.
Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner with product, partnerships, design, events, and communications teams to coordinate messaging, align campaign execution, and maintain a cohesive brand narrative across channels.
Community Engagement: Monitor social channels for emerging trends, audience sentiment, and engagement opportunities. Respond thoughtfully to conversations and help strengthen community relationships, trust, and brand credibility.
Continuous Improvement: Stay informed about evolving social platforms, emerging formats, creator trends, and AI-powered marketing capabilities, translating relevant developments into actionable recommendations.

Requirements

Professional Experience: At least 8 years of experience in social media marketing and content marketing, with demonstrated ownership of both strategy and hands-on execution.
Social Media Expertise: Proven success managing multiple brand accounts, growing audiences, increasing engagement, and delivering measurable business or marketing outcomes.
Web3 and Emerging Technology Knowledge: Experience in blockchain, cryptocurrency, Web3, or other emerging technology sectors. Familiarity with Crypto Twitter/X, developer ecosystems, and builder communities is a strong advantage.
Content Development: Excellent editorial judgment and storytelling skills, with the ability to turn complex technical subjects and strategic narratives into clear, compelling, audience-focused content.
Video and Creative Production: Hands-on experience planning, producing, directing, or managing video content for social platforms, including short-form video and livestreams.
AI and Workflow Automation: Practical experience using AI tools to support content creation, research, ideation, and workflow optimization, with the ability to evaluate and adopt relevant tools.
Data Analysis: Strong analytical skills and experience using social media metrics, performance dashboards, and audience insights to refine strategy and communicate results to leadership.
Project and Stakeholder Management: Excellent organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple accounts, concurrent campaigns, competing priorities, and cross-functional projects independently.
Creative Collaboration: Experience preparing creative briefs and working effectively with designers, video editors, motion specialists, and other internal or external partners.
Social Media Tools: Familiarity with social publishing, scheduling, monitoring, and social listening platforms.
Communication and Adaptability: Excellent written and verbal communication skills, sound judgment, and the ability to work autonomously in a fast-paced, distributed environment.
Remote Collaboration: Ability to work remotely with at least four hours of overlap with Pacific Time (PT). The original role is open to candidates across North American time zones, the UK, Europe, and selected Middle Eastern countries; eligibility for applicants based in India should be confirmed during the application process.

Benefits

Competitive Compensation: USD $60–$75 per hour, depending on experience.
Contract Engagement: Contract-based opportunity with an expected full-time workload of approximately 40 hours per week.
Fully Remote Work: Work remotely with an internationally distributed team.
Global Collaboration: Partner with professionals across product, design, communications, partnerships, and leadership.
Professional Impact: Shape social media strategy and influence brand visibility, community engagement, and adoption within the global Web3 ecosystem.
Innovation and Technology: Work with emerging AI tools and modern marketing workflows to improve creative output and operational efficiency.
Creative Ownership: Take responsibility for social strategy, content direction, channel growth, and performance optimization.
Growth Opportunities: Develop your expertise in blockchain marketing, digital storytelling, AI-enabled content production, and global community engagement.

jobs.title: Lifecycle Growth Marketing Senior Manager - Onboarding
jobs.description:
About Crunchyroll

Founded by fans, Crunchyroll delivers the art and culture of anime to a passionate community. We super-serve over 100 million anime and manga fans across 200+ countries and territories, and help them connect with the stories and characters they crave. Whether that experience is online or in-person, streaming video, theatrical, games, merchandise, events and more, it’s powered by the anime content we all love.

Join our team, and help us shape the future of anime!

About The Role

As the Lifecycle Growth Marketing Senior Manager - Onboarding, you will set the global strategy using data to turn new subscribers into active, engaged fans. You’ll design and scale personalized journeys that meet fans where they are—using recommendations, messaging, and contextual experiences to drive immersion, strengthen viewing habits, and build lasting connections with Crunchyroll. Operating at the intersection of Lifecycle Strategy, Analytics, Product, Engineering, User Acquisition, Go-To-Market, SVOD Strategy, Creative, Brand, and Marketing Operations, you will translate high-value actions, viewership, and behavioral patterns into customized experiences. You’ll pair quant-focused analysis with AI and LLM-enabled query workflows to evaluate performance, identify growth opportunities, and recommend precise, scalable optimizations.

In the role of Lifecycle Growth Marketing Senior Manager - Onboarding, you will report to the Director, Lifecycle Growth Marketing - Global VOD.

We are considering applicants for the location of Los Angeles, CA.

Core Areas of Responsibility

Set the Onboarding Agenda

Define and lead the end-to-end onboarding and early-tenure strategy, using retention from initial sign-up as a primary measure of success and a driver of long-term customer value.
Create a proactive, signal-based operating model that continuously advances the strategy through quantitative analysis, experimentation, fan insights, and business priorities.

Orchestrate Personalized Fan Journeys.

Design and scale personalized lifecycle journeys that adapt to each fan’s stage, interests, viewing activity, engagement level, and behavioral patterns.
Use recommendations, messaging, and contextual experiences to meet fans where they are, drive immersion, deepen content discovery, and strengthen repeat viewing and fandom habits.
Identify and prioritize high-value actions across fans and subscribers—including viewership and behavioral signals—and translate them into customized experiences that are relevant, timely, and designed to move measurable business outcomes.

Scale Personalization Through Braze & Orchestration

Own the strategic development of sophisticated journeys in Braze across push, email, SMS, in-app messages, Content Cards, WhatsApp, and MMS.
Establish operating standards for segmentation, personalization, real-time triggers, orchestration, testing, and quality assurance, partnering with Lifecycle Operations and Automations teams to scale execution with discipline.

Turn Data, AI & LLMs Into Growth Decisions

Define a rigorous, quant-focused measurement and optimization framework across retention, engagement, viewership, high-value actions, habituality, show diversity, and other business-critical outcomes.
Partner with Analytics and Data Science to use AI- and LLM-enabled analytics and query tools to explore journey and campaign performance, identify trends and opportunities, validate insights and incrementality, and translate learnings into scalable lifecycle optimization strategies that improve targeting and timing.

Lead End-to-End Growth Initiatives & OKR Delivery

Own growth initiatives end-to-end—from framing the business problem and opportunity, through strategy, execution, measurement, and iteration.
Identify and prioritize growth opportunities that increase the speed, quality, and effectiveness of lifecycle execution, helping the organization meet and exceed OKRs.
Bring a decisive bias for action to ambiguous, cross-functional challenges while maintaining rigor in prioritization, analysis, decision-making, and delivery.

Align Global Strategy Across the Organization

Lead alignment across Product, Engineering, User Acquisition, Go-To-Market, SVOD Strategy, Creative, Brand, Analytics, Marketing Operations, Content & Programming, and regional teams to deliver a unified subscriber experience.
Shape global and regional strategies with stakeholders across markets, improving performance through culturally relevant messaging, recommendations, and journey customization.
Represent lifecycle strategy in matrixed initiatives, connecting customer behavior, business priorities, and execution across the organization with clarity and influence.

Build Capability Through Team & Agency Leadership

Develop and lead a high-performing early-tenure lifecycle team, creating clarity of ownership, high standards, and a culture of continuous improvement.
Direct external agency partners supporting design, copy, operations, and QA workflows, with clear expectations for creative quality, operational rigor, and efficiency.

About You

We get excited about candidates, like you, because...

8+ years of progressive experience in Lifecycle Marketing, Retention Marketing, Growth Marketing, or a related discipline, with deep exposure to onboarding and early-tenure engagement strategies.
5+ years leading and developing globally distributed teams.
Demonstrated record of using data, experimentation, and customer behavior to improve retention, engagement, viewership, and personalized experiences.
Deep expertise with Braze or comparable orchestration platforms, including journey design, real-time triggers, segmentation, personalization, and multi-channel execution.
Highly quantitative and analytical, with the ability to turn behavioral, cohort, viewership, and lifecycle data into strategic direction and rigorous decisions.
Experience applying AI and LLMs to query performance data, accelerate analysis, surface insights, and deliver actionable optimization recommendations.
Proven ability to lead complex, end-to-end initiatives; identify business growth opportunities; and deliver against ambitious OKRs in a matrixed organization.
Executive-level communicator and critical thinker who creates clarity, influences stakeholders, and moves teams from insight to action.
High-ownership operator with a strong bias for action, sound judgment, and the operating discipline to prioritize effectively, execute with urgency, and learn quickly.
Experience overseeing multiple global lifecycle programs and external agencies with a focus on creative and operational excellence.
A genuine interest in anime, entertainment, or fan-focused brands and an ability to build an authentic connection with our content and audience.
Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Marketing, Business, or a related field.

About The Team

The Lifecycle Marketing team curates personalized journeys that engage, delight, and build long-term loyalty—from onboarding to retention and beyond. Through data-driven insights, we create strategies that connect users to the right experience, at the right time, on the right platform. Whether for our core streaming service or flywheel businesses, our mission is to promote growth, foster a membership mindset, and maximize lifetime value.

Why you will love working at Crunchyroll

In addition to getting to work with fun, passionate and inspired colleagues, you will also enjoy the following benefits and perks:

Receive a great compensation package including salary plus performance bonus earning potential, paid annually.
Flexible time off policies allowing you to take the time you need to be your whole self.
Generous medical, dental, vision, STD, LTD, and life insurance
Health Saving Account HSA program
Health care and dependent care FSA
401(k) plan, with employer match
Employer paid commuter benefit
Support program for new parents
Pet insurance and some of our offices are pet friendly!

The Pay Range for this position is listed. Actual pay will vary based on factors including, but not limited to location, experience, and performance. The range listed is just one component of Crunchyroll’s Total Rewards offerings for employees. Other rewards may include performance bonuses, employer matched retirement savings, time-off programs, and progressive health benefits and perks.

About Our Values

We want to be everything for someone rather than something for everyone and we do this by living and modeling our values in all that we do. We value

Courage. We believe that when we overcome fear, we enable our best selves.
Curiosity. We are curious, which is the gateway to empathy, inclusion, and understanding.
Kaizen. We have a growth mindset committed to constant forward progress.

Our mission of helping people belong reflects our commitment to diversity & inclusion. It's just the way we do business.

The Special Events & Marketing Manager leads the planning and execution of fundraising events that bring people together, inspire generosity, and deepen connection to Loaves & Fishes’ mission. This role combines creativity, relationship building, and hands-on project management with strong attention to detail to deliver a welcoming, high-quality guest experience from the first invitation through post-event follow-up. Working closely with Advancement colleagues, vendors, and volunteers, the Manager oversees event logistics, budgets, timelines and details, and helps achieve event revenue goals through sponsorship solicitation, auction procurement, and guest development. This position also supports the Marketing & Communications Team through event marketing, social media content, storytelling, and helping build a library of photos that capture our mission in action and support communications across the organization. The Special Events & Marketing Manager reports directly to the Sr. Director of Donor & Corporate Engagement with additional direction from the Director of Marketing & Communications.

Responsibilities:

Special Events (70%)

·      Serve as the lead in the planning and implementation of our signature fundraising events, including Night to End Hunger and Chef Showdown, in collaboration with other team members.
·      Play a key role in meeting the recruitment, implementation, and revenue goals for each fundraising event, including soliciting sponsorships and auction items and supporting outreach to attract and engage guests.
·      Coordinate event day set-up, registration, check out, and post event follow-up.
·      Build successful relationships with vendors, event participants, sponsors, and volunteers.
·      Use event database to track ticket sales, sponsorships, donations and in-kind contributions.
·      Assist with procurement, management, and fulfillment of auction items.
·      Negotiate contracts for event venues, vendors, and suppliers.

Marketing (30%)

·      Help with storytelling content and photography for newsletters, social posts, and other communication channels while maintaining voice and brand of Loaves & Fishes.
·      Work with Sr. Director of Marketing & Communications to develop social media strategy, calendar, scheduling/posting social media content – along with monitoring content and messages.
·      Partner with Graphic Designer to develop and maintain fundraising collateral.

Job Requirements:

·      Strong project management skills, organizational skills – ability to manage multiple priorities and coordinate cross-functional teams.
·      Experience working with vendors, sponsors, and volunteers; ability to manage budget and timelines.

jobs.title: Senior Product Marketing Manager, Field Enablement
jobs.description:
About Nerdio

At Nerdio, our mission is to simplify the lives of IT professionals and maximize their Microsoft Cloud and end user computing investments.

Deploying, managing, and cost-optimizing Azure Virtual Desktop (AVD), Windows 365, and Intune is technically complex without a purpose-built management layer on top. Nerdio is that layer. We automate what Microsoft’s native tooling leaves manual, so enterprises and Managed Service Providers (MSPs) can run cloud desktops at scale with lower cost, less operational effort, and less migration risk.

Founded in 2016, Nerdio is used by more than 15,000 organizations in over 50 countries and was named Microsoft’s 2024 Americas Partner of the Year. Our vision is to be the control plane that makes Microsoft cloud workspaces simpler, more efficient, and cost-effective at scale. How much of that opportunity we capture depends on go-to-market execution.

We are a fast-moving, nimble company looking for people who are collaborative, empathetic, driven, and who love to move at the speed of light.

About The Role

Nerdio is looking for a Senior Product Marketing Manager, Field Enablement to be the connective tissue between Product, Marketing, and our direct and partner sales organizations. You will make sure sellers and partners understand our products, our positioning, and our customer value, and can use that story to drive better outcomes for sellers, partners, and customers.

You will partner closely with Nerdio’s Sales Enablement & Readiness team, which leads onboarding, training, certifications, sales methodology, and field execution for sellers and partners. As part of Product Marketing, you will create the messaging, positioning, competitive insights, and content that power these programs. Together, the teams will equip sellers and partners to confidently position, demonstrate, and sell Nerdio solutions.

What You'll Do

Translate product into field-ready messaging. Turn strategy, releases, and positioning into clear value messaging, talk tracks, and proof points for direct sellers, MSPs, and Microsoft co-sell teams.
Own launch readiness. Partner with Product and PMMs on field launch kits delivered ahead of general availability. Collaborate with Sales Enablement & Readiness to establish launch timelines, readiness requirements, and content delivery milestones, enabling Sales Enablement to partner on the training, rollout, reinforcement for field readiness.
Build product-led sales content. Create pitch decks, solution briefs, battle cards, customer stories, and ROI tools tailored to direct and partner motions.
Equip partners and co-sell. Work with Partnerships and Partner Marketing to create partner-ready content that makes MSP, channel, and Microsoft co-sell motions repeatable.
Close the feedback loop. Gather field, partner, and customer insight, including win/loss and competitive intelligence, and turn it into recommendations that sharpen positioning and inform the roadmap.
Partner with Sales Enablement. Align on priorities and supply the product content for their onboarding, training, and playbooks.
Use AI to scale. Speed up content creation and help the field apply AI in their own workflows.

Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Business, Communications, or a related field (or equivalent experience).
6+ years in B2B technology across product marketing, field enablement, or GTM roles, with experience supporting both direct and partner sellers.
Proven ability to translate complex technical products into clear value for sellers and varied buyer personas.
Strong writing and content skills across PMM formats (battle cards, solution briefs, decks, launch kits).
Track record of cross-functional partnership with Product, Sales, Sales Enablement, Customer Success, Partnerships, and Marketing in a fast-paced environment.
Strong analytical skills, with the ability to turn field, customer, and competitive insight into clear recommendations.
Comfort with and willingness to use AI tools to maximize impact and efficiency.

Preferred Qualifications

Knowledge of the Microsoft ecosystem (Azure, AVD, Windows 365, Intune), plus Microsoft co-sell or Microsoft Partner Network experience.
Experience enabling MSPs, resellers, or other channel partners.
Background in end user computing, cloud desktop, or device management markets.
Familiarity with sales enablement platforms and CRM.
Experience at a high-growth SaaS or cloud technology company.

Stock Options
Health and Welfare Plans*
Life and Disability Plans*
Retirement Plan*
Unlimited Flexible Paid Time Off, including your birthday off!
Collaborative Team Culture

Job Description

Join Team Amex and let's lead the way together.

Resy is the American Express global dining platform within U.S. Consumer Services (USCS). Our mission is to power the world’s best restaurants, using technology to imagine the future of hospitality. Our customers discover the amazing world of restaurants thanks to our content-rich website and innovative mobile app. Our diners are insiders, and we love having them at the table. The team is responsible for reimagining hospitality and redefining the way restaurants and diners connect through a single network.

Interested in joining our team of restaurant-obsessed explorers? Right this way.   

About The Role

We’re looking for a Senior
Analyst, Venue Retention & Lifecycle Marketing
, to support the execution and optimization of Resy’s venue retention, nurture, and B2B content marketing strategy. Reporting to the Manager of Venue Lifecycle and Retention Marketing
, this role will play a key part in bringing data-driven, multi-channel marketing programs to life that deepen restaurant partner engagement, strengthen loyalty, drive product adoption, and support long-term partner retention.

This individual will work closely with the Manager of Venue Retention Marketing to execute partner nurture strategies and B2B content programs across the venue lifecycle
, translating strategic priorities, partner insights, and product value into relevant and compelling communications. They will own key executional workstreams across email and editorial content
including the B2B Content Calendar and end-to-end development of Resy’s partner eNewsletter, while supporting the development and execution of trigger-based and ongoing nurture journeys.

The role will sit at the intersection of lifecycle marketing, B2B content, email execution, and marketing operations
. This person will partner cross-functionally with Marketing, Partner Success, Product, Creative, Compliance, and other teams to move campaigns and initiatives from ideation and briefing through development, approval, deployment, measurement, and optimization. They will bring strong operational rigor to the team, ensuring that multiple campaigns, stakeholders, approvals, and deadlines are effectively managed.

The ideal candidate is an organized and execution-oriented marketer with strong email, editorial, and social instincts and analytical curiosity

They have a desire to understand our hospitality partners and use data-driven lifecycle marketing to create communications that deliver meaningful value.

Responsibilities

Support the execution and optimization of Resy’s venue retention and lifecycle marketing strategy, bringing partner-facing content and communications to life across email, editorial, and social channels.

Support the development of partner retention and loyalty strategies, identifying opportunities to deepen engagement through new channels, programs, events, and partner experiences.
Maintain strong operational processes and project management across campaigns and content, ensuring clear timelines, approvals, documentation, and performance reporting.
Partner cross-functionally with Sales, Partner Success, Product, Product Marketing, Creative, and other teams to ensure partner communications reflect shared business objectives.

Qualifications

2+ years of experience in lifecycle, CRM, email, B2B, content, digital, or integrated marketing, ideally within a SaaS, technology, hospitality, or partner-focused organization.
Hands-on experience developing and executing email or lifecycle marketing campaigns, with an understanding of campaign development from audience definition and content creation through QA, deployment, and reporting.
Strong editorial and writing skills, with the ability to generate content ideas and translate business priorities, product capabilities, and audience needs into clear and compelling B2B communications; familiarity with SEO principles is a plus.
Experience supporting or executing nurture and lifecycle marketing programs, with an understanding of segmentation, personalization, behavioral triggers, and journey-based marketing; familiarity with HubSpot is a plus.
Strong analytical skills, with the ability to use campaign performance, CRM data, partner feedback, research, and other qualitative and quantitative insights to inform marketing decisions and identify opportunities for optimization.
Strong project management and organizational skills, with experience managing multiple campaigns, stakeholders, timelines, dependencies, and approval processes.
Experience navigating Compliance, Brand, or other structured marketing approval processes is a plus.
Strong written and verbal communication skills and demonstrated ability to collaborate effectively across functions and stakeholders.

You’ll Thrive In This Role If You

Are both creative and execution-oriented—you enjoy developing content and campaign ideas and are equally energized by bringing them to life.
Have strong editorial instincts and intellectual curiosity, with an interest in understanding what content will be useful and engaging for Resy’s partners.
Are a highly organized project manager with exceptional attention to detail who can bring structure to complex work and keep multiple workstreams moving at once.
Are proactive and take ownership, following up with stakeholders, anticipating roadblocks, and keeping projects moving without needing every next step defined.
Have a “can do” approach to problem solving and are comfortable operating amid ambiguity, white space, evolving priorities, and strategic pauses.
Are analytically curious and interested in using performance data, partner behavior, and feedback to understand what’s working and continuously improve your work.
Are a strong cross-functional collaborator who can build productive relationships across Marketing, Partner Success, Product, Creative, Compliance, and external partners.
Have a desire to continuously learn and improve, building your expertise across lifecycle, content, and B2B marketing.
Have a passion for the hospitality industry and curiosity about the challenges, priorities, and opportunities facing Resy’s partners.

jobs.description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a VP, Marketing based in the United States.

Lead the next stage of growth for an innovative AI-powered healthcare technology business transforming modern dentistry. As VP of Marketing, you will build and scale a revenue-driven marketing organization that strengthens enterprise pipeline, accelerates sales, and establishes category leadership. Reporting directly to the CEO, you will play a central role in shaping company strategy and aligning Marketing, Sales, Product, and Customer Success around a unified go-to-market vision. You will develop demand generation programs across enterprise, mid-market, and SMB segments while expanding market reach through strategic partnerships and customer lifecycle initiatives. This role combines hands-on execution with executive leadership, offering the opportunity to create scalable marketing systems and measurable commercial impact. Your work will help dental professionals deliver better care and improve patient outcomes through technology already used in clinical practice.

Accountabilities

As a key member of the leadership team, you will own marketing performance, establish a repeatable go-to-market engine, and align brand, demand generation, and customer engagement initiatives with business growth objectives.

Revenue and pipeline growth: Own marketing-sourced and marketing-influenced pipeline targets across enterprise, mid-market dental service organizations (DSOs), and SMB segments, with accountability for measurable revenue outcomes.
Demand generation: Build scalable, segment-specific programs, including enterprise account-based marketing (ABM), mid-market awareness campaigns, and high-volume SMB inbound initiatives.
Market expansion: Develop targeted campaigns to increase penetration among mid-market DSOs and strengthen the company's presence across key customer segments.
Brand and category leadership: Define and communicate a compelling market position for AI-powered dental care, differentiating the platform from competing solutions.
Messaging and thought leadership: Develop a unified platform narrative, lead PR and thought leadership initiatives, and create evidence-based sales materials that demonstrate customer value and return on investment.
Enterprise sales enablement: Partner with Sales leadership to refine ideal customer profiles, account segmentation, pipeline coverage, and strategies for complex, multi-stakeholder sales cycles.
Channel and partner marketing: Build partner-led demand generation, co-marketing, channel enablement, and scalable partner onboarding programs.
Customer lifecycle marketing: Develop retention, expansion, nurture, and advocacy programs that increase customer lifetime value and help reduce churn.
Product and go-to-market strategy: Collaborate with Product and Sales on pricing, packaging, launches, and market expansion, incorporating customer insights and competitive intelligence into commercial decisions.
Marketing team leadership: Build and lead a high-performing organization across demand generation, product marketing, brand, customer marketing, and marketing operations.
Marketing systems and performance: Establish scalable attribution, analytics, and revenue operations processes to track performance across segments and channels.
Continuous improvement: Foster a culture of accountability, speed, collaboration, and experimentation, balancing strategic direction with hands-on execution.

Requirements

The ideal candidate is a commercially minded marketing leader with a strong track record of translating marketing strategy into predictable pipeline and revenue growth. You should combine strategic storytelling and category creation with the analytical capabilities and operational discipline needed to scale a B2B business.

10+ years of B2B marketing experience, including at least 5 years in marketing leadership roles.
Demonstrated success scaling marketing from early traction to repeatable, sustainable growth.
Proven ownership of pipeline and revenue outcomes across enterprise, mid-market, and SMB customer segments.
Strong expertise in either product marketing or demand generation, with experience supporting complex B2B SaaS sales cycles.
Experience across channel and partner marketing, customer lifecycle marketing, and brand development.
A builder mindset, with a willingness to remain hands-on while setting strategic direction and developing scalable processes.
Strong analytical capabilities and experience with marketing operations, attribution, performance measurement, and revenue operations.
Exceptional storytelling, positioning, and messaging skills, with the ability to align Marketing, Sales, and Product around a unified go-to-market strategy.
Strong cross-functional collaboration and communication skills, particularly in executive and commercial environments.
A genuine interest in improving healthcare and making a positive impact on patients' lives.

Experience in healthcare, artificial intelligence, or other regulated industries.
Experience marketing to clinicians, healthcare providers, or healthcare systems.
A track record at category-defining companies or experience creating demand in emerging markets.

jobs.description:
Description

We're reinventing how to attract and hire quality talent at scale — come join us.

We're seeking a Talent Marketing Manager to lead the strategy, execution and performance behind two of the AIM organization's most critical marketing functions: activation management and integrated marketing and campaign planning across Workforce Staffing's global hiring portfolio. This role starts with the customer: understanding hiring needs, translating them into marketing goals, and owning how those goals are achieved. You define how marketing support is prioritized, how campaigns are strategically planned, measured and optimized, and how the team scales its impact through automation, data-driven decisioning, and cross-functional orchestration.

You help thousands of people get a job every year.

As a marketing strategist and cross-functional operator, you set the vision for how activation logic, campaign planning, override management, and performance optimization work together to drive fill rate outcomes at scale across priority geographies globally. You translate complex performance data into decisive activation recommendations, manage daily pacing and spend governance, and own the narrative for senior leadership. You flex between deep-focus, data-rich environments and wide-focus, relationship-heavy environments with equal confidence.

You shape organizational strategy, build trust, drive clarity, and solve problems before they escalate.

Your insights don't just inform decisions — they define them. You influence partner team roadmaps and align business managers on fill risk strategy, and represent both the activation and campaign functions in cross-functional planning. You identify gaps between teams and processes, hold partner teams accountable for improvements, and build scalable mechanisms that outlast your direct involvement. You build the trust, mechanisms, and reporting that close the existing gap. You don't wait for perfect data — you make decisions with what exists and build toward what's needed.

Key job responsibilities

Performance Optimization & Marketing Strategy: Define the annual marketing strategy and plan the direction for channel mix, spend efficiency, fill rate improvement, and labor order trajectory across your portfolio. Lead quarterly strategy reviews, updating priorities based on performance data, market shifts, and evolving business needs. Partner with analytics teams to move beyond single-metric measurement to comprehensive campaign performance frameworks. Push back on media recommendations with data where channel performance does not support continued investment.

Activation Strategy & Risk Management: Own the strategic framework for weekly marketing activation logic across assigned markets, including application need and paid application need assessments. Define the override governance model, ensuring decisions are logged and structured to accelerate automation development. Set the standard for how risk is identified, escalated, and resolved across the portfolio.

Integrated Campaign Planning & Execution: Own annual integrated campaign plans for assigned markets, with focus on building and testing during low-volume periods and maintaining readiness for high-volume hiring events. Lead working-backwards planning from hiring projections, site capacity, and historical performance data. Consult senior leadership on quarterly strategy, budget allocation, and major campaign pivots. Translate changing labor order visibility into dynamic marketing adjustments, flagging risks and mitigation plans early.

Cross-Functional Orchestration: Drive collaboration with Performance Marketing, Journey Orchestration, Creative, Talent Engagement, Marketing Analytics, and Business stakeholders. Manage stakeholder expectations across business partners, country leads, and global teams. Bridge the gap between marketing capabilities and operational hiring realities. Manage a wide portfolio of countries with varying levels of data maturity, labour order certainty, and stakeholder sophistication.

Pacing & Spend Governance: Oversee daily pacing reviews, implementing ramp-down or pause decisions when application delivery targets are met. Share insights with Performance Marketing to improve paid marketing efficiency. Own escalation thresholds and spend decision governance.

Stakeholder Communication & Alignment: Own weekly and monthly Business Review deep dive presentations for senior leadership, translating risk sites and marketing performance into clear strategic narrative. Maintain regular alignment with Business Managers and cross-functional partners on fill rate risk and marketing actions. Influence investment priorities and partner team roadmaps through data-driven business cases. Adapt communication to audience maturity — from sophisticated data-driven forums to foundational trust-building conversations.

Application Quality & Fill Rate Improvement: Monitor performance against goals including fill rate, non-paid application share, spend per hire, and application-to-usable application ratios. Implement data-driven optimisations for underperforming sites. Identify quality gaps (geo-targeting, shift messaging, channel mix) and coordinate with Paid Marketing, Creative, and Owned Marketing teams to resolve. Own the activation logic that balances cost efficiency with fill rate delivery.

Automation & Process Improvement: Identify, develop, and drive adoption of mechanisms that improve activation efficiency, reduce manual override volume, and accelerate the path to automated decisioning. Own the automation of campaign planning processes — from discovery through recommendation to implementation. Eliminate redundant workflows and hold partner teams accountable for process improvements across both functions.

A day in the life

Your morning starts with reviewing overnight pacing data across your markets and making activation decisions for the day. You join the weekly reporting call with your stakeholders, leading the marketing view for your area with a clear recommendation for each at-risk site. Mid-morning, you're on a stakeholder call with business partners in Brazil translating application pacing risk into language they understand and building alignment on marketing levers available. After lunch, you're deep-diving a high-spend site in Germany where channel efficiency has dropped — pulling site-level data, identifying the issue, and producing an internal discussion analysis for the Paid Marketing team. In the afternoon, you're working through quarterly initiatives with other teams — defining what to learn, which markets to test in, and how results will inform next quarter's strategy. Later, you prepare the MBR narrative for senior leadership, connecting this month’s activation decisions to fill rate outcomes. You close the day connecting the dots: what patterns are emerging across your portfolio, what's working, what needs to change, and how to translate that into the quarterly strategy update you're presenting to leadership next week.

About The Team

Workforce Staffing (WFS) hires thousands of Amazonians every year. The Attraction, Influence, and Marketing (AIM) team achieves high-volume hiring goals by delivering exceptional, multi-channel candidate experiences — engaging and hiring job seekers with maximum efficiency and precision. Leveraging paid digital advertising, owned channels, web experience, and local grassroots efforts, AIM delivers quality candidates at scale. Practicing transformational thinking empowered by leading-edge tech and tool development, this team constantly innovates new processes to increase marketing efficacy.

Basic Qualifications

Experience using data and metrics to measure impact and determine improvements
Experience in marketing or marketing research
Experience presenting metrics and progress to goal to senior leadership
Experience driving direction and alignment with cross-functional teams
Experience with Excel or Tableau (data manipulation, macros, charts and pivot tables)

Preferred Qualifications

Experience using SQL to pull data and metrics to deliver reports

Our second brand, RE:YOU (getreyou.com), is dominating the luxury haircare market and is already one of the fastest growing brands ever after launching in July 2026.

We are backed by some of the best venture firms in the world (Maveron, Khosla Ventures, Mars, Imaginary Ventures) and are building a world-class team together to transform the consumer health industry as we know it.

You’ll have the opportunity to help scale our organic and paid advertisements channels and partnerships. You’ll assist with the development of Pacagen and RE:YOU’s creative content across all channels and website iteration. The best candidate will have a proven track record for clear communication and proactive problem-solving. You will be mentored by and working directly with our co-founders who built and sold one of the fastest-growing science-backed beauty brands ever. This role is for someone who actively enjoys working in a fast-paced environment while taking on larger responsibilities within a rapidly growing organization.

Responsibilities:
● Work with the rest of the team to brainstorm and develop new, creative approaches for advertising that meet Pacagen and RE:YOU’s objectives and goals.
● Oversee development of video content and ads for all Pacagen and RE:YOU’s paid channels using best practices for each platform, including Facebook/Instagram, TikTok, and Youtube.
● Manage large influencer collaborations.

Requirements:
● BS or BA in any field. But a proven track-record of high performance.

● Ability to work independently and in a team environment.

● Comfortable working in a fast-paced environment.
● Clear communication skills.
● Ability to multitask and adhere to deadlines.

We’re a fast-paced startup that is delivering life-changing products. You’ll notice that the phrase “fast-paced” is in this job description multiple times. jobs.title: Marketing Analyst
jobs.description:
Job Type

Full-time

Description

Berkshire Hathaway Direct Insurance Company (biBERK) is building a cloud-first, API-driven insurance platform that enables small business owners to buy commercial policies directly online. We are seeking an analytical and technically minded Marketing Analyst
to join our team in Stamford, CT, to help scale our digital marketing analytics and performance reporting framework.

In this role, you will sit at the intersection of growth marketing, data science, and web applications. You will leverage modern AI coding environments (such as Claude, Copilot) alongside core digital tracking tools (Google Ads, GA4) and Python/R web application frameworks to build real-time interactive dashboards. Your efforts will directly inform marketing investment, optimize digital acquisition funnels, and track key operational metrics for senior leadership

This job is hybrid with mandatory in-office days at our Stamford, CT location on a weekly or monthly basis depending on location.

Job Responsibilities

Production Dashboard Engineering: Design, deploy, and support interactive analytical applications and custom web tools using Python (Streamlit) or R (Shiny). Build reporting systems to track direct-to-business marketing metrics, including quote-to-bind ratios, channel attribution, conversion velocities, and other funnel metrics. Use AI to build and maintain these dashboards on an azure environment.
AI-Accelerated Development: Serve as a functional champion for generative AI tools (Claude) within marketing operations. Utilize LLM workflows to accelerate code synthesis, automate data pipelines, and refactor analytical scripts to streamline dashboard delivery timelines.
Cloud & Data Integration: Partner with internal technology teams within the Azure ecosystem to integrate marketing data streams, support data warehouse migrations, and ensure secure deployment of analytical web applications.
Tracking Architecture & GA4 Optimization: Maintain and enhance digital analytics architecture across GA4 and Google Ads. Oversee custom dimension setups, event-driven tag management, and clean B2B lead attribution to ensure high data integrity across all digital channels.
Growth Experimentation & Media Testing: Design, run, and evaluate rigor-based media testing frameworks to measure true marketing incrementality. Execute Conversion Lift studies, Geo-Testing / Match-Market models, and A/B experiments across digital channels.

Requirements

Experience: 3–5 years of experience in marketing analytics, marketing science, or business intelligence. Experience in B2B commercial insurance, financial services, or insurtech environments is strongly preferred.
Education: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in a quantitative field such as Computer Science, Economics, Mathematics, Statistics, or Data Science.
Location: Must reside within a viable commuting distance of our Stamford, CT office to attend required monthly strategy and team alignment session.
Development & Analytics Stack: Advanced proficiency in Python (Streamlit) and/or R (Shiny) for web application development and data visualization. Deep expertise in GA4 (event tracking, custom dimensions) and Google Ads management platforms. Hands-on experience using Claude/LLMs for code generation, workflow automation, and refactoring.
Database & Cloud: Foundational understanding of the Azure ecosystem for data storage, query optimization, or web application hosting.
Testing Methodologies: Proven understanding of statistical media testing, specifically Conversion Lift testing, Geo-Testing, and A/B experimentation architectures.
Preferred Skills: Prior experience with traditional enterprise BI platforms (Power BI or Tableau) is a plus.

About Us

biBerk is where commercial insurance buyers can obtain coverage for their businesses from insurers of the Berkshire Hathaway group of Insurance Companies, one of the best capitalized insurance groups in the world. Our ultimate parent, Berkshire Hathaway Inc. (berkshirehathaway.com) is a holding company with diversified interests in a host of industries, including insurance, energy, transportation and manufacturing. Most policies issued through biBerk.com will be underwritten by Berkshire Hathaway Direct Insurance Company ("BHDIC"), which is an AM Best rated A++ insurer.

BHDIC is domiciled in Omaha, Nebraska. BHDIC and the team at biBerk are focused on helping small business owners quickly and easily buy affordable insurance directly from a financially strong insurance company they can trust.

BHDIC is excited to announce our comprehensive benefits package with some new and enhanced features for 2026 that include:

Medical (PPO/HDHP), vision, disability, and life insurance.
Enhanced dental plan with orthodontia coverage in addition to a standard plan.
Generous PTO plan for all benefit-time eligible employees.
Paid company holidays and 4 floating holidays.
Paid parental leave.
Employee Retirement Savings Plan/401(k) with company match and immediate vesting.
Education Assistance Program that offers 100% upfront tuition reimbursement after 6 months of service for approved degree programs.
Service Recognition Program that provides a monetary award to be used toward a vacation every 5 years of employment.
Wellness Initiatives that include Fitness Center and Weight Watchers Reimbursement programs.
Voluntary benefits that include accident, critical illness, and hospital indemnity.
Employee discount and rewards program on travel, tickets, electronics, home, and more.

In accordance with pay transparency laws and regulations, the following good faith compensation range estimate is being provided. The salary range for this position is $85,000 to $95,000 per year.
Final compensation will be based on candidate qualifications, geographic location, and other considerations permitted by law.

jobs.description:
Overview

At Zebra, we are a community of innovators who come together to create new ways of working. United by curiosity and a culture of caring, we develop smart solutions that anticipate our customer’s and partner’s needs and solve their challenges.

Being part of Zebra Nation means you are seen, heard, valued, and respected. Drawing from our unique perspectives, we collaborate to deliver on our purpose. Here you are part of a team pushing boundaries today to redefine the work of tomorrow for organizations, their employees, and those they serve.

You’ll have opportunities to learn and lead in a forward-thinking environment, defining your path to a fulfilling career while channeling your skills toward causes you care about—locally and globally.

Come make an impact every day at Zebra.

What We're Looking For

The purpose of this internship is to prepare students for entry into the business world by providing a thorough understanding of the various functions of the Zebra Technologies organization. The program is designed to provide students with experiences that provide insights into a career with Zebra. Students will be positioned for success with training and hands-on experiences, invited to social and development activities, and provided a professional mentor relationship.

The primary purpose of the Business and Market Intelligence team is to provide research-based insights on markets, customers, and competitors. The team works with senior members to understand business needs and then translates them into an appropriate research design / methodology.

This marketing Internship at Zebra will provide you with the foundation to explore and apply for Zebra's Marketing Development Program (MDP). The MDP is a two-year, full-time rotational program offering employees the opportunity to learn from experts throughout the marketing organization at our Lincolnshire, IL headquarters.

US Summer Internship Benefits

Summer Fridays, As Applicable With Your Team

30+ Social and Professional Events in 12 Weeks

Global Immersion With Your Teams and Interns

Intern Allowance (when applicable)

(for all US internships)

Essential Duties And Responsibilities

Work with senior team members to understand the business need and translate them into an appropriate research design
Delivers report in format to aid business stakeholder interpretation (pivot tables, graphs, etc.)
Reviews existing reports for data accuracy
Proposes resolutions for quality issues of limited scope to more senior level analysts and/or supervisor; Support business units and marketing teams on intelligence/research requests
Utilizes analytical working techniques, problem solving, research/quantitative analysis skills to generate recommendations
Identifies and interprets trends and patterns in datasets to locate influences
May be responsible for data governance processes and quality in assigned area of responsibility
Develop planning, organizational and leadership skills
Increase technology knowledge and skills, especially as it relates to Zebra's product portfolio
Manage team-based work assignments
Practice interpersonal skills to connect with day-to-day business contacts through follow-up activities

This position requires hybrid work (3 days/week in office) in the Lincolnshire, IL office.

Required Qualifications

Current enrollment in an undergraduate degree program in Economics, Mathematics, Statistics, Management, Marketing or Finance
Must have an anticipated graduation date between December 2027 - 2028
Must be authorized to work in the US without requiring sponsorship now or in the future

Preferred Qualifications

High level of Excel skills required
Ability to design questionnaires, build sampling plans, and create data tabulations
Strong analytical skills – data cleaning and preparation, analyze data to extract answers to business questions
Communication Skills – Clear and effective verbal and written communication
Adaptability and Learning Agility – Willingness to learn quickly, embrace new tools or methods, and thrive in a dynamic, fast-paced environment
Technical Skills – Basic proficiency in Microsoft Office tools (e.g., Excel, Word, PowerPoint) and basic familiarity with technology solutions)
Integrity – Commitment to ethical behavior and confidentiality
