jobs.title: Senior Field Marketing Specialist (12-month Term)
jobs.description:
Opentext - The Information Company

OpenText is a global leader in information management, where innovation, creativity, and collaboration are the key components of our corporate culture. As a member of our team, you will have the opportunity to partner with the most highly regarded companies in the world, tackle complex issues, and contribute to projects that shape the future of digital transformation.

AI-First. Future-Driven. Human-Centered.

At OpenText, AI is at the heart of everything we do—powering innovation, transforming work, and empowering digital knowledge workers. We are hiring talent AI can't replace to help us shape the future of information management. Join us.

YOUR IMPACT

This is a 12-month term position.

We are seeking an organized, detail-oriented, and results-focused Senior Field Marketing Specialist to support and execute regional marketing programs across the U.S. East. This is a field marketing role for an early-career marketer who is ready to build broader experience in regional planning, sales partnership, account-based marketing, demand generation, events, and performance measurement in a large B2B technology company.

Working with guidance from field marketing leadership and colleagues, this individual will coordinate programs from planning through follow-up, maintain accurate timelines and budgets, communicate effectively with stakeholders, and ensure that every detail is completed on time and to a high standard. The role will partner with sales teams and cross-functional marketing groups, as needed, to support pipeline creation, opportunity acceleration, client engagement, and market presence.

The ideal candidate is a strong executor who takes ownership, follows through, learns quickly, and wants to develop into a Field Marketing Manager over time.

What The Role Offers

Program Planning & Execution

Support the development and execution of U.S. East field marketing plans aligned to sales priorities, campaigns, target accounts, and regional business needs.
Translate approved plans into clear project timelines, task lists, milestones, and deliverables.
Coordinate campaigns and programs from launch through follow-up, ensuring details are accurate and deadlines are met.
Identify risks, dependencies, or delays early and communicate them to the appropriate stakeholders.
Develop field marketing judgment by learning how program decisions connect to pipeline and revenue objectives.

Sales & Stakeholder Coordination

Build productive working relationships with account executives, sales development representatives, sales leaders, and marketing partners.
Coordinate program details, account lists, invitations, communications, follow-up actions, and sales enablement materials.
Prepare clear status updates and help keep sales teams informed, engaged, and accountable for agreed actions.
Gather feedback from sales and marketing partners and apply it to improve future programs.

Campaign & Demand Generation Support

Execute regional components of integrated demand-generation campaigns, including email, digital, webinar, event, and sales activation tactics.
Coordinate with campaign, digital, sales development, marketing operations, partner, and product marketing teams.
Support lead management and follow-up processes to help improve engagement and conversion.
Maintain campaign documentation and ensure program information is complete and accurate.

Account-Based Marketing Support

Support ABM programs for priority U.S. East accounts under the direction of field marketing leadership.
Help organize target-account lists, research account needs, coordinate personalized tactics, and track engagement.
Assist with client experiences, executive programs, digital outreach, thought leadership, and sales follow-up for named accounts.
Build knowledge of account planning, buying groups, whitespace opportunities, and opportunity acceleration.

Events & Experiential Marketing

Coordinate virtual, hybrid, and in-person programs, including regional events, webinars, executive roundtables, client events, conferences, and tradeshows.
Manage detailed logistics such as schedules, vendors, speakers, invitations, registration, materials, onsite requirements, and follow-up.
Maintain event checklists, budgets, purchase requirements, and stakeholder communications.
Support pre-event promotion, onsite execution, and post-event lead follow-up and reporting.

Budget, Process & Operational Excellence

Track program budgets, purchase requests, invoices, and expenses accurately and in a timely manner.
Follow marketing, finance, procurement, brand, data, and reporting processes.
Maintain organized program files, calendars, trackers, and documentation.
Look for practical ways to improve efficiency, consistency, and the stakeholder experience.

Measurement & Reporting

Track registrations, attendance, account engagement, leads, follow-up, campaign influence, and pipeline contribution using available systems and reports.
Prepare regular program updates and summarize results, lessons learned, and recommended improvements.
Develop proficiency in using data to evaluate performance and optimize future activity.

What You Bring

3+ years of experience in B2B marketing, field marketing, demand generation, events, campaigns, partner marketing, or a related role, preferably in technology.
Strong organizational and project-management skills with close attention to detail and deadlines.
Demonstrated ability to coordinate multiple programs, stakeholders, and priorities at the same time.
Clear written and verbal communication skills and confidence working with sales and marketing partners.
A proactive, dependable approach with strong follow-through and willingness to take ownership.
Interest in learning field marketing strategy, ABM, pipeline generation, executive engagement, and sales alignment.
Basic understanding of B2B demand generation, lead management, campaigns, or events.
Comfort working with data, spreadsheets, budgets, and performance reports.
Experience with Salesforce, Eloqua, 6sense, Microsoft 365, or similar marketing and productivity tools is preferred.
Bachelor's degree in marketing, business, communications, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
Ability to travel throughout the U.S. East and North America as needed.

What You Need To Succeed

You are highly organized and keep details, timelines, and commitments on track.
You take pride in accurate, high-quality execution and reliable follow-through.
You are collaborative, responsive, and comfortable supporting multiple stakeholders.
You ask thoughtful questions, apply feedback, and learn quickly.
You can manage several priorities while knowing when to escalate risks or ask for guidance.
You are client-focused and understand that strong execution should support sales and business outcomes.
You are curious about technology, AI, customer challenges, and how field marketing contributes to growth.

GROWTH AND DEVELOPMENT WITHIN THE ROLE

Learn how to build regional marketing plans aligned to sales priorities and target-account needs.
Develop stronger capability in ABM, demand generation, executive engagement, pipeline measurement, and marketing ROI.
Gain experience partnering with sales leaders and cross-functional marketing teams.
Progress from executing defined programs to independently recommending strategies and investments based on data and market insight.

If you need assistance and/or a reasonable accommodation due to a disability during the application or recruiting process, please contact us at hr@opentext.com. Our proactive approach fosters collaboration, innovation, and personal growth, enriching OpenText's vibrant workplace.

jobs.title: Product Marketing Lead
jobs.description:
About Us

Shorthand exists to empower creative teams to produce and publish beautiful, transformative content radically faster. We’ve begun our journey by creating an easy-to-use platform for one of the most creatively and technically demanding use cases on the web — immersive feature stories — and we’re proud to count many of the world’s best known and most discerning publishers, brands, not-for-profits, and universities as loyal customers.

Shorthand is a growing, investor-backed company with customers on every continent (except Antarctica!), and there’s never been a more exciting time to join our band of geeks with art and heart.

We’re looking for a Product Marketing Lead
to join our team on the US West Coast on a fully remote basis. The role comes with a high level of responsibility and autonomy and is a fantastic opportunity to join an ambitious but down-to-earth team making an outsized positive impact in the digital publishing space.

What You’ll Be Doing

You’ll own Shorthand’s story: who it’s for and how we talk about it. You’ll shape our positioning with the CEO and VP of Growth & Marketing, give Sales the narratives and proof to close deals, lead our launches, and write copy that has a point of view. We’re looking for someone who believes a product should stand out, and who’s experienced in crafting a distinctive narrative that cuts through.

You’ll be our sole product marketer, joining a small, fast-paced Growth & Marketing team that already covers content, demand gen, community, and design. This is a senior but hands-on role, with real influence over how Shorthand is seen, sold, and built.

Anyone can sign up and start building stories in Shorthand. Most of our business comes to us inbound, and our sales team works each deal from first conversation to signed contract. Your job is to make sure every step tells the same clear, compelling story.

You’ll know it’s working when Sales reaches for your materials first and we see stronger conversion and shorter sales cycles. Bonus points when people can tell a piece of Shorthand marketing is ours before they see the logo.

You’ll report to the VP of Growth & Marketing and partner with the CEO, Head of Sales, and Product team. Much of the team you’ll work with is in Australia and New Zealand, and our Head of Sales is in California. We collaborate async-first, and live calls with the ANZ team usually fall in your afternoon (Australia’s morning).

In This Role, You Will

Shape Shorthand’s positioning, segmentation, and core value propositions with the CEO and our Marketing, Sales, and Product leaders, giving Shorthand a distinctive voice and point of view
Develop a deep understanding of our buyers, users, market, and competitors, and turn it into tools the whole company uses
Build messaging frameworks, use cases, and proof points that support a sales-led motion, from first touch through to expansion
Work with customers to learn how they measure the value of Shorthand, and turn that evidence into reusable proof
Make Sales more confident and effective, with sharper deal narratives, objection handling, competitive positioning, and supporting decks and one-pagers
Make sure people who sign up to try Shorthand understand its value quickly, and help turn that early interest into sales conversations
Lead product and feature launches end-to-end — strategy and KPIs, the narrative, and coordinating execution across the company
Bring customer, market, and competitive perspective to decisions on pricing and packaging
Keep our voice and messaging consistent across the website, product pages, sales materials, lifecycle emails, and in-product touchpoints
Work with Product and Design on how features are framed, named, and introduced to customers
Feed market insight and customer feedback back into product strategy and roadmap discussions
Use Shorthand to tell Shorthand’s story — your own launches and enablement should show what the product can do

What We’re Looking For

The successful candidate will have:

A bachelor’s degree in marketing, business, journalism, communications, or a related field, or equivalent industry experience.
At least 4 years in product marketing or a closely related role, ideally in B2B SaaS or technology.
A track record of positioning work you drove yourself.
A conviction that products should stand out. You’d rather be memorable than safe and forgettable, but you know the difference between personality and gimmick.
Experience supporting a sales-led motion with enterprise buyers, including sales enablement materials (decks, one-pagers, launch assets) that you can tie to revenue outcomes.
Demonstrated success in partnering with leadership and cross-functional teams (including Sales, Product, and Marketing) to influence product, pricing, and go-to-market decisions.
Outstanding writing and communication. You’ll work closely with our content team, but they won’t be your ghostwriters: you’ll write shippable copy yourself, from website headlines and product pages to launch emails and sales decks. You can appeal to a specific buyer in a voice that’s energetic and never flat.
The ability to balance strategic thinking with hands-on execution, prioritizing impact while maintaining high standards.
A passion for visual storytelling and communicating product value on the web.

Show us your work.
Please include links to at least two pieces of work you’ve created — content, messaging, or sales enablement. If you include a cover letter, we’d love to hear from you, not Claude.

You’ll be a great fit for our team if:

You have exceptional attention to detail.
You are collaborative and know how to work with others to meet shared goals.
You are a proactive self-starter, who does not need to be told what to do and will be resourceful in order to find solutions to any challenge.
You thrive in a fast-paced and demanding environment, and possess a high level of intellectual curiosity.
You are intrinsically motivated, deriving happiness from a job well done.

Why work for us

We Offer

Options for working your way: fully remote working, flexible hours and an allowance for a co-working space if you prefer.
True autonomy, with the freedom to grow the role, and the chance to shape how our product is perceived, positioned, and sold.
The opportunity to work in a growing SaaS company that is still small enough that you can make a real impact.
An allowance for setting up your home office, a laptop, and any peripherals you need to do your job.
An Employee Option Plan for all team members.
A Health and Wellness fund to support your healthy lifestyle, as well as access to coaching and counseling services.
Paid parental leave if you are growing your tribe.
A 401(k) plan and 100% employer-paid healthcare premiums for US-based team members.
An annual learning allowance to support your professional development.
The base salary range for this position is US$135,000–$165,000. Actual compensation will depend on your skills, experience and local market benchmarks.

Shorthand’s interview process

We value direct communication here at Shorthand and want to be transparent on how we hire. Our process involves:

An initial Zoom screen: You’ll have an informal Zoom meeting with the hiring manager to discuss your background, the role, and what led you to apply.
A work task: We’ll ask you to complete a take-home task, similar to the work you’ll be doing in the role. This should take approximately 2-4 hours. This helps us to verify that you’d be a great fit for the role, and helps you better understand what you’d be doing if you joined our team. Even if we love your work, we won’t use it. This task is intended solely to help us make an informed hiring decision.
Interviews: You’ll have interviews with the hiring panel over Zoom. This means you’ll typically get to meet another 3 people from Shorthand, including our CEO.
Final checks: The successful candidate will undergo a reference and criminal background check prior to us sending the final employment agreement.

Our workplace is 100% distributed and all interviews are conducted virtually unless otherwise advised. Please let us know of any reasonable accommodations you may need during the interview process. Please use PDF versions for all documents.

jobs.title: Marketing Performance & Growth Manager
jobs.description:
At AllianceCorp, we're a leading property investment company in Australia
, helping everyday Australians build long-term wealth through property. We bring strategy, finance, property acquisition and ongoing support together under one roof, making the property investment journey simpler for our clients.

With more than 18 years in the industry, we're growing rapidly and continuing to invest in the people, technology and marketing capability that drive our success. Operating across multiple entities, our business offers opportunities to work across different functions, campaigns and growth priorities, with marketing playing a significant role in our continued expansion.

Ranked #13 among Australia's Best Places to Work, we're building a business where ambitious people can do their best work and keep raising the bar.

About the Role

Big investment. High-volume lead generation. Real commercial impact.

Marketing at AllianceCorp is a significant part of how we grow. We have a substantial multi-million-dollar marketing budget, an established team of nine people and campaigns operating across multiple channels, brands and areas of the business.

We're not working with a shoestring budget or asking one person to do everything. We invest in marketing because we understand its value, and we're looking for someone who knows how to turn that investment into measurable results.

Reporting to our Head of Brand, you'll lead the performance and optimisation of our marketing activity, connecting data, campaigns and customer journeys to drive stronger conversion and commercial outcomes.

This is a broad, hands-on management role. You'll work across paid advertising, social, landing pages, funnels, webinars, events and internal campaigns, identifying opportunities to improve performance at every stage. You'll also work across our multi-entity business, helping coordinate marketing activity around different business priorities and growth opportunities.

You'll partner closely with our wider Brand team, Sales and Technology to turn strategy into execution, test new approaches and make smarter decisions backed by data.

You'll need to be comfortable getting into the details, challenging what's not working and spotting opportunities others might miss.

Just as importantly, you'll bring the leadership capability to develop your team, improve how we operate and help build our marketing function as the business continues to scale.

What You'll Be Doing

Own the performance. Find the opportunities. Lead what's next.

Conversion rate optimisation:
Analyse landing pages, forms and customer journeys to identify friction, understand drop-off and improve the rate at which visitors become leads and clients.
Performance marketing:
Drive improvements across paid search, paid social and digital advertising, using campaign data, audience insights and lead quality to guide optimisation.
Campaign strategy and execution:
Work across a broad mix of marketing campaigns, from digital acquisition and lead-generation initiatives to webinars, events and internal campaigns, ensuring activity aligns with business priorities and is measured against clear outcomes.
Multi-entity marketing:
Coordinate and optimise marketing activity across multiple entities, understanding the different audiences, priorities and opportunities while maintaining a consistent focus on performance and commercial outcomes.
Testing and experimentation:
Build a structured approach to A/B testing across creative, messaging, offers, landing pages and calls to action. Learn from the results and turn insights into ongoing improvements.
Lead generation and funnel performance:
Identify opportunities to improve lead capture, nurture, routing and progression through the sales funnel. Partner with Sales, CRM and Technology to strengthen the end-to-end customer journey.
Data, analytics and reporting:
Use analytics and performance reporting to identify trends, understand what's driving results and translate findings into clear commercial recommendations.
Marketing investment and ROI:
Evaluate the effectiveness of campaigns and channels, identify opportunities to improve efficiency and ensure decisions are informed by performance, lead quality and business outcomes.
Cross-functional collaboration:
Work closely with the broader marketing team across organic, communications, social and campaign delivery, webinars, events - bringing a performance lens to activity across the business.
Team leadership and development:
Lead and develop your team, set clear priorities, build capability and create an environment where people can do their best work. As our marketing function grows, you'll help shape the team and how it operates.
Continuous improvement:
Stay across emerging tools, technologies and optimisation techniques, looking for smarter ways to improve our marketing performance and scale what works.

What You'll Bring

You're commercially sharp, data-driven and naturally curious. You know that launching a campaign is only the beginning. The real value comes from understanding how it performs, identifying what's holding it back and making it better.

You'll bring:

Experience in performance marketing, conversion rate optimisation, growth marketing, digital acquisition or a closely related field.
Strong experience analysing digital performance and turning data into practical, commercially focused decisions.
A solid understanding of paid search, paid social, campaign optimisation, landing pages and lead-generation funnels.
Experience designing and evaluating A/B tests, using insights to improve conversion and campaign effectiveness.
Confidence working with analytics and optimisation tools such as GA4, Google Tag Manager, heatmaps and session-recording platforms.
An understanding of CRM systems, marketing automation, lead management and the relationship between marketing activity and sales outcomes.
Experience managing or mentoring people, or the capability and ambition to take the next step into a formal leadership role.
Strong stakeholder management skills and the ability to work across teams, balance priorities and bring people along with your thinking.
A commercial mindset, a high standard of execution and the confidence to challenge assumptions when the data tells a different story.

Experience in B2C, e-commerce, financial services, property or another considered-purchase environment would be highly regarded. Experience in high-volume lead generation or a multi-brand or multi-entity business would be particularly valuable.

Why AllianceCorp?

We believe great marketing deserves the investment to match.

In many businesses, marketing teams are expected to deliver more with less: limited budgets, lean teams and responsibility for everything from strategy to execution. That's not how we approach marketing at AllianceCorp.

We recognise the role marketing plays in driving business growth, and we back our team with the resources, people and opportunities to make a meaningful impact.

A substantial marketing budget:
Work with a significant multi-million-dollar investment and the opportunity to influence how it's deployed, optimised and measured.
An established team:
Join a nine-person marketing function with expertise across different areas of marketing, giving you the support and collaboration to deliver work at scale.
Volume and quality:
Work across significant lead-generation activity while continuing lead quality, conversion and commercial performance.
Breadth of opportunity:
Get exposure to campaigns across digital advertising, social, webinars, events and more, with opportunities to influence performance across the wider business.
Multi-entity exposure:
Work across a growing business with multiple entities, giving you a broader remit and the opportunity to contribute to different business priorities.
A genuine leadership opportunity:
Lead and develop people, shape how the team works and help grow our marketing capability as AllianceCorp continues to expand.
A business that moves:
Join an ambitious, fast-growing organisation where marketing has a meaningful role in business performance and future growth.

And because the right environment matters just as much as the work, we also invest in our people through:

A market-leading parental leave policy
designed to support our people and their families.
Training and development
to keep building your skills and career.
An Employee Assistance Program (EAP)
to support wellbeing.
Quarterly engagement surveys
so our people have a voice in shaping the workplace.
Monthly team events and initiatives
that bring our people together.
Hybrid working
that supports flexibility alongside collaboration.

We're proud to be ranked #13 among Australia's Best Places to Work
, and we're committed to building a workplace where people can grow their careers, contribute meaningfully and do their best work.

Ready to Make Your Mark?

If you're a commercially minded marketer who wants to combine performance, strategy and leadership, with the resources to make a real difference, we'd love to hear from you.

As the first point of call please make sure you send your CV through to this advert. We will be in contact with you from there!

jobs.title: Marketing Analytics Manager
jobs.description:
With 1,000+ intelligence professionals serving over 1,900 clients worldwide, Recorded Future is the world’s most advanced, and largest, intelligence company!

Recorded Future is seeking a Marketing Analytics Manager.
As a Marketing Analytics Manager, you will be a strategic partner across marketing decision-making, reporting to the Senior Manager of Marketing Analytics to execute on the reporting, measurement, and data foundation that helps the business make faster, smarter, outcome-driven decisions. You will articulate compelling buyer journey stories through data for demand generation, field marketing, marketing operations, and the broader go-to-market organization. Beyond day-to-day analytics and ad hoc analysis, you'll help drive our growing investment in AI, automation, and modern data tooling, bringing curiosity and a builder's mindset to how we scale the analytics function. This role is ideal for a data-driven, business-minded analyst who wants to sit at the intersection of marketing strategy, measurement, and emerging data and AI capability in a B2B SaaS environment.

Note:
This role is required to work from the Recorded Future office in Boston, MA at least 3 days per week.

What You'll Do:

Marketing Analytics & Strategic Insights:

Serve as a strategic analytics partner across the marketing organization, translating data into insights that shape planning, investment, and campaign decisions and drive measurable business outcomes.
Develop, maintain, and refresh marketing dashboards and reports across HockeyStack, Salesforce, Domo, and Adobe CJA to track KPIs, campaign effectiveness, and ROI.
Report on top of funnel marketing performance, lead acquisition, conversion rates and velocity, and opportunity progression, to give a clear view of marketing's impact.
Support reporting needs across all levels of the business, from executive leadership to individual executors, tailoring insight to each audience.
Deliver ad hoc analysis, segment breakdowns, and channel/campaign deep dives that answer strategic questions on short turnaround.

Marketing Data Quality & Governance:

Validate reporting and ensure the numbers reconcile across systems, so stakeholders can trust the metrics they act on.
Troubleshoot and resolve integration and data discrepancies.
Help build out the marketing data warehouse, partnering with the centralized data infrastructure team to establish a scalable, reliable data foundation.
Help maintain the clean, consistent, well-governed data foundation that enables faster reporting, trusted metrics, and confident decision-making across marketing.

Attribution & Pipeline Measurement:

Support the maintenance and evolution of multi-touch attribution models, keeping reporting objects current as campaigns and channels change.
Partner with field marketing, revenue operations, and the Sales/BDR organizations on lead-to-opportunity reporting and analysis, ensuring accurate tracking of marketing-sourced and influenced pipeline.
Translate attribution and pipeline data into actionable insights that help stakeholders make informed ROI decisions when planning activities.

Automation, Tooling & AI Innovation:

Help drive our growing investment in AI and automation for marketing analytics, we're actively expanding into this space and want someone with the curiosity and passion to help shape it.
Build and extend automation and data-access workflows, including API and MCP connections, that broaden analytics and AI tooling access for the Marketing Analytics & Operations team.
Explore and apply emerging AI and data capabilities to increase analytics throughput, reduce manual work, and unlock new kinds of insight.
Develop reusable reporting templates, lightweight data products, and cross-system data workflows that scale the team's impact.

What You'll Bring:

3+ years of experience in marketing analytics, marketing/revenue operations, or a related analytical field, ideally in a B2B SaaS environment.
Strong proficiency building dashboards and reports in tools such as HockeyStack, Domo, Tableau, or Sigma, or similar BI/visualization platforms.
Hands-on experience with CRM data (particularly Salesforce) and marketing automation platforms (Marketo or HubSpot).
Hands-on experience applying AI/LLM tooling to analytics or operations workflows.
Experience building automations or integrations via APIs, with familiarity with emerging standards like MCP a plus.
Working knowledge of SQL and/or Python for data analysis and cross-system data work.
Self-driven and intellectually curious, with the initiative to dig into problems without waiting to be told how, you can pick up the business and domain along the way.
Solid understanding of the marketing funnel, lead lifecycle, and attribution concepts (multi-touch, first-touch, last-touch).
Curiosity and passion for AI, automation, and modern data tooling, with eagerness to help build in an emerging space.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to translate data into clear, actionable insights and business recommendations.
Excellent communication skills, with the ability to convey findings to non-technical stakeholders.

Preferred Qualifications:

Experience with data warehousing (e.g., Snowflake) and data-quality, ETL, or data-pipeline processes.
Exposure to customer journey analytics (e.g., Adobe CJA).
Certification in Marketo or Salesforce.
Previous experience in a high-growth, enterprise SaaS company.

jobs.title: Product Demand - Marketing Senior Manager
jobs.description:
When you join Verizon

You want more out of a career. A place to share your ideas freely — even if they’re daring or different. Where the true you can learn, grow, and thrive. At Verizon, we power and empower how people live, work and play by connecting them to what brings them joy. We do what we love — driving innovation, creativity, and impact in the world. Our V Team is a community of people who anticipate, lead, and believe that listening is where learning begins. In crisis and in celebration, we come together — lifting our communities and building trust in how we show up, everywhere & always. Want in? Join the #VTeamLife.

What You’ll Be Doing…

As the Product Demand - Marketing Senior Manager, you will play a critical role within the Growth Marketing team, directly supporting and reporting to the Associate Director of Growth Marketing product demand campaigns. You are the tactical execution engine and central point of coordination between Product, Marketing, Sales, and Solutions teams to bring growth marketing campaigns to market to drive demand.

This is an execution-focused growth marketing role—not a general product marketing function. You will translate product positioning and messaging into actionable, full-funnel growth strategies and high-converting marketing campaigns. Your focus will center on audience segmentation, targeted list development, multi-channel demand generation campaigns, and aggressive customer migration initiatives—specifically driving the transition from legacy TDM (Time Division Multiplexing) networks to Verizon’s Advanced Solutions as well as demand for these products among prospects.

Strategic Campaign Development & Coordination

Integrated Campaign Management: Developing comprehensive briefs and implementing integrated marketing campaigns designed to boost lead generation, pipeline velocity, customer acquisition, and revenue growth across Global Enterprise (GE), Public Sector (PS) and Business Market (BM) segments.
Cross-Functional Governance: Serving as the central point of coordination between Product Marketing, Segment Marketing, Field Marketing, Integrated Marketing and creative execution teams in development and execution of growth campaigns. Establishing clear communication channels and regular governance processes to provide campaign updates, align on objectives, and track execution.
Continuous Feedback Loop: Proactively engaging with field marketing and solutions teams to assess growth opportunities, actively solicit feedback on campaign performance, and rapidly iterate on tactics.

Tactical Growth Execution & Messaging Guidance

Strategy-to-Tactics Translation: Taking overarching value propositions from Product Marketing and converting them into concrete, multi-touch growth campaigns.
Messaging & Creative Guidance: Providing creative guidance based on strategic messaging for growth campaign development that highlights Verizon’s unique value, addresses key customer friction points, and demonstrates Verizon’s value proposition.
TDM-to-IP Migration Campaigns: Planning and executing time-sensitive migration campaigns to transition from legacy TDM/copper networks to modern fiber, Ethernet, and advanced wireless solutions.
Content development: Partnering with third parties and stakeholders in the development of meaningful content to drive demand in programmatic and syndication efforts.

Segmentation & List Development

Audience Segmentation: Working with database marketing to build, refine, and maintain granular target lists derived from Verizon customer base analytics
List Enrichment & AI Capabilities: Utilizing internal customer databases and AI resources to size the addressable market and develop targeted campaign lists.

Sales Enablement, Market Feedback & Performance Tracking

Sales Enablement Kits: Packaging marketing assets into plug-and-play outreach toolkits for direct sales reps and account executives to capitalize on lead generation.
Performance Analytics & Optimization: Tracking and measuring campaign progress against KPI’s (Click-to-Convert Rates, Migration TDM-to-IP Conversions, MQL/SQL Volume, and Incremental Bookings generated) to optimize ROI.

What We’re Looking For…

You are a highly collaborative, data-driven, and execution-oriented marketer who excels at hitting aggressive revenue targets. You know how to translate product capabilities into actionable demand campaigns.

You’ll Need To Have

Bachelor’s degree or four or more years of work experience.
Six or more years of relevant experience required, demonstrated through one or a combination of work and/or military experience, or specialized training.
Relevant marketing experience in B2B growth marketing, demand generation, campaign execution,marketing strategy, and/or Product Marketing.
Willingness to travel.

Even Better If You Have one or more of the following:

Experience in legacy network modernization campaigns or enterprise telecom product campaigns (Managed Network Services, IoT/FWA, Private Wireless, SIP/Voice, Wireline, CX solutions).
Experience with audience targeting.

jobs.title: Brand Manager - Unpublished R&D Product
jobs.description:
Brand Management at Riot is focused on our players. Our mission is to make it better to be a player by building trust, inspiring fandom, and delivering meaningful experiences that resonate globally.

As a Brand Manager for an undisclosed R&D game, reporting to the Director of Global Brand Management, you will help introduce a brand-new product to players for the very first time. This is a rare opportunity to be an early pioneer, shaping how this product shows up in the world, how players first experience it, and how the brand and live service evolve over time.

You will be focused on driving go-to-market strategy and executing global player experiences that bring this new game to life, operating at the intersection of product, publishing, and creative to align teams, build momentum, and deliver key moments with clarity, craft, and operational excellence. This role is ideal for a highly organized, execution-driven brand marketer who thrives in ambiguity and loves bringing big moments to market.

Responsibilities

Deliver against global go-to-market strategy, translating global game experiences into clear, actionable marketing plans, briefs, and milestones that teams can execute against with confidence
Lead execution of cross-functional campaigns end-to-end, from framing objectives and defining audiences through creative development, production, launch, and post-launch evaluation.
Partner closely with external and internal partners such as Product, Publishing, Creative, Production, Community, Social, Comms, and Regional teams to align priorities, timelines, and execution plans across functions.
Own the development and execution of core go-to-market tactics, including channel planning, asset development, launch sequencing, and cross-channel coordination across owned, earned, and partner surfaces.
Serve as the accountable on-team owner for campaign rollout and tactical execution, overseeing end-to-end development of marquee moments, including briefing and alignment with external vendors and agency partners, while partnering with producers and channel owners who support day-to-day execution.
Drive cross-functional coordination and operational rigor, maintaining sources of truth such as campaign roadmaps, timelines, creative trackers, and status updates.
Ensure campaigns are delivered on time, on brief, and on budget, proactively identifying risks and dependencies and helping teams navigate tradeoffs.
Support the development of scalable campaign frameworks and go-to-market processes that can evolve as the product grows into a long-term live service.
Partner with Analytics and Insights to evaluate campaign performance, synthesize learnings, and apply optimizations to evolve the publishing playbook.

Required Qualifications

4+ years of experience in brand management, product marketing, publishing, or equivalent roles, agency or in-house.
Experience delivering integrated go-to-market campaigns from strategy through execution in fast-moving environments.
Strong cross-functional leadership skills, with a track record of aligning multiple teams and stakeholders around shared goals.
Exceptional organizational and project management abilities, comfortable managing complex timelines, dependencies, and deliverables.
Demonstrated strength in execution, able to turn strategy into action and keep work moving forward with clarity and momentum.
Experience working on live-service products or ongoing content-driven marketing programs and with first party or third party partners to land product/brand campaigns.
Excellent communication skills, including the ability to write clear briefs, present plans, and drive alignment across partners.
Passion for games and empathy for players.

Desired Qualifications

Familiarity with global publishing models and working with regional or international partners.
Experience or passion for the games industry, entertainment, or youth-culture-driven brands.

For this role, you will find success through collaboration, operational excellence, and a deep commitment to delivering great player experiences. If you are energized by launching something new, aligning teams around bold moments, and turning ideas into action this could be the role for you.

Our Perks

Riot focuses on work/life balance, shown by our open paid time off policy and other perks such as flexible work schedules. We offer medical, dental, and life insurance, parental leave for you, your spouse/domestic partner, and children, and a 401k with company match. Check out our benefits pages
for more information.

At Riot Games, we put players first. That mission drives every decision in our quest to create games and experiences that make it better to be a player. Whether you’re working directly on a new player-facing experience or you’re supporting the company as a whole, everyone at Riot is part of our mission. If that sounds like the kind of place you want to work, we’re looking forward to your application.

jobs.description:
Blitzy is a Cambridge, MA based AI software development platform on a mission to revolutionize the software development life cycle by autonomously building custom software to unlock the next industrial revolution. We're transforming how enterprises build software, turning enterprise requirements into enterprise grade code with an agentic software development platform that can autonomously execute 80% of the quantum of software development work. We're backed by multiple tier 1 investors, and have proven success as founders of previous start-ups.

Our Culture

Who We Are

Led by two pioneering co-founders we are one of the fastest growing companies in the U.S., creating our own category of enterprise autonomous software development. We automate thousands of hours of software development for our customers, which includes strong representation within the Fortune 500.

How We Work

We move Blitzy Fast: Time is both our company’s and our clients’ most precious asset. We move quickly and decisively to innovate internally and deliver exceptional software externally.
Championship Mindset: We operate like a professional sports team. We win as a team by holding ourselves and each other to high standards, collaborating in-person, and remaining focused on the mission.
Passion for Invention: We’re pushing the frontier of what’s possible, requiring constant innovation and iteration.
We Work for the Customer: We focus on delivering outsized value to the customers we work with and expanding those relationships into deep, meaningful partnerships.

About The Role

We're looking for a VP, Marketing to report directly to our CEO and build and lead Blitzy's global marketing organization.

This is a highly strategic, hands-on leadership opportunity to shape how a category is defined, positioned, and brought to market. You'll own the entire marketing function, from category creation, brand strategy, and product positioning to messaging, demand generation, and building a scalable pipeline engine.

You'll develop a differentiated market narrative that resonates with technical and executive buyers, establish Blitzy as a category leader, and build the programs, systems, and team required to support our next phase of hypergrowth.

As a core member of the executive leadership team, you'll partner closely with Sales, Engineering and Customer Delivery to translate Blitzy's technical innovation into compelling business value and measurable revenue impact.

We're looking for a builder who can operate at both the strategic and execution levels, thrive in a fast-moving environment, and create a world-class marketing function.

Responsibilities

Define and execute Blitzy's marketing strategy to accelerate growth, revenue, and market leadership.
Own brand strategy, market positioning, messaging, and executive thought leadership.
Drive market awareness through strategic campaigns, events, analyst relations, and PR.
Lead product marketing, competitive positioning, and go-to-market strategy across Blitzy's platform.
Translate complex technical capabilities into compelling business value for enterprise buyers and executive stakeholders.
Develop customer stories, sales enablement, and persona-specific messaging that drive enterprise adoption.
Build and scale a predictable demand generation engine that delivers qualified pipeline and revenue growth.
Lead integrated campaigns across ABM, digital, field marketing, events, and strategic partnerships.
Drive an AI-first marketing strategy, leveraging automation and emerging technologies to maximize efficiency, scale impact, and deliver more with fewer resources.
Partner with Sales to drive enterprise account engagement, pipeline generation, and conversion.
Establish marketing KPIs and optimize investments based on pipeline contribution, conversion, and ROI.
Build, develop, and lead a high-performing marketing organization across all core functions.
Establish scalable marketing operations, processes, technology, and performance reporting.
Own marketing budgets, resource allocation, and strategic investment priorities.
Serve as a key member of the executive leadership team, partnering with the CEO and cross-functional leaders to drive company strategy and growth.

Qualifications

10+ years of progressive B2B marketing experience, including significant leadership experience within high-growth enterprise software, SaaS, AI, or developer technology companies.
Proven experience building and scaling a marketing organization through periods of rapid growth, ideally from early-stage through significant enterprise revenue scale.
Demonstrated success developing category-defining positioning, differentiated messaging, and compelling enterprise value propositions.
Deep expertise in product marketing, enterprise demand generation, account-based marketing, and go-to-market strategy.
Track record of building marketing programs that generate meaningful pipeline and directly contribute to revenue growth.
Strong understanding of enterprise technology buying cycles, complex buying committees, and selling to technical and C-suite stakeholders.
Experience marketing sophisticated technical platforms, ideally within AI, developer tools, cloud infrastructure, enterprise software, or digital transformation.
Proven ability to recruit, develop, and lead high-performing marketing teams while remaining hands-on when necessary.
Strong analytical and operational discipline, with the ability to connect marketing investments to measurable commercial outcomes.
Exceptional executive communication, storytelling, and cross-functional leadership skills.
A builder mentality with the ability to move quickly, operate with ambiguity, and balance long-term strategy with immediate execution.

Job Description

Marketing Account Manager – Supply

Position: Marketing Account Manager – Supply
Area: Supply
Location: Remote
Reports to: Global Strategy Supply ManagerTarget Start: ASAP

About Classic Vacations – The Classic® Difference

Classic Vacations is the #1 luxury vacation wholesaler for Travel Advisors, driven by a singular purpose: to delight our clients with exceptional vacation experiences. Our team’s commitment to excellence ensures that every journey we create is seamless, luxurious, and filled with unforgettable moments. We take pride in our role as trusted partners to travel professionals worldwide, providing world-class accommodations, unparalleled service, and exclusive privileges in premier destinations.

Role Overview

The Marketing Account Manager – Supply develops supplier-funded marketing partnerships that strengthen Classic Vacations’ position in luxury travel. Serving assigned hotel and tourism board partners across Hawaii, the South Pacific, Asia, Australia, the Americas, and other destinations, this role creates marketing opportunities that deliver measurable results and sustainable revenue growth.

The position leads partner discovery, annual co-op planning, customized proposals, presentations, negotiations, and account engagement. It manages co-op revenue goals, pipeline development, forecasting, contracts, and campaign handoffs while collaborating with Supply, Marketing, Sales, Operations, Creative, Digital, and Finance.

The role also supports European supplier marketing through proposals, campaign guidance, coordination, and reporting, while the Europe Supply team retains regional relationship ownership. Success requires strong relationships, commercial judgment, creativity, organization, and cross-functional accountability.

Why This Role Matters

This role connects supplier goals with effective co-op marketing, strengthening partner relationships, advisor engagement, revenue growth, and accountability across teams.
Key Responsibilities
Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform these essential functions.

Responsibilities include:
Supplier Marketing Strategy & Account Leadership

Strategic Account Ownership:
Serve as the primary marketing point of contact and strategic account manager for assigned hotel and tourism board partners across Hawaii, the South Pacific, Asia, Australia, the Americas, and other designated destinations, providing consistent relationship leadership, commercial direction, and marketing expertise.
Partner Discovery & Relationship Development:
Lead meaningful supplier conversations to understand partner objectives, commercial priorities, destination needs, booking windows, marketing budgets, and opportunities for mutual growth.
Annual Co-op Marketing Planning:
Lead the development of annual supplier co-op marketing strategies and plans, aligning proposed investments with partner goals, Classic's commercial priorities, and relevant advisor-facing marketing opportunities.
Customized Marketing Solutions:
Develop compelling, tailored marketing recommendations that reflect supplier needs, target audiences, destination positioning, seasonal opportunities, and Classic Vacations' luxury brand standards.
Strategic Presentations & Negotiations:
Prepare and deliver professional supplier presentations, communicate the value of Classic's marketing portfolio, and negotiate appropriate opportunities and commitments.
Incremental Revenue Opportunities:
Proactively identify opportunities for additional co-op investments, marketing packages, à la carte placements, educational programs, supplier promotions, and relevant sales events.
Relationship Continuity:
Maintain consistent, proactive communication with assigned partners, strengthening trust, managing expectations, and ensuring marketing priorities remain aligned throughout the partnership lifecycle.
Commercial Partnership Development:
Identify opportunities to deepen supplier engagement, strengthen long-term relationships, and expand the strategic and commercial value of assigned marketing accounts.

Europe Supplier Marketing Support & Regional Alignment

Europe Supply Partnership:
Collaborate closely with the Europe Supply team to support supplier marketing strategy, annual marketing plans, campaign proposals, and partner initiatives while respecting established regional relationship ownership.
Marketing Portfolio Expertise:
Provide guidance regarding Classic's available marketing programs, advertising opportunities, campaign formats, pricing structures, deliverables, and promotional capabilities.
Proposal & Presentation Support:
Assist the Europe Supply team with developing supplier-facing marketing proposals, presentations, tactic recommendations, and supporting materials.
Campaign Coordination:
Support the coordination and execution of European supplier marketing initiatives, helping ensure approved plans are communicated effectively and delivered according to agreed expectations.
Reporting & Performance Support:
Provide relevant marketing reporting, campaign insights, and performance information to support Europe Supply's partner discussions and ongoing planning.
Regional Commercial Alignment:
Ensure European marketing recommendations reflect Supply-led partner relationships, regional priorities, supplier objectives, and Classic's broader commercial strategy.
Clarity of Ownership:
Maintain a collaborative approach that distinguishes primary marketing account ownership in assigned non-European regions from the specialized marketing support provided to Europe.

Co-op Revenue Development, Forecasting & Financial Accountability

Co-op Revenue Ownership:
Manage assigned co-op marketing revenue goals, identifying opportunities to achieve and strengthen commercial performance through strategic supplier engagement.
Pipeline Development:
Maintain an accurate and actionable pipeline of proposed marketing investments, signed commitments, incremental opportunities, and potential future business.
Revenue Forecasting:
Prepare and maintain reliable co-op revenue forecasts, communicating expected commitments, changes, risks, and opportunities to appropriate leadership stakeholders.
Marketing Proposals & Agreements:
Prepare accurate supplier proposals, marketing agreements, tactic selections, pricing details, campaign street dates, and supporting contractual documentation.
Contract Coordination:
Coordinate required approval and signature workflows, ensuring marketing commitments are appropriately documented and aligned with established processes.
Commitment Tracking:
Maintain organized records of supplier marketing plans, approved tactics, campaign deliverables, financial commitments, and relevant deadlines.
Financial Reconciliation:
Reconcile marketing commitments and plan records with reporting and forecast systems to maintain visibility into revenue performance and outstanding obligations.
Finance Partnership:
Collaborate closely with Finance to coordinate co-op marketing invoicing schedules, support accurate billing and revenue tracking, provide timely forecast updates, and reconcile marketing plans against financial records.
Commercial Risk Management:
Proactively identify potential revenue shortfalls, delayed commitments, invoicing concerns, or changes affecting marketing plans and communicate recommended next steps to leadership.
Financial Integrity:
Support accurate, transparent financial reporting through timely documentation, disciplined follow-through, and consistent coordination across Supply, Marketing, and Finance.

Marketing Campaign Planning, Execution & Performance

Campaign Translation:
Convert signed supplier marketing plans into clear campaign briefs, deliverables, timelines, ownership expectations, and cross-functional execution requirements.
Cross-Functional Campaign Coordination:
Partner with Marketing Operations, Creative, Digital, Sales, and Supply to ensure marketing initiatives are executed consistently and effectively.
Multi-Channel Marketing Activation:
Coordinate supplier-funded marketing opportunities across relevant advisor-facing channels, including email, website, booking engine, social media, webinars, editorial content, and other approved marketing programs.
Campaign Readiness:
Monitor campaign preparation, creative requirements, supplier deliverables, approvals, launch dates, and operational dependencies to support timely execution.
Deliverable Accountability:
Maintain visibility into committed marketing tactics and ensure appropriate teams understand campaign expectations, deadlines, and required handoffs.
Campaign Performance Monitoring:
Review campaign performance, supplier outcomes, and relevant engagement or production indicators to evaluate marketing effectiveness.
Proof of Performance:
Coordinate the collection and communication of appropriate campaign performance documentation and reporting to support supplier commitments.
Optimization Opportunities:
Identify opportunities to refine marketing recommendations, improve campaign performance, and strengthen the value of future supplier investments.
Follow-Up Investment: Use campaign outcomes and partner feedback to identify appropriate additional marketing opportunities and support ongoing account development.

Supplier Production, Market Intelligence & Commercial Opportunities

jobs.description:
APPLY HERE!
https://lineage.typeform.com/to/lfVmQPMs

The TL;DR - Who we’re looking for

As VP of Marketing (Growth), you'll own Lineage's growth engine: new-customer acquisition, the marketing P&L, and the experimentation program behind every spend, offer, and creative decision. You'll lead a cross-functional team across paid acquisition, creative and content, CRO, ecommerce, email and retention, affiliates, and partnerships, and you'll be accountable for new-customer growth, CAC efficiency, and LTV expansion.
You'll also lead how the team uses AI across creative production, testing, reporting, and analysis, and you'll use it in your own work every day.
This role is ideal for a hands-on, analytical growth leader who has scaled a CPG or DTC brand to $100M+, runs growth on written hypotheses and clean tests, and wants to build that system at a profitable, bootstrapped, subscription-driven brand. Experience growing a brand with well-known founders is a big plus.

About Lineage

Lineage Provisions makes animal-based nutrition products with high standards for quality, nutrient density, taste, and transparency. The company was founded by Paul Saladino MD and Anthony Gustin DC and sources from producers and farms committed to regenerative agriculture. We sell primarily direct to consumer on Shopify, with most revenue coming from subscriptions. We are mid-eight figures in revenue, profitable, bootstrapped, and fully remote.

💪 Why Lineage Provisions?

We think that the majority of health products online are just a bunch of garbage with fancy labels trying to sell trendy items for a quick buck. We make the best products we possibly can to help humans eat like humans. We believe that real-food nutrition is the cornerstone for proper human health. We exist to make adhering to this lifestyle easy and delicious.
We also are passionate proponents of regenerative agriculture. Regenerative agriculture is the only way we can produce food indefinitely. The vast majority of how we currently produce food is destroying our ecosystems which we depend on for survival. The more we support regenerative agriculture, the more we support a food system that can continue to feed people in the future. There is no other option.
Eating a hyper local and seasonal diet is the best way to approach nutrition, but the reality is most food is purchased in packaged form. We aim to drive a wedge into that industry by sourcing from the best farms, making the best products, and displacing those that cut corners and sell lies.
If we’re successful with Lineage Provisions, we will help transition farms from conventional to regenerative agriculture, all while nourishing the people who are supporting us to do so. And we need your help!

About The Role

We are looking for a VP of Marketing (Growth) to lead new-customer acquisition and revenue growth across our DTC business. You will own the marketing P&L and experimentation program, and you will manage a cross-functional team spanning paid acquisition, creative and content, CRO, ecomm, email/retention, affiliate, and partnerships.
Our approach to growth is traditional: form a hypothesis, run a clean test, read the result, and apply what you learn to the next decision. The team already includes dedicated retention and marketing directors, so this role is focused on measurable growth rather than brand marketing. Success is defined by new-customer growth, CAC efficiency, and LTV expansion.

What You’ll Do

1. Growth Strategy & Experimentation
Set the growth roadmap and translate it into weekly execution and clear KPIs
Run a structured testing program across audiences, offers, funnels, landing pages, and creative, with written hypotheses, weekly readouts, and documented decisions
Own growth reporting and dashboards that leadership and finance rely on, including attribution and incrementality testing and cohort LTV analysis
Partner with finance on forecasting, budget pacing, and first-order profitability

2. Paid Acquisition
Own the paid media budget and performance across Meta, Google, YouTube, and emerging channels such as TikTok
Scale spend while holding CAC, payback, and contribution margin targets

3. Creative Strategy
Lead creative strategy for paid and organic growth: ad concept development, UGC production, and iteration speed
Work with the content team and founders to turn performance data into creative priorities

4. Acquisition Beyond Paid Social
Build affiliate and performance partnership programs
Develop programs that convert the organic audiences of Dr. Paul Saladino and Dr. Anthony Gustin into customers, including lead magnets, advertorial funnels, and whitelisting

5. Offers, Funnels & Retention
Test offers (bundles, entry price points, sample packs) and funnels (subscription, lead generation) to improve conversion rate, AOV, and acquisition efficiency
Work with the Director of Retention and Director of Marketing on email/SMS, post-purchase flows, and campaigns that improve repeat purchase rate and 30/60/90-day cohort LTV

6. Team Leadership
Lead, hire, and develop the growth team, and set quarterly goals and clear ownership across channels
Manage agency and contractor relationships while owning outcomes

😍 You'll love this role if

You approach growth like a scientist: you form hypotheses, run structured tests, and let the results decide
You enjoy building funnels, testing offers, and developing creative angles until you find what works
You think in systems and want to build a growth program that runs without you
You're hands-on and happy to build alongside your team
You use AI every day to work faster and better, and you want your team to do the same
You give direct feedback and hold yourself and your team to a high bar
You can set a clear strategy and get your team and leadership aligned behind it
You care about nutrition, real food, metabolic health, and the environment
You do your best work in a low-ego, remote, async environment where clear writing matters

🤬 You'll hate this role if:

You need a large team around you to get things shipped
You'd rather manage agencies than get into the work yourself
You prefer quick growth hacks to sustainable, customer-centric growth
You're used to scaling with large amounts of outside funding
You prefer meetings to written, async communication
You need close direction to solve problems
You're looking for a clearly defined career path
You prefer doing the same tasks every day
You prefer the structure of a large corporate environment

📈 What You’ll Bring

6+ years of growth or performance marketing experience in DTC eCommerce; CPG or supplements/VMS experience strongly preferred
Experience scaling a CPG or DTC brand to $100M+ in revenue, managing a cross-functional team and multi-million-dollar annual paid media budgets
Direct ownership of a marketing P&L, with accountability for CAC, payback, and contribution margin
A disciplined approach to testing: hypotheses in writing, well-designed tests, honest readouts, and clear scale-or-kill decisions
Strong analytical skills; you can build and explain the models behind budget decisions, including first-order profitability and ROAS vs. LTV tradeoffs
Hands-on experience with attribution and incrementality testing, using platforms such as Haus, Prescient, Triple Whale, or Northbeam
Experience growing a subscription business, with fluency in nCAC, aMER, iROAS, cohort LTV, and churn
Creative strategy experience for paid social, including ad concept frameworks and landing-page CRO

Nice to Have
Experience with founder-led or organic-to-paid acquisition programs
Background or genuine interest in health, nutrition, or food
Comfort in a fully remote, async, low-ego work environment

Compensation & Benefits

Full-time salary with bonus opportunities based on company performance. Benefits include:
Top-of-the-line health, vision, and dental plans with employer matching
Monthly stipends for local farmer's market and food, gym or personal fitness, and mental wellness
Free Kindle and unlimited free books
$3,000 per year for continued learning and training programs
Free Lineage products and friends-and-family discounts
Unlimited time off and a parent-friendly working environment
Fully remote and location-independent, with no set work schedule and no monitoring of hours

jobs.title: Head of Growth & Marketing
jobs.description:
About High Camp

High Camp was born from a love of craft cocktails and the great outdoors. What began as a Kickstarter campaign has grown into a brand known for premium, beautifully designed products that are built to last and made to share.

We design Fortified Barware for people who care about what they pour, wherever they pour it. We make it easy to craft and carry your favorite drinks everywhere from the backyard to the backcountry.

We're a lean team that has grown primarily through a strong direct-to-consumer business. Now we're building toward true omni-channel growth across DTC, wholesale/B2B, corporate gifting, and marketplaces. This hire is one of the most important seats in the company.

Head of Growth & Marketing

About the job

As Head of Growth & Marketing, you'll own High Camp's acquisition, retention, and revenue performance across our direct-to-consumer business, our largest revenue channel, while supporting marketing needs across the broader company. You'll lead our creative and performance marketing team, translate brand direction into marketing that performs across every channel, and oversee the partners and systems that power growth and e-commerce. This role is a deliberate middle ground between a pure growth operator and a CMO: strong growth fundamentals come first, with enough marketing range to serve the whole company.

This role reports to our CEO & you’ll lead an in-house team across creative, performance, and organic, and direct a roster of agency and contract partners covering media buying, email and SMS, video and design, web development, and emerging channels. You’ll own a seven-figure media budget, the partner relationships behind it, and the decisions about how this capability is resourced as we scale.

What you'll do

Own DTC growth and e-commerce performance.
Hold the DTC revenue target and contribution margin, not just top-line revenue. Whoever executes the work, the outcome sits with you.
Partner with Finance on forecasting and reporting.
Build the annual and peak-season paid media budget and an inventory-aware DTC forecast, set efficiency targets, and review performance against plan regularly.
Lead paid growth strategy.
Own risk analysis and go/no-go calls on paid and marketplace spend, using incrementality testing to know where the next marginal dollar earns the most.
Run creative as a performance lever.
Direct our in-house creative team and creative vendors, and build the creative testing program and creator/UGC pipeline that feed paid performance.
Grow organic reach.
Set direction for social, PR, affiliates and brand partnerships, and make sure they build demand that paid and retention can convert.
Own retention and lifecycle.
Set email and SMS strategy, calendar and LTV goals, and own the repeat purchase and LTV targets that come with them. You’ll work through a mix of in-house and partner resources, and you’ll shape how that mix evolves as the business scales.
Own go-to-market, launches and promotions.
Plan launches around when product actually lands and around wholesale and corporate timelines, own the promotional calendar, and translate brand direction from the founders into channel execution.
Make marketing show up for the whole company.
Make sure the content engine produces assets our wholesale and corporate custom teams can use, and that paid supports where DTC and B2B overlap, like corporate gifting in Q4. When channels compete for the same product, creative or spend, make the call that's right for the company.
Own the analytics and marketing tech stack.
Make sure tracking and reporting can be trusted, decide what to keep or retire, and direct the technical resources who run it.
Build the team.
Shape the growth and marketing functions as the business scales, deciding what to build in-house and what to contract or partner. We expect AI and automation to be a real part of that answer, so the function grows on leverage rather than headcount alone.

Key requirements

Owned the number.
You’ve owned a DTC P&L or contribution margin line at a brand doing $20M or more, and can describe the efficiency targets you were accountable for.
Came up as an operator.
You started as a media buyer or close to it, and you’ve since managed media buyers or agencies rather than only executing buys yourself.
Proven creative testing
. You’ve directed a creative team or vendors producing high-volume, fast-iteration content, and built a testing or creator/UGC program whose results changed where spend went.
Planned around real constraints
. You’ve forecast demand where supply was limited (long lead times, seasonal peaks, constrained launches) and adjusted spend to match.
Retention results.
You’ve grown repeat purchase or LTV through email and SMS, including work with outside partners.
Hands-on measurement.
You’ve run a tracking or analytics implementation and can walk us through it. You’re fluent in growth math (MER, CAC, contribution margin, incrementality) and can pressure-test any buyer’s or agency’s plan.
Built growth teams.
You’ve built and led growth teams, decided when to hire, contract or partner, and directed technical or e-commerce platform resources.
Tools.
Deep Shopify literacy, hands-on with Meta, Google and TikTok ads, and working knowledge of modern attribution tools.
Location:
Remote-friendly across the U.S., with hybrid co-working options available in Bozeman, MT; San Rafael, CA; or Golden, CO.
Travel:
Two team retreat/collaboration trips per year to a hub location, plus 2–3 additional business trips per year as needed.

Nice-to-haves

You’ve supported B2B, wholesale, retail or corporate gifting alongside DTC.
Experience on both sides of the agency table, or running an agency selection or transition.
Incrementality testing and media-mix modeling, or experience scaling newer channels like AppLovin and TikTok.
You’ve worked on premium consumer goods, lifestyle brands, or hard goods, where the product itself carries the brand.

Salary & benefits

Expected base salary range (San Francisco Bay Area): $170,000 - $210,000 USD. Offered compensation will vary based on geographic location, as well as relevant experience, domain knowledge, and interview performance.

Eligible for target bonus of 20% of base salary
Choice of three PPO medical plans, with employee coverage on our base plan 100% company-paid
Dental, vision, and HSA plan options
Flexible PTO
401(k) with up to 5% company match
Monthly cell phone stipend
Paid parental leave (16 weeks for birthing parents, 12 weeks for non-birthing parents)
Remote-friendly, with flexible schedules in a high-trust, high-autonomy culture
Office hubs and bi-annual company offsites for in-person collaboration and community

High Camp is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy, sexual orientation, or gender identity), national origin, age, disability, genetic information, marital status, veteran status, or any other legally protected characteristic. Applicants must be currently authorized to permanently work in the United States. At this time, we are not able to sponsor employment visas or provide relocation assistance.

Join Axon and be a Force for Good.
At Axon, we’re on a mission to Protect Life. We’re explorers, pursuing society’s most critical safety and justice issues with our ecosystem of devices and cloud software. Like our products, we work better together. We connect with candor and care, seeking out diverse perspectives from our customers, communities and each other.

Life at Axon is fast-paced, challenging and meaningful. Here, you’ll take ownership and drive real change. Constantly grow as you work hard for a mission that matters at a company where you matter.
Your Impact

We are looking for a highly motivated, data-driven Paid Media Manager to own and elevate Axon’s targeted paid advertising strategies. In this role, you will lead end-to-end strategy, execution, and continuous optimization across our paid digital channels. 
Beyond channel management, you will serve as both an analytical steward and a persuasive creative force, crafting compelling, high-converting ad copy and integrating paid media channels directly into our reporting tools for transparent, real-time ROI tracking. You will work closely with Product Marketing, Growth Marketing, Creative, Web, and Marketing Ops teams to build aligned, performance-driven campaigns that resonate with our specialized audiences. If you thrive on finding high-intent opportunities, relentlessly pursuing performance efficiency, and turning analytics into growth, you will play a transformative role in driving Axon's global mission.
  What You’ll Do

Location:
Scottsdale, Boston, or Seattle Office (Hybrid Schedule: Mon remote, Tues-Fri in office)
Reports to:
Head of Digital Marketing

None
Build and own the annual paid media plan, including channel mix, audience strategy, and testing roadmap, and present results, insights, and recommendations to stakeholders and leadership. 
Develop, launch, and optimize campaigns across paid search, paid social, programmatic and display, retargeting, YouTube, industry publications, and ABM platforms. 
Conduct ongoing keyword research and trend analysis to identify high-intent opportunities for campaign expansion and performance improvement.
Connect ad platforms with CRM, marketing automation, and analytics tools to ensure accurate, real-time tracking of ROI, attribution, and conversions, and report on performance with clear strategy recommendations and A/B testing opportunities for key stakeholders.
Monitor spend, pacing, and performance metrics, making data-driven adjustments and bid updates to maximize efficiency.
Reach niche audiences while adhering to compliance, brand, and platform policy requirements. 
Ensure alignment between paid programs and broader product and growth marketing initiatives, as well as paid and organic search strategies, for cohesive performance across all digital touchpoints.
Partner with global and localization teams to extend paid campaigns into international markets, adapting strategy and messaging for regional audiences and privacy requirements. 
Craft copy that drives conversions. Collaborate with creative, web, and content teams on ad design, landing pages, and conversion rate optimization. 
Stay up to date with digital marketing trends, algorithm updates, and emerging ad tech to continuously refine strategies.

What You Bring

7+ years of experience in B2B digital marketing, directly managing performance-focused paid campaigns.
Deep expertise in search engine marketing (SEM) and intent-based keyword strategy, with a working knowledge of SEO and how it complements paid.
Advanced hands-on experience with Google Ads, Microsoft/Bing Ads, and LinkedIn Campaign Manager, plus experience with additional paid channels such as programmatic, paid social, or ABM platforms.
Experience integrating ad channels with marketing automation platforms, CRM, and analytics reporting tools.
Strong analytical capabilities with a proven ability to translate complex datasets into actionable growth insights.
Proactive, curious, solution-oriented, and highly collaborative mindset with exceptional attention to detail and campaign pacing skills.
Strong copywriting skills with experience crafting high-performing, conversion-focused ad and landing page copy.

Competitive salary and 401k with employer match
Discretionary paid time off

Medical, Dental, Vision plans
Fitness Programs

Learning & Development programs
And yes, we have snacks in our offices
