Job Description

Join Team Amex and let's lead the way together.

Resy is the American Express global dining platform within U.S. Consumer Services (USCS). Our mission is to power the world’s best restaurants, using technology to imagine the future of hospitality. Our customers discover the amazing world of restaurants thanks to our content-rich website and innovative mobile app. Our diners are insiders, and we love having them at the table. The team is responsible for reimagining hospitality and redefining the way restaurants and diners connect through a single network.

Interested in joining our team of restaurant-obsessed explorers? Right this way.   

About The Role

We’re looking for a Senior
Analyst, Venue Retention & Lifecycle Marketing
, to support the execution and optimization of Resy’s venue retention, nurture, and B2B content marketing strategy. Reporting to the Manager of Venue Lifecycle and Retention Marketing
, this role will play a key part in bringing data-driven, multi-channel marketing programs to life that deepen restaurant partner engagement, strengthen loyalty, drive product adoption, and support long-term partner retention.

This individual will work closely with the Manager of Venue Retention Marketing to execute partner nurture strategies and B2B content programs across the venue lifecycle
, translating strategic priorities, partner insights, and product value into relevant and compelling communications. They will own key executional workstreams across email and editorial content
including the B2B Content Calendar and end-to-end development of Resy’s partner eNewsletter, while supporting the development and execution of trigger-based and ongoing nurture journeys.

The role will sit at the intersection of lifecycle marketing, B2B content, email execution, and marketing operations
. This person will partner cross-functionally with Marketing, Partner Success, Product, Creative, Compliance, and other teams to move campaigns and initiatives from ideation and briefing through development, approval, deployment, measurement, and optimization. They will bring strong operational rigor to the team, ensuring that multiple campaigns, stakeholders, approvals, and deadlines are effectively managed.

The ideal candidate is an organized and execution-oriented marketer with strong email, editorial, and social instincts and analytical curiosity
. They are equally comfortable developing a content idea, building an email campaign, coordinating a legal review, analyzing campaign performance, and managing a complex project plan. They have a desire to understand our hospitality partners and use data-driven lifecycle marketing to create communications that deliver meaningful value.

Responsibilities

Support the execution and optimization of Resy’s venue retention and lifecycle marketing strategy, bringing partner-facing content and communications to life across email, editorial, and social channels.
Lead execution of partner email and lifecycle programs, including Resy’s partner eNewsletter, developing relevant, engaging communications across key partner moments while evolving and optimizing evergreen engagement strategies.
Manage Resy’s B2B editorial ecosystem, including supporting blog maintenance and owning the content calendar, translating product capabilities, industry trends, partner stories, and business priorities into timely partner-facing content.
Partner with the Manager to advance personalization, segmentation, and ongoing optimization of email and content, using partner insights and performance data to improve the relevance and effectiveness of communications.
Support cross-functional campaign execution, partnering with Sales, Partner Success, Product, Product Marketing, Creative, Compliance, and other stakeholders to keep initiatives aligned and on track.
Support the development of partner retention and loyalty strategies, identifying opportunities to deepen engagement through new channels, programs, events, and partner experiences.
Maintain strong operational processes and project management across campaigns and content, ensuring clear timelines, approvals, documentation, and performance reporting.
Partner cross-functionally with Sales, Partner Success, Product, Product Marketing, Creative, and other teams to ensure partner communications reflect shared business objectives.

Qualifications

2+ years of experience in lifecycle, CRM, email, B2B, content, digital, or integrated marketing, ideally within a SaaS, technology, hospitality, or partner-focused organization.
Hands-on experience developing and executing email or lifecycle marketing campaigns, with an understanding of campaign development from audience definition and content creation through QA, deployment, and reporting.
Strong editorial and writing skills, with the ability to generate content ideas and translate business priorities, product capabilities, and audience needs into clear and compelling B2B communications; familiarity with SEO principles is a plus.
Experience supporting or executing nurture and lifecycle marketing programs, with an understanding of segmentation, personalization, behavioral triggers, and journey-based marketing; familiarity with HubSpot is a plus.
Strong analytical skills, with the ability to use campaign performance, CRM data, partner feedback, research, and other qualitative and quantitative insights to inform marketing decisions and identify opportunities for optimization.
Strong project management and organizational skills, with experience managing multiple campaigns, stakeholders, timelines, dependencies, and approval processes.
Experience navigating Compliance, Brand, or other structured marketing approval processes is a plus.
Strong written and verbal communication skills and demonstrated ability to collaborate effectively across functions and stakeholders.

You’ll Thrive In This Role If You

Are both creative and execution-oriented—you enjoy developing content and campaign ideas and are equally energized by bringing them to life.
Have strong editorial instincts and intellectual curiosity, with an interest in understanding what content will be useful and engaging for Resy’s partners.
Are a highly organized project manager with exceptional attention to detail who can bring structure to complex work and keep multiple workstreams moving at once.
Are proactive and take ownership, following up with stakeholders, anticipating roadblocks, and keeping projects moving without needing every next step defined.
Have a “can do” approach to problem solving and are comfortable operating amid ambiguity, white space, evolving priorities, and strategic pauses.
Are analytically curious and interested in using performance data, partner behavior, and feedback to understand what’s working and continuously improve your work.
Are a strong cross-functional collaborator who can build productive relationships across Marketing, Partner Success, Product, Creative, Compliance, and external partners.
Have a desire to continuously learn and improve, building your expertise across lifecycle, content, and B2B marketing.
Have a passion for the hospitality industry and curiosity about the challenges, priorities, and opportunities facing Resy’s partners.

Beyond channel management, you will serve as both an analytical steward and a persuasive creative force, crafting compelling, high-converting ad copy and integrating paid media channels directly into our reporting tools for transparent, real-time ROI tracking. jobs.title: Senior Product Marketing Manager
jobs.description:
About OpenSesame

OpenSesame is the trusted partner for workforce reinvention in the age of AI. We deliver integrated software, curated and customizable content, and expert services embedded into existing learning, HR, and work systems to help organizations expand their human + AI potential and thrive through change.

About the Role

OpenSesame is on a mission to become the global leader in corporate training and professional learning. As we expand our platform offerings and reinvent our workforce through AI adoption we are looking for an experienced Senior Product Marketing Manager to own this function within the organization and guide our strategic positioning, messaging, and enablement forward.

This role acts as the strategic centerpiece in our GTM org and is ideal for professionals who enjoy entrepreneurial ownership, cross-functional collaboration, and being a hands-on builder of strategy and assets.

Key Responsibilities:

Revenue Enablement:
Act as a subject-matter expert on messaging, market position, and competition. Develop GTM assets, case studies, and battlecards to aid the sales process.
Go-to-Market
- You’ll own the end-to-end GTM for the new product & features launching, from positioning & messaging, to asset creation, GTM launch management and internal enablement. You’ll collaborate with Product, Sales, Marketing and Customer Success teams to help create and test the positioning & messaging for your portfolios, which may include technology products and features, partnerships, or publishers.
GTM Impact Analysis:
Plan and execute ongoing analysis of the sales funnel, collateral kit, and GTM strategy inclusive of Win/Loss, sales cycle, engagement, and response.
Launch Program:
Build and manage a company-wide launch process for planning and directing the scope, schedule, and execution of our most critical moments.
Market Research:
Stay ahead of market trends, customer needs, and competitor moves. Engage with analysts and other industry stakeholders to build our brand and inform strategy. Use your insider-knowledge of our personas and industry to shape our unique approach to market.
Messaging & Positioning:
Build a compelling narrative around our products and value that we can take to market and win with. Help the organization tell our story more effectively by developing and aligning messaging, value propositions, and audiences.
Cross-Functional Alignment:
Collaborate with other teams to align GTM strategy, identify collateral needs, influence pricing and packaging, and ensure our market position is optimized for success.
Personal Effectiveness & AI utilization:
Create your own urgency, keep work organized, and have line of sight to achieving all deadlines. Have a plan to incorporate AI into the daily flow of work to contribute to your effectiveness.

Performance Objectives

First 30 Days:

Audit the existing selling collateral kit and sales playbook to identify areas of opportunity and notable gaps.
Refresh our competitor battlecards to reflect current market conditions and changes in messaging tied to AI.
Develop a working perspective on our brand messaging framework and identify gaps in implementation of this framework across the entire portfolio of channels and assets.
Create an initial POV on the key drivers of our value proposition that includes partners, publishers, and technology.
Establish relationships with key stakeholders across product management, sales, and the partner teams.
Learn about OpenSesame products and solutions and be able to accurately speak to their opportunities and position in the market.
Outline the plan for incorporating AI into the product marketing workflows.

First 90 Days:

Support GTM enablement as a subject-matter expert on messaging, market dynamics, competition, and positioning.
Establish a template and process for conducting company launches with an emphasis on cross-functional collaboration and audience optimization.
Establish a reporting cadence for key metrics including asset utilization, launch adoptions and outcomes, pipeline influence, and sales cycle metrics.
Collaborate with marketing stakeholders to build a messaging transition to in-market campaign process, determining key steps, templates, and RACI to ensure alignment between strategic messaging and positioning decisions and how we bring that to life in the market.
Build at least one LLM-based workflow to optimize your work.

First 6 Months:

Plan and engage analysts and industry stakeholders to evangelize OpenSesame’s products and position to share our story far and wide.
Deepen our GTM collateral kit through segmentation and targeting including industry-specific plays, persona targeted assets, and variable flows.
Utilize AI tools and processes to automate workflows, build templates, and gain organizational traction across the PMM function.
Leverage our robust publisher, partner, and customer audiences towards a combined narrative that compounds our value in the market.

By the end of Year 1:

Accelerate workflows across the GTM organization through streamlined, efficient processes, AI-enabled automations, and a fully realized PMM playbook.
Demonstrably accelerate and improve sales win rate, cycle speed, and engagement through improved collateral, processes, and strategic direction.
Help OpenSesame establish a defensible brand position as a global leader in corporate training and AI-enabled learning.

You might notice we don’t have the typical list of requirements and buzzwords here. That’s intentional.
We’re looking for proven examples from your career that show you can do this job, that you’ve built systems, driven alignment, and created impact at scale. When you look back a year from now, you’ll know you’ve made OpenSesame better, faster, and stronger because of your leadership.
Although it should go without saying (but it doesn’t), OpenSesame is an equal opportunity employer and we strive to create a welcoming, inclusive environment that celebrates diversity.

We use AI. For real.
Every team at OpenSesame works with AI tools daily, not as a buzzword, but as practice. You'll build fluency that most companies are still talking about adopting, with hands-on training and clear guardrails to experiment responsibly. AI amplifies your creativity and judgment. It doesn't replace them. The skills you build here travel with you.

Location:
This position can be based anywhere in the US. We operate as a remote-first company, and invest in mandatory all-company meetings several times a year in addition to required team travel as necessary.

Performance Driven:
We're looking for self-starters with a track record of delivering excellent results, but we're highly selective about who we hire. We don't focus on typical job requirements, instead, we're interested in specific examples from your past experiences. We're looking for a commercial expert with deep experience in the payer or life sciences
industry. You'll have spent your career marketing to, selling to, or enabling teams that sell into these organizations. As our Senior Industry Expert, you'll be the Revenue Operations team's in-house authority on these markets: how customers buy, what pressures they face, and what makes them say yes. You'll use that knowledge to shape how marketing, sales enablement and training, and sales operations go to market in these segments.

You'll set direction, pressure-test plans, and make sure every campaign, playbook, training program, and territory model reflects how our customers actually work. You'll partner closely with, Sales, Product, and other teams in RevOps to establish segment strategy.

Be the voice of the customer. Act as the go-to expert on payer and/or life sciences customers: their business models, buying committees, budget cycles, regulatory environment, and top priorities. Turn that knowledge into guidance the whole RevOps team can use.
Shape segment RevOps strategy. Help set multi-year go-to-market strategy for payer and life sciences segments across marketing, sales enablement and training, and sales operations. Identify where we should focus, where we're underinvesting, and what needs to change.

Raise the bar on sales readiness. Define what "industry fluent" means for our sellers. Shape enablement curricula, playbooks, discovery frameworks, and value messaging, and help subject matter experts and trainers deliver them credibly.
Inform sales operations. Give industry input on segmentation, account prioritization, territory design, pipeline expectations, and forecasting assumptions for these segments.
Track the market. Monitor industry trends, regulatory changes, competitive moves, and emerging customer needs. Translate them into clear implications and recommendations for leadership.
Build credibility in the field. Join strategic customer conversations and deal reviews when needed, and act as a trusted peer to sales leaders and account teams.
Connect the dots across functions. Bring Product, Marketing, Sales, and Customer Success together around a shared view of segment opportunities and priorities.

6+ years in a commercial role (marketing, sales, or sales enablement) within or selling to the payer or life sciences industry.
Deep understanding of how your industry operates: organizational structures, key personas, buying processes, economic drivers, and regulatory context

Blue Star Families

Blue Star Families is the largest nonprofit dedicated to making military life better for families. Each year, we support over 1.5 million military- and veteran-connected family members through a national network of 300,000+ members and local chapters in communities across the country.

Our mission is simple and bold: We make military life awesome for families.

We listen, share, partner, and act to deliver evidence-based, data-driven solutions that work for real people. We’re a lifestyle organization, a friend and neighbor, and a trusted partner. Our approach is collaborative, human-centered, and designed with the whole family in mind.

A Blue Star Family is one with an immediate family member — a spouse, parent, or child — actively serving in the U.S. Armed Forces, including the Guard and Reserves. These families face unique challenges: frequent relocations, deployments, career disruption, and isolation. We respond with research-informed programs that create connection, build resilience, and foster a true sense of belonging.

We serve with urgency but build trust over time — because change happens at the speed of trust. Whether we’re driving spouse employment, supporting caregivers, or helping communities welcome military families, we strive for upstream solutions.

Who We’re Looking For

Bold thinkers. Fast movers. Smart collaborators. People who want to build, lead, and drive measurable change — and who care deeply about making an impact that matters.

What You’ll Do Here

Solve complex challenges with data, heart, and humility
Build cross-sector partnerships that get things done
Help military families feel at home wherever they live

If you're ready to work in a high-performance, mission-driven environment — and to make life better for those who serve — Blue Star Families is where you belong.

General Description

The Vice President, Direct Marketing & Peer-to-Peer Fundraising leads the strategy and performance of Blue Star Families' direct response and peer-to-peer fundraising programs. This role grows BSF's broad base of individual donors through multi-channel direct marketing. It also builds scalable peer-to-peer and grassroots giving programs that engage volunteers, ambassadors, chapter members and community members as fundraisers on behalf of military families.

Reporting to the Chief Development Officer and directly supervising [direct report title(s)], this leader partners closely with Marketing, Development Operations and Chapters/Programs staff to integrate direct marketing and peer-to-peer fundraising into the organization's broader revenue strategy.

This role requires the ability to travel overnight several times per year to attend team offsites, leadership sessions, fundraising events and company-wide events. Attendance and participation in these gatherings is a non-negotiable component of the position.

Key Job Functions

Direct Marketing & Mass-Market Fundraising

Oversee multi-channel direct response strategy, including donor acquisition, retention, reactivation, and upgrade pathways across direct mail, email, digital advertising, SMS, and other mass-market channels.
Set annual revenue goals, budgets and performance benchmarks for direct marketing programs.
Ensure rigorous segmentation, A/B testing, and performance-based ROI analysis to inform channel investment, with a bias toward rapid experimentation and scaling winning plays.
Manage relationships with external direct marketing vendors and agencies (e.g., MissionWired), ensuring quality, timeliness, and cost-effectiveness; hold partners to the same high-performance standard as internal team members.
Monitor campaign performance, donor acquisition costs, retention, and lifetime value metrics, adjusting strategy as needed.
Build a clear pathway that moves donors from first-time gifts to recurring, mid-level and major gift potential.

Peer-to-Peer & Grassroots Fundraising

Design and grow peer-to-peer fundraising programs (e.g., team and individual fundraising campaigns, DIY fundraising, ambassador programs) to diversify and expand BSF's donor base.
Partner with Marketing to build compelling peer-to-peer campaign assets, digital fundraising pages, and participant communications.
Develop toolkits, training and playbooks that equip volunteers, ambassadors and chapter leaders to fundraise effectively.
Set and track participant recruitment, fundraising, and retention goals across peer-to-peer campaigns.
Create a visible scoreboard and recognition program that celebrates top fundraisers and teams and fuels healthy competition.
Launch, test, and iterate on new peer-to-peer concepts quickly, scaling winning approaches and retiring those that underperform.
Convert peer-to-peer donors and participants into ongoing supporters through targeted direct marketing follow-up.

Team Leadership & Performance Management

Supervise staff and provide leadership and coaching to expand the chapter fundraising support function.
Develop, coach, and appraise staff to ensure high performance and professional growth, providing regular, candid feedback and addressing performance gaps promptly.
Build a high-talent-density team in which every member understands the strategy, owns their results, and makes decisions quickly.
Foster a collaborative, solutions-oriented culture aligned with BSF values across the chapter network, grounded in freedom, responsibility, and accountability.

Program Integration & Cross-Functional Coordination

Partner with Marketing & Communications on donor messaging, campaign creative, branding and channel strategy.
Coordinate with the Chapters/Programs team to engage chapter members and volunteers in peer-to-peer campaigns.
Ensure alignment between direct marketing, peer-to-peer, major gifts, corporate and events strategies to build strong donor pipelines.

Systems, Data & Reporting

Oversee accurate tracking of chapter and peer-to-peer fundraising activity within the CRM, ensuring data integrity and consistent reporting.
Establish performance dashboards and revenue pacing for direct marketing and peer-to-peer channels, using them as a real-time scoreboard for the team.
Provide regular reporting to the Chief Development Officer, and to the Board as needed, on channel performance, donor retention and revenue forecasts.
Perform other duties as assigned.

Required Experience, Skills, Background

8+ years of progressive nonprofit development experience, including experience with chapter-based, affiliate, or peer-to-peer fundraising models.
3+ years of experience managing staff or leading a team.
Demonstrated experience building or scaling peer-to-peer, grassroots, or volunteer-driven fundraising programs.
A proven track record of meeting or exceeding ambitious revenue and participation goals, with specific, measurable wins you can speak to.
An athlete's mindset: high energy, competitive drive, resilience after setbacks, and a hunger to keep improving.
A coach's ability to motivate, hold accountable, and bring out the best in staff and volunteers alike.
Comfort operating with a high degree of autonomy and accountability, and the ability to give and receive candid feedback.
Experience developing training, toolkits, or resources to support a distributed or volunteer fundraising network.
Strong relationship-building skills with the ability to motivate and support volunteer leaders across a geographically dispersed organization.
Demonstrated success working with CRM systems (preferably Salesforce) and peer-to-peer fundraising platforms.
Strong organizational, analytical, and communication skills.
Ability to travel to chapters and organizational gatherings several times per year, including overnight travel.
May be required to work nights, weekends, and holidays as necessary to carry out key job functions.

Desired Experience, Skills & Background

Bachelor's degree in nonprofit management, business administration, or a related field.
Experience in membership-driven, chapter-based, or affiliate nonprofit organizations.
Familiarity with the military and Veteran-connected community.
Experience with peer-to-peer fundraising software (e.g., Classy, GoFundMe Charity, OneCause).
Experience in a high-growth, performance-driven culture (nonprofit or private sector).

More About Blue Star Families

Blue Star Families empowers military and Veteran families to thrive by connecting them with their civilian neighbors — both people and organizations — to create strong communities of mutual support. We believe we're all stronger when we take care of one another.

Our groundbreaking research is raising the nation's awareness of the unique challenges of military family life. With the help of neighbors across the country, Blue Star Families is overcoming the isolation and alienation of frequent moves, deployments, and reduced support from the government. Our innovative programs are solving specific challenges for military families, including fighting economic insecurity with resources that foster spouse career development, creating family strength with rich family programming, and providing critical peer support for caregivers, whose numbers are only increasing.

Blue Star Families is a registered 501(c)(3) nonprofit organization.

jobs.title: Lead Marketing Scientist
jobs.description:
The science is yours. The work is ours.

Due to unprecedented growth, we now need a part-time or full-time expert to join the team and work alongside our account directors to lead client engagements.

Our Account Director leads the client engagement. You support them with advisory.

You do none of the heavy lifting. No data collection, no model building, no slide production, no selling. The team does all of that and hands you the finished work: the model, the diagnostics, the planner output, the draft readout and the open questions. You of course make sure you are happy with every input and output along the way, and you can be as involved in that as you like.

WHAT YOU DO

Review the team's work and send it back with your notes. Two or three rounds is normal.

Decide what the evidence supports. Every readout ends in proceed, stage, test or defer.

Join the client call with the Account Director as the scientist in the room. You stand behind what you have reviewed, and say so when the evidence is not there.

Turn what you catch into checks the team runs next time.

ABOUT SEEDA

A six-year-old marketing mix modelling business with customers around the world. A full team in Vietnam, led from Sydney, collects the data, builds and refits the Bayesian models, runs the planner and writes the first draft of every readout, on an AI platform that does the heavy lifting.

HOW IT WORKS

Part-time or full-time, your choice. Part-time is about five hours in a brand's first month and four a month after that, growing with the brands we add. Your own practice can continue; the role is not exclusive. You get each brand's schedule and a written brief ahead of time.

The first brand is ready now: a US subscription brand in travel services, with a decision on a planned increase in media spend. Client calls are in US Eastern business hours; where you live is up to you.

YOU

5+ years in marketing science, marketing analytics or econometrics, with real marketing mix models behind you.
You have sat in front of a CMO or CFO and defended a model, and you have also told one what the model could not say.
Fluent in Bayesian MMM: priors, identifiability, adstock and saturation, holdouts, calibration against experiments.
You think in decisions and write with precision. A client reads your note and knows what to do on Monday.
Comfortable with an AI-first team: the first draft of everything you review was made with AI, and you know how to check it.

HOW TO APPLY

Apply here on LinkedIn with a few lines on the marketing mix models you have presented to clients. We reply to everyone, and the process from there is a conversation, then a short paid trial.

We're looking for someone who can help establish a consistent, professional visual identity across our marketing channels while ensuring campaigns and communications are planned, coordinated, and executed effectively. The ideal candidate is comfortable working independently, managing multiple projects, and turning ideas into polished marketing materials.

Email Marketing & Campaign Coordination

Plan, create, and coordinate weekly email marketing campaigns.
Manage campaigns across platforms such as Mailchimp, HubSpot, and Apollo.
Maintain and organize contact databases, including email data entry and list management.
Develop reusable email templates to improve consistency and efficiency.
Coordinate campaign calendars, scheduling, and distribution.

Social Media & Content

Create and schedule social media content, primarily for LinkedIn.
Coordinate website updates, blog posts, and product announcements.
Develop cohesive messaging and visual assets across channels.
Maintain a consistent publishing schedule.

Branding & Graphic Design

Establish and maintain a consistent visual identity across company communications.
Develop a catalog of reusable marketing templates.
Create graphics for email campaigns, social media, presentations, and promotional materials.
Improve the overall quality and consistency of our external communications.

Sales & Internal Marketing Support

Work closely with the sales team to develop supporting marketing materials.
Create and maintain standardized company document templates, presentations, and email signatures.
Assist with promotional materials for new products, services, and campaigns.
Support the preparation of customer-facing marketing collateral.

Assist with planning and coordinating conference participation.
Source and coordinate branded merchandise, giveaways, and promotional materials.
Help prepare event-related marketing materials and communications.

Qualifications

Previous experience in marketing coordination, digital marketing, or a similar role.
Strong graphic design skills and a good eye for layout, typography, and visual consistency.
Familiarity with email marketing platforms and CRM tools.
Experience creating content for LinkedIn and other business-oriented channels.
Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.
Ability to manage multiple ongoing activities independently.
Excellent written English communication skills.

jobs.title: Head of Growth & Marketing
jobs.description:
About High Camp

High Camp was born from a love of craft cocktails and the great outdoors. What began as a Kickstarter campaign has grown into a brand known for premium, beautifully designed products that are built to last and made to share.

We design Fortified Barware for people who care about what they pour, wherever they pour it. We make it easy to craft and carry your favorite drinks everywhere from the backyard to the backcountry.

We're a lean team that has grown primarily through a strong direct-to-consumer business. Now we're building toward true omni-channel growth across DTC, wholesale/B2B, corporate gifting, and marketplaces. This hire is one of the most important seats in the company.

Head of Growth & Marketing

About the job

As Head of Growth & Marketing, you'll own High Camp's acquisition, retention, and revenue performance across our direct-to-consumer business, our largest revenue channel, while supporting marketing needs across the broader company. You'll lead our creative and performance marketing team, translate brand direction into marketing that performs across every channel, and oversee the partners and systems that power growth and e-commerce. This role is a deliberate middle ground between a pure growth operator and a CMO: strong growth fundamentals come first, with enough marketing range to serve the whole company.

This role reports to our CEO & you’ll lead an in-house team across creative, performance, and organic, and direct a roster of agency and contract partners covering media buying, email and SMS, video and design, web development, and emerging channels. You’ll own a seven-figure media budget, the partner relationships behind it, and the decisions about how this capability is resourced as we scale.

What you'll do

Own DTC growth and e-commerce performance.
Hold the DTC revenue target and contribution margin, not just top-line revenue. Whoever executes the work, the outcome sits with you.
Partner with Finance on forecasting and reporting.
Build the annual and peak-season paid media budget and an inventory-aware DTC forecast, set efficiency targets, and review performance against plan regularly.
Lead paid growth strategy.
Own risk analysis and go/no-go calls on paid and marketplace spend, using incrementality testing to know where the next marginal dollar earns the most.
Run creative as a performance lever.
Direct our in-house creative team and creative vendors, and build the creative testing program and creator/UGC pipeline that feed paid performance.
Grow organic reach.
Set direction for social, PR, affiliates and brand partnerships, and make sure they build demand that paid and retention can convert.
Own retention and lifecycle.
Set email and SMS strategy, calendar and LTV goals, and own the repeat purchase and LTV targets that come with them. You’ll work through a mix of in-house and partner resources, and you’ll shape how that mix evolves as the business scales.
Own go-to-market, launches and promotions.
Plan launches around when product actually lands and around wholesale and corporate timelines, own the promotional calendar, and translate brand direction from the founders into channel execution.
Make marketing show up for the whole company.
Make sure the content engine produces assets our wholesale and corporate custom teams can use, and that paid supports where DTC and B2B overlap, like corporate gifting in Q4. When channels compete for the same product, creative or spend, make the call that's right for the company.
Own the analytics and marketing tech stack.
Make sure tracking and reporting can be trusted, decide what to keep or retire, and direct the technical resources who run it.
Build the team.
Shape the growth and marketing functions as the business scales, deciding what to build in-house and what to contract or partner. We expect AI and automation to be a real part of that answer, so the function grows on leverage rather than headcount alone.

Key requirements

Owned the number.
You’ve owned a DTC P&L or contribution margin line at a brand doing $20M or more, and can describe the efficiency targets you were accountable for.
Came up as an operator.
You started as a media buyer or close to it, and you’ve since managed media buyers or agencies rather than only executing buys yourself.
Proven creative testing
. You’ve directed a creative team or vendors producing high-volume, fast-iteration content, and built a testing or creator/UGC program whose results changed where spend went.
Planned around real constraints
. You’ve forecast demand where supply was limited (long lead times, seasonal peaks, constrained launches) and adjusted spend to match.
Retention results.
You’ve grown repeat purchase or LTV through email and SMS, including work with outside partners.
Hands-on measurement.
You’ve run a tracking or analytics implementation and can walk us through it. You’re fluent in growth math (MER, CAC, contribution margin, incrementality) and can pressure-test any buyer’s or agency’s plan.
Built growth teams.
You’ve built and led growth teams, decided when to hire, contract or partner, and directed technical or e-commerce platform resources.
Tools.
Deep Shopify literacy, hands-on with Meta, Google and TikTok ads, and working knowledge of modern attribution tools.
Location:
Remote-friendly across the U.S., with hybrid co-working options available in Bozeman, MT; San Rafael, CA; or Golden, CO.
Travel:
Two team retreat/collaboration trips per year to a hub location, plus 2–3 additional business trips per year as needed.

Nice-to-haves

You’ve supported B2B, wholesale, retail or corporate gifting alongside DTC.
Experience on both sides of the agency table, or running an agency selection or transition.
Incrementality testing and media-mix modeling, or experience scaling newer channels like AppLovin and TikTok.
You’ve worked on premium consumer goods, lifestyle brands, or hard goods, where the product itself carries the brand.

Salary & benefits

Expected base salary range (San Francisco Bay Area): $170,000 - $210,000 USD. Offered compensation will vary based on geographic location, as well as relevant experience, domain knowledge, and interview performance.

Eligible for target bonus of 20% of base salary
Choice of three PPO medical plans, with employee coverage on our base plan 100% company-paid
Dental, vision, and HSA plan options
Flexible PTO
401(k) with up to 5% company match
Monthly cell phone stipend
Paid parental leave (16 weeks for birthing parents, 12 weeks for non-birthing parents)
Remote-friendly, with flexible schedules in a high-trust, high-autonomy culture
Office hubs and bi-annual company offsites for in-person collaboration and community

High Camp is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy, sexual orientation, or gender identity), national origin, age, disability, genetic information, marital status, veteran status, or any other legally protected characteristic. Applicants must be currently authorized to permanently work in the United States. At this time, we are not able to sponsor employment visas or provide relocation assistance.

**Who We Are & What We Do…**

At STI Federal, we drive growth through strategic government contracting, fulfilling our mission to support the Sault Ste. Marie Tribe of Chippewa Indians. Our company reinvests 100% of its profits into tribal businesses or community programs, enhancing the well-being of over 52,000 tribal citizens. Our work empowers federal agencies and strengthens some of the nation’s most critical initiatives, while fostering opportunities for skilled professionals to make a meaningful impact.

**What You’ll Do…**

**Key Responsibilities & Expected Outcomes**

**Growth Strategy & Business Development Alignment**

* Partner with Business Development and Capture leadership to build and execute an annual growth marketing plan aligned to target agencies, priority pursuits, contract vehicles, and the recompete calendar.

* Measure and report event performance (meetings secured, qualified contacts, teaming conversations initiated, and opportunities influenced) to inform future event investment decisions.

**Booth, Exhibit & Collateral Operations**

* Own end-to-end exhibit execution: registration, booth space selection, exhibitor deadlines, shipping and drayage, electrical and internet orders, and on-site setup and teardown.

* Track and report marketing-sourced and marketing-influenced pipeline with BD, tying campaigns and events to opportunity outcomes.
* Route inbound agency and teaming inquiries to Business Development, and ensure no sensitive BD, capture, or nonpublic information enters public-facing materials.

**Knowledge, Skills, & Abilities for Success**

* Working knowledge of the federal acquisition lifecycle, from sources sought through award and recompete, and how marketing accelerates each stage.
* Confident, polished in-person presence; able to engage senior government officials, prime contractor executives, and small business liaisons on the conference floor.

* Strong project and vendor management skills, with a collaborative approach to working alongside BD, SMEs, and leadership.
* Proficiency with CRM platforms (e.g., Salesforce, HubSpot), CMS and analytics tools, and design tools (e.g., Adobe Creative Suite, Canva); able to convert technical concepts into clear, persuasive content.

**Experience:**

The Skirball Cultural Center seeks a strategic, creative, collaborative, and visitor-focused Vice President of Marketing to lead the institution's efforts to build awareness, deepen engagement, strengthen its brand and reputation, and create an exceptional experience for everyone who encounters the Skirball. jobs.title: Director, Marketing & Communications
jobs.description:
Greenlight Rent, formerly Rhino + Jetty, is making housing more affordable and accessible for millions of renters each year. We're the market-leading rental housing platform building simpler, more accessible ways for people to move into homes — and for property managers to lease with confidence.

Our technology removes friction from the move-in process, lowers upfront costs for renters, and helps property managers make faster, more accurate decisions. We support a network of 3 million rental units nationwide and work with 47 of the NMHC Top 100 property owners, including Greystar, Brookfield, Asset Living, UDR, and more.

We pioneered security deposit insurance and continue to push the industry forward with a growing suite of products — from deposit management to lease guarantees and loss-of-employment protection. We're growing quickly, tackling real problems at scale, and building technology that's changing how renting works.

**The Role**

Own and evolve the Greenlight Rent brand across every channel. You'll build clear, credible materials for partners, their leasing teams, and renters while supporting revenue through sales enablement, partner marketing, and pipeline-generating campaigns.

This is a hands-on role with significant ownership and room to shape how marketing operates at Greenlight Rent. One of your first major projects will be leading the marketing website revamp, from content strategy and structure through launch.

**What You'll Own**

  

* **Brand ownership** — voice, visual identity, and consistency across every channel partners and renters touch
* **Marketing site** — own it end to end: content, structure, and a full revamp as one of the first projects in the role
* **Brand and launch communications** — announcements, email campaigns, LinkedIn, launch collateral
* **Partner marketing** — product overviews, FAQs, training materials, help-center content, rollout comms
* **Product messaging** — translate Greenlight Deposit, Greenlight Guarantee, and future products into audience-specific value props
* **Sales enablement** — modular decks, one-pagers, case-study materials, partner-specific presentations
* **Lifecycle comms** — segmented messaging across partner types, portal users, policyholders, renters; coordinate with ops/CX on readiness and inbound response
* **Content operations** — copy quality, editorial calendar, legal/compliance approvals, asset production with designers
* **Events and field marketing** — conferences and partner moments: positioning, collateral, follow-up
* **Measurement** — reporting on email performance, engagement, asset usage, marketing's contribution to pipeline

  

**First 90 Days**

* Core narrative, product messaging, and audience segmentation documented and in consistent use
* Marketing site revamp scoped, with a build plan and timeline
* Partner and renter-facing materials complete, accurate, self-serve
* Post-launch comms cadence running across email, web, portal, help center, sales, CX, events
* Revenue has a usable, modular marketing toolkit

  

**Background**

* 7+ years in B2B marketing, communications, product marketing, or brand
* Hands-on experience owning a company website — content strategy, information architecture, working directly with design/dev to ship a rebuild, not just briefing an agency
* Real estate, proptech, multifamily, or adjacent fintech/insurance experience
* Exceptional writer/editor — can turn complex product and policy detail into simple, credible copy
* Comfortable building in a small, fast-moving team with no existing marketing infrastructure
* Experience partnering closely with sales, partnerships, product, legal/compliance, CX
* Strong judgment on regulated or reputationally sensitive communications

  

**Who Thrives Here**

This is a builder role — high ownership, fast iteration, equal comfort with strategy and execution. Owns the brand outright, not just supports it. Balances a sales-forward narrative with careful coordination across legal, compliance, CX, and product. Fills the gap left by no dedicated marketing team, and makes marketing a durable counterpart to sales and product.

**This Probably Isn't the Right Fit If...**

* You need an existing marketing team or established playbook to be effective
* You haven't worked in regulated or compliance-sensitive comms before
* You want to specialize in one channel rather than own brand + comms + enablement end to end

  

**Compensation & Benefits**

**Base Salary Range:** $145,000 - $185,000

Greenlight Rent has partnered with a number of compensation benchmarking tools to determine competitive and fair market pay bands for our size and stage. Our goal is to ensure each employee is paid equitably and competitively while also maintaining a consistent and standardized methodology.

Individual pay decisions are based on a number of factors including qualifications for the role, experience level and balancing internal equity relative to other teammates.

Base salary is just one part of our Total Rewards Package here at Greenlight Rent. In connection with this position, we also offer:

  

* Competitive cash compensation package including base salary, milestone based bonus, and other financial perks
* Medical, Dental, and Vision coverage (up to 90% employer contribution) - eligible from your start date
* 401(k), HSA, Life & Disability Insurance Coverage ($0 employee contribution for additional insurances)
* Unlimited PTO Policy
* Generous Paid Parental Leave
* Stock option plan to give our employees a direct stake in R + J’s success
* Remote-first work culture with opportunities to collaborate as a team in person
* Monthly lifestyle stipend to fit your needs (meals, wellness, co-working)

Performance Measurement and Optimization

jobs.title: Social Media & Performance Marketing Manager
jobs.description:
Companies: Flip It Factory & Dialed Industries

Location: Remote

Employment: Contract / Full Time

Compensation: $60,000–$75,000 base + performance-based bonus

Experience: 2+ years paid social experience; demonstrated experience managing $100K+ in monthly ad spend

About the Role

Flip It Factory and Dialed Industries are looking for a results-driven Paid Social & Performance Marketing Manager to

own and scale our Facebook and Instagram advertising. This isn't a traditional social media role. This role is responsible

for understanding that great creative gets attention and great performance marketing turns that attention into

customers, revenue and growth.

You'll take ownership of paid social strategy, campaign execution, optimization, testing and reporting across two

growing automotive brands. You'll work closely with ownership and our creative/content resources to continuously

improve performance and identify opportunities to scale.

If you live inside Meta Ads Manager, love testing creative and audiences, understand the numbers behind customer

acquisition, and get excited about figuring out why something worked, this is your role!

What You'll Own

Paid Social Strategy & Execution

 Own Facebook and Instagram paid advertising across Flip It Factory and Dialed Industries.

 Manage $100K+ in monthly advertising spend.

 Build, launch, monitor and optimize campaigns inside Meta Ads Manager.

 Develop campaign strategies around launches, giveaways, promotions and key revenue periods.

 Allocate and shift budgets based on performance and opportunity.

 Build audience, retargeting and prospecting strategies designed to efficiently acquire and convert customers.

Performance & Optimization

 Monitor performance daily and proactively identify opportunities or issues.

 Optimize toward revenue, ROAS, customer acquisition cost, conversion rate and other key business KPIs.

 Conduct structured A/B testing across creative, copy, audiences, offers, placements and campaign structures.

 Identify winning campaigns and scale them responsibly.

 Diagnose underperforming campaigns and make adjustments quickly.

Creative Strategy

 Partner with our team to identify the type of content, video, images, hooks, offers and messaging needed to

improve ad performance.

 Use campaign data to inform future creative instead of relying on guesswork.

 Continuously test new angles, messaging and formats.

 Stay current on Meta advertising trends, platform changes and emerging best practices.

Reporting & Business Insights

 Maintain clear, easy-to-understand performance reporting.

 Translate marketing data into actionable recommendations for ownership.

 Regularly report on spend, revenue, ROAS, CAC, conversion, creative performance and trends.

 Help answer the questions that matter: What's working? What's not? Why? And what should we do next?

Organic & Brand Collaboration

 Partner with our organic social/content resources so paid and organic strategies support one another.

 Identify high-performing organic content that can be leveraged through paid media.

 Help strengthen engagement and conversion across Facebook and Instagram.

 Maintain each brand's distinct voice and audience while creating efficiencies across both businesses.

 Compliance & Brand Protection

 Ensure advertising and promotional messaging aligns with platform policies and company requirements.

 Partner with leadership as needed regarding sweepstakes/giveaway promotional requirements and disclosures.

 Protect the integrity and reputation of both brands while pushing creative performance.

Requirements

 2+ years of hands-on paid social/media buying experience.

 Demonstrated experience personally managing at least $100,000 per month in paid advertising spend.

 Advanced experience with Meta Ads Manager / Meta Business Manager.

 Demonstrated ability to optimize campaigns against measurable business outcomes.

 Strong understanding of ROAS, CAC/CPA, CTR, CPM, CPC, conversion rate, attribution and funnel performance.

 Experience building prospecting and retargeting strategies.

 Strong analytical skills and comfort working with performance data.

 Experience developing and executing structured creative and campaign testing.

 Ability to work independently, move quickly and take ownership.

 Strong communication and organizational skills.

Preferences

 E-commerce or direct-to-consumer experience.

 Automotive, enthusiast, giveaway or promotional marketing experience.

 Experience with Shopify.

 GA4, pixel, conversion API and tracking knowledge.

 Experience working with video-heavy or creator-led brands.

 Experience scaling high-performing Meta campaigns.

 Knowledge of TikTok advertising or other emerging paid-social channels.

 Meta certification.

What Success Looks Like

Success isn't measured by how many posts we publish.

It's measured by whether marketing performs.

You'll be successful when you can consistently:

 Improve acquisition efficiency.

 Identify and scale winning campaigns.

 Develop a repeatable creative testing process.

 Provide clear visibility into marketing performance.

 Make smart recommendations without waiting to be asked.

 Help Flip It Factory and Dialed Industries acquire more customers and grow profitably.

The Person Who Will Thrive Here

 You're analytical without being afraid to be creative.

 You're comfortable experimenting, learning quickly and changing direction when the data tells you to.

 You don't need someone standing over your shoulder telling you what campaign to launch next.

 You see something underperforming and investigate it.

 You see something working and figure out how to scale it.

 And you're excited by the opportunity to have a direct, measurable impact on two growing automotive brands.

 Compensation: $60,000–$75,000 base salary, depending on experience, plus performance-based bonus

jobs.title: Sr. Growth Marketing Manager
jobs.description:
*At FourKites we have the opportunity to tackle complex challenges with real-world impacts. Whether it's medical supplies from Cardinal Health or groceries for Walmart, the FourKites platform helps customers operate global supply chains that are efficient, agile and sustainable.*

*Join a team of curious problem solvers that celebrates differences, leads with empathy and values inclusivity*

**The Role**

We're looking for a Sr. Growth Marketing Manager to own and scale the programs that turn target accounts into qualified pipeline. This role owns demand generation end-to-end — email nurtures, paid media (Google Ads, LinkedIn Ads), content syndication, webinars, and organic social presence — while contributing to overall messaging strategy and brand direction.

This is a high-ownership, execution-focused role for someone who's equally comfortable optimizing a paid search account, building a nurture sequence, and keeping our social channels sharp day to day. You'll set demand gen campaign strategy and ensure it stays aligned with FourKites' broader narrative by partnering across Marketing, Product, and Sales.

**What You'll Do**

**Demand Generation Strategy & Campaigns**

* Lead the growth and pipeline strategy: design and execute an integrated plan across paid, content, social, and lifecycle programs, with the roadmap and budget to hit awareness, conversion, and pipeline targets.
* Build and manage always-on and campaign-specific nurture programs including drip sequences, segmentation, and A/B testing, in coordination with sales development.
* Own end-to-end execution for webinars tied to active demand gen campaigns (platform administration, promotion, registration, and follow-up).
* Draft first-pass content supporting demand gen campaigns — landing pages, campaign emails, ad copy, and gated assets — for review and refinement.

**Programs & Partnerships**

* Own content syndication, third-party promotions, and paid placements end-to-end — from vendor selection and contracting through asset delivery, lead handoff with marketing ops and SDRs, and performance tracking.
* Build and maintain campaign planning templates and calendars that keep cross-functional stakeholders aligned on timing, assets, and channels.

**Paid Media & Search**

* Own strategy, execution, and ongoing optimization of Google Ads and LinkedIn Ads, including keyword strategy, bid management, audience targeting, and budget allocation across funnel stages.
* Own quarterly keyword planning — competitive gap analysis, tiered keyword strategy, and forecasting to inform budget conversations.
* Maintain and refresh our ICP and target persona/title lists each half or after major launches, feeding both paid and account-based targeting.

**Social Media**

* Own day-to-day management of FourKites' social channels with agency support on execution: copywriting on 2-3 posts weekly, final QA on all posts and graphics, community moderation, and photo/asset sourcing.
* Serve as the go-to resource for internal teams looking to get social content published, ensuring everything meets brand and voice standards.

**Cross-Functional Collaboration**

* Partner closely with the Director, Corporate Marketing on campaign strategy for nurture and webinar programs.
* Partner with content, PR, and product marketing to align demand gen campaigns with major company moments (product launches, positioning shifts, analyst events).
* Partner with marketing operations on analytics and reporting infrastructure — pipeline sourced/influenced, cost per opportunity, and channel-level ROI — so performance data is reliable and accessible across campaigns.
* Own continuous improvement across all campaigns: regularly test, measure, and iterate on targeting, messaging, and spend allocation based on performance data, rather than treating campaigns as set-and-forget.

**What You Bring**

* 6+ years of B2B demand generation or growth marketing experience in enterprise SaaS. Experience in supply chain, logistics, or transportation technology and AI agents is a plus.
* Hands-on email marketing experience, including building nurture sequences, managing segmentation, and reporting on engagement and conversion.
* Direct, hands-on experience managing Google Ads and LinkedIn Ads campaigns, from strategy through execution and optimization is preferred.
* Experience owning a webinar program (platform administration, promotion, and reporting) is a plus.
* Comfort managing organic social channels day to day, including community moderation and content QA.
* Strong project management instincts — comfortable building and maintaining the templates, processes, and calendars that keep a marketing team organized.
* A collaborative style; you'll work closely across Sales, Marketing, and Product and need to bring people along rather than execute in a silo.
* Comfort working with data to track performance — you don't need to build dashboards yourself, but you should be fluent enough in the numbers to know what to test next.
* Strong writing skills — clear, human copy for campaigns and social, even if long-form content isn't your primary focus.

**What Success Looks Like**

In your first 90 days: you'll have taken ownership of the paid media, social media, and webinar programs, be fluent in current campaign performance and ICP targeting, and have a working rhythm established with the Director, Corporate Marketing on nurture and webinar strategy.

By month six: you'll be running demand gen campaigns independently end-to-end, have a content syndication program live and generating qualified leads, have improved reporting visibility into pipeline sourced by channel, and have tightened up campaign planning processes for the broader marketing team.

jobs.title: Manager, Marketing Communications, LAC
jobs.description:
**Ready to make your next big professional move? Join us on our journey to achieve our big dream of building the most loved restaurant brands in the world.**

Restaurant Brands International Inc. is one of the world's largest quick service restaurant companies with nearly $45 billion in annual system-wide sales and over 32,000 restaurants in more than 120 countries and territories.

RBI owns four of the world's most prominent and iconic quick service restaurant brands – TIM HORTONS®, BURGER KING®, POPEYES®, and FIREHOUSE SUBS®. These independently operated brands have been serving their respective guests, franchisees and communities for decades. Through its Restaurant Brands for Good framework, RBI is improving sustainable outcomes related to its food, the planet, and people and communities.

RBI is committed to growing the TIM HORTONS®, BURGER KING®, POPEYES® and FIREHOUSE SUBS® brands by leveraging their respective core values, employee and franchisee relationships, and long track records of community support. Each brand benefits from the global scale and shared best practices that come from ownership by Restaurant Brands International Inc.

The Manager, Marketing Communications is responsible for supporting the development and execution of integrated communication strategies that strengthen brand awareness, engagement, and relevance with consumers. This role manages marketing communications initiatives across multiple channels, partnering closely with cross-functional teams, agencies, and other stakeholders to bring brand strategies and campaigns to life.

The Manager oversees a broad portfolio of communications initiatives, including brand-building campaigns, product launches, promotional initiatives, social media, and licensing partnerships. The role provides regional coordination and guidance to local markets, helping them adapt plans to their consumers and business needs while protecting Burger King’s brand standards.

A key responsibility is managing the regional licensing calendar and supporting the effective planning and activation of partnerships negotiated globally, regionally, or locally. The role also provides strategic guidance and follow-up on social media across LAC markets, helping teams deliver against their digital strategies and identify culturally relevant opportunities.

Success requires strong organization, creative judgment, and the ability to lead and influence stakeholders across markets and functions, including franchisees. The ideal candidate brings a strong understanding of Latin American consumers and culture, and consistently contributes new ideas and market perspectives to the region.

**RBI follows a** **5** **day, in-office work schedule to support collaboration. Successful candidates will be expected to work onsite** **5****days** **per week.**

**Roles and Responsibilities:**

**Brand & Communications Strategy**

* Support the development and execution of integrated, 360° marketing communication plans aligned with broader brand and business objectives.
* Translate brand strategies into clear consumer-facing communications across digital, social media, television, influencer, and other relevant channels.
* Manage communications supporting product launches, promotional initiatives, and broader brand-building campaigns.
* Partner with Marketing and cross-functional teams to ensure communication plans effectively address consumer, business, and market needs.
* Ensure licensing and social media initiatives strengthen Burger King’s brand positioning and remain consistent with brand identity, tone of voice, and communication standards.
* Support other integrated marketing communications initiatives as needed.

**Licensing Strategy & Calendar Leadership**

* Lead the planning and management of the Burger King licensing calendar across LAC, partnering with innovation, Field Marketing, International, Legal, franchisees, and key stakeholders to support effective licensing activations.
* Track licensing plans, approvals, deliverables, timelines, and results across markets collaborating with field team to address risks or delays.
* Identify opportunities to strengthen the licensing portfolio and bring fresh, culturally relevant ideas to the calendar.

* Optimize on-page SEO, including metadata, internal linking, schema markup, and website architecture.
* Manage local SEO campaigns, Google Business Profiles, and Google Maps rankings.
* Implement AI Search Optimization (GEO/AEO) strategies for ChatGPT, Google AI Overviews, and other AI-powered search engines.

* Prepare SEO reports demonstrating measurable results and growth.
* Collaborate with developers, content writers, and account managers to execute SEO strategies.

Required Qualifications

* **Minimum 5 years of professional, hands-on SEO experience.**
* **Mandatory previous experience working at established SEO or digital marketing agencies.**
* **Proven experience managing a large number of SEO client projects simultaneously.**
* Demonstrated success working with clients across multiple industries and competitive markets.
* Strong portfolio of successful SEO projects with verifiable ranking and organic traffic improvements.
* Advanced knowledge of technical SEO, on-page SEO, off-page SEO, and local SEO.
* Proven experience with Google Business Profile optimization and Google Maps rankings.
* Proficiency with Ahrefs, SEMrush, Screaming Frog, Google Search Console, and GA4.
* Experience with WordPress, HTML, CSS, and JavaScript SEO.
* Familiarity with AI search optimization, GEO, AEO, and structured data.

**Senior Account & Marketing Strategist**

Pet Engine Marketing is looking for an experienced marketer who can become a trusted partner to our clients and a key operator inside our agency.

This is not a coordinator role, and it is not a narrow channel-specialist role.

You’ll lead client relationships, help shape marketing strategy, manage projects and contractors, interpret performance data, and make sure good ideas actually turn into completed work.

Our clients are independent pet businesses across the U.S. and Canada, including pet retailers, groomers, trainers, boarding and daycare facilities, and other local service businesses.

**What You’ll OwnClient Leadership**

* Lead regular client meetings and become a trusted marketing advisor.
* Understand each client’s business, goals, challenges, and priorities.
* Bring ideas to the table instead of waiting for clients or leadership to tell you what to do.
* Manage expectations, navigate difficult conversations, and occasionally provide what could best be described as client therapy.
* Identify opportunities to improve results or expand the relationship.

**Marketing Strategy**

* Help diagnose where a client’s marketing is working, where it is breaking down, and what should happen next.
* Develop and refine strategies across SEO, paid advertising, websites, email/SMS, local marketing, customer retention, and other channels.
* Connect marketing activity to actual business outcomes.
* Understand that the right marketing recommendation depends on the business behind it, including revenue goals, capacity, budgets, seasonality, and operational constraints.
* Push back on distractions and help clients focus on the work most likely to matter.

**Account & Operational Ownership**

* Keep projects, campaigns, contractors, approvals, and deadlines moving.
* Maintain organized accounts and clear next steps in ClickUp.
* Follow through without requiring constant reminders.
* Know how to distinguish between something that is urgent, something that is important, and something that can wait.
* Catch problems before they become client problems.
* Improve processes when you see a better way to do something.
* Operate comfortably when the answer or process isn’t already laid out for you.

**Reporting & Analysis**

* Review marketing performance regularly and understand the story behind the numbers.
* Identify trends, problems, and opportunities.
* Translate data into clear recommendations clients can understand.
* Work with specialists to evaluate campaign performance and determine next steps.

**What You Should Know**

You don’t need to be the deepest technical expert in every marketing channel. You do need enough marketing experience to understand how the pieces fit together and confidently advise clients.

You should be comfortable with:

* Local and organic SEO
* Google Business Profile
* Google Ads and Meta Ads reporting
* Email and SMS marketing
* Common websites CMS and conversion optimization
* Marketing analytics and reporting
* Customer journeys, lead generation, retention, and conversion

You should be able to look at traffic, leads, rankings, ad performance, email results, bookings, revenue trends, or similar data and answer three questions:

**What’s happening? Why might it be happening? What should we do next?**

**Tools & Technical Comfort**

You should be highly comfortable with:

* Google Workspace
* ClickUp or similar project management software
* ChatGPT and AI tools for research, analysis, planning, writing, and improving workflows

You should also know your way around tools such as:

* Google Analytics 4
* Google Search Console
* Google Business Profile
* Klaviyo, Mailchimp, or similar email platforms
* Google Ads and Meta Ads reporting
* Website CMS platforms
* Marketing dashboards and reporting tools

Specific platform expertise matters less than being able to learn quickly and work independently.

**Who We Think Will Thrive Here**

You’re probably a strong fit if you:

* Have several years of hands-on marketing experience and have managed client relationships, preferably in an agency, consulting, or similar environment.
* Can confidently lead conversations with business owners and communicate clearly in writing.
* Think strategically, understand the business behind the marketing, and can turn ideas into action.
* Are highly organized, accountable, and able to prioritize without escalating every decision.
* Can manage multiple clients, contractors, and competing priorities without losing the thread.
* Are curious, adaptable, and comfortable figuring things out when there isn’t a perfect playbook.

An entrepreneurial mindset matters here. If you’ve run your own business, freelanced, consulted, built a side business, or otherwise had to make decisions and create momentum without someone constantly telling you what to do, we want to hear about it.

Experience working with local businesses, retail, service businesses, or the pet industry is also a plus.

As Pet Engine grows, this role has the potential to take on increasing leadership responsibility, including helping develop and manage additional members of the account team.

**About Pet Engine Marketing**

Pet Engine Marketing is a boutique digital marketing agency focused exclusively on independent pet businesses.

We work with pet businesses across the U.S. and Canada, helping them grow through strategy, SEO, paid advertising, email and SMS, websites, local marketing, and other digital channels.

We care about doing excellent work, being useful to our clients, and producing measurable results without unnecessary agency bureaucracy.

jobs.title: Social Media & Content Coordinator
jobs.description:
About the Role

Shasta Pools & Spas builds premium residential pools across the Valley, and every project is a story worth telling: an empty backyard on day one, a resort-style retreat at the end. We want a creator who sees those stories and can't wait to film them.

This isn't a desk job, and it isn't a role where you'll wait for assignments. You'll own Shasta's organic social presence on Instagram, TikTok, and Facebook. You'll pitch the ideas, grab your phone, head out to job sites, get our crews and homeowners talking on camera, and turn it into content people stop scrolling for. You'll have real freedom to experiment, try new formats, and jump on trends fast.

You'll also have a clear framework to work within: a weekly posting cadence and a monthly content calendar, so your creativity has a rhythm and your work shows up consistently.

What You'll Do

* Own the content from idea to post. Come up with concepts, shoot them, edit them, and publish them, with 4–5 posts per week across Instagram, TikTok, and Facebook and short-form video as the priority.
* Get out in the field. Visit construction sites, finished backyards, showrooms, and company events to capture authentic content. Most weeks you'll spend more time on location than at a desk.
* Get people talking on camera. Interview homeowners about their new backyard, get our builders and service techs to share what they know, and capture the personalities behind the brand.
* Tell the transformation story. Before-and-afters, dig-day-to-first-swim timelines, behind-the-scenes moments, customer experiences, and company culture.
* Move fast on trends. Spot new formats, sounds, and ideas as they emerge and turn them into Shasta content while they're still relevant.
* Shoot and edit short-form video on a smartphone or camera, using CapCut, Adobe Premiere Pro, or similar tools, with strong hooks, pacing, and captions.
* Capture great photos of premium projects and outdoor lifestyle moments, with an eye for composition, lighting, and making a backyard look like a destination.
* Create graphics and promo creative in Canva, Adobe, or AI-assisted design tools for social posts, promotions, flyers, and brochures.
* Write scroll-stopping captions, hooks, and calls to action, plus basic promotional copy.
* Keep the calendar on track. Build a monthly content calendar around seasonal demand, promotions, and company announcements, and hit the posting cadence every week.
* Learn from the numbers. Watch reach, engagement, video retention, and follower growth, and share a quick monthly recap of what worked and what you'll try next.
* Pitch in on marketing projects. Help with creative requests from sales, keep marketing materials and the photo and video library organized, and coordinate with outside vendors.
* Keep it unmistakably Shasta. Make sure everything you publish reflects our premium brand, look, and voice.

You're Probably a Great Fit If You…

* Always have a new content idea and get restless when you're not creating something.
* Light up around people. You can walk onto a job site, make a crew laugh, and get a homeowner comfortable on camera in a few minutes.
* Like to move fast and would rather post something good today than something perfect next month.
* Want ownership. You do your best work when someone hands you the goal and trusts you to figure out how to get there.
* Can keep yourself on a schedule. Your creativity is backed by a track record of posting consistently.

What You Bring

* 1–3 years of experience creating organic social content, through a job, internship, freelance work, or growing your own account. Recent grads with a strong portfolio are encouraged to apply.
* A portfolio of short-form video you conceived, shot, and edited yourself. This is the most important part of your application.
* A posting history that shows consistency, whether on a brand account you ran or your own, over at least several months.
* Fluency on TikTok, Instagram, and Facebook, including Reels, Stories, carousels, and what's working on each platform right now.
* Hands-on editing skills in CapCut, Adobe Premiere Pro, or similar tools.
* A strong visual eye for photography, lighting, and aesthetics.
* Sharp, engaging writing for captions, hooks, and calls to action.

Nice to Have

* Content experience in home improvement, construction, outdoor living, luxury lifestyle, or another visually driven consumer brand.
* Comfort using AI-assisted creative tools (Canva Magic Studio, Adobe Firefly, CapCut AI features, ChatGPT or Claude) to speed up ideation, editing, and design.
* Experience with social scheduling and analytics platforms.
* Experience coordinating influencer partnerships, user-generated content, or customer testimonials.
* Basic familiarity with email marketing, content management systems, or general digital marketing.

Field & Schedule Requirements

* Valid driver's license and reliable vehicle; mileage reimbursed for travel to job sites across the Phoenix metro area.
* Comfortable working outdoors, including Arizona summer heat.
* Able to follow safety rules on active construction sites.
* Occasional early-morning, evening, or weekend shoots for events and the best light.

Not Part of This Role

To keep your focus on creating, this role does not include:

* Website development or maintenance.
* Advanced SEO or technical website optimization.
* Managing Google Ads or Meta paid campaigns.
* Advanced marketing automation, CRM administration, or analytics implementation

Send your resume to ShastaHR@shastapools.com and a link to your portfolio or the account you've been growing. Include at least three short-form videos you shot and edited yourself. Then tell us, in a sentence or two, the first video you'd make at Shasta. Finalists will complete a short paid editing exercise using raw footage from one of our projects.
